row.name: Crypto Miner Tycoon Simulator Starter Edition
row.detailed_description: Get the full game About the Game Crypto Miner Tycoon Simulator™ is a complete simulation of the cryptocurrency mining business. The Starter Edition includes one full scenario and story from the main game. In this one, you start as a teenager whose wealthy father is hyped about digital currency. He isn’t really tech savvy, so he gives you some cash and challenges you to build a crypto mining business: Relive mining history Start in your bedroom in 2010 Historically accurate coin exchange rates Various events including new hardware unlocks Speed up the game clock up to 28800x The game uses real historic prices for coins, but your actions can change the course of history. For example, you can set up a PR department that will influence the media and hype some coins up or down. Build mining rigs Assemble rigs from PC parts Install software Use racks to organize space and direct heat Replace broken parts and outdated components A custom C++ game engine was written specially for this game in order to support 1000’s of mining hardware units per facility. Mine coins Play through the CPU, GPU, FPGA and ASIC mining era Mine Bitcoin, Ethereum and more... Realistic network hash rates Manage power, heat, noise, dust Build datacenters with cooling systems and low dust levels. Keep noise down in research labs. Manage your company buy or rent new offices hire people set work shifts and task priorities pay monthly bills and wages You can unlock overtime work by upgrading your management skill or hiring professional managers. Research develop employee skills create research labs discover new technology before competition create your own coin and launch the ICO Each game scenario has a special research goal related to the story. Customization Customize your character Set dress code for employees Use whichever currency you like ($, GBP, EUR, RUB, CNY…) Imperial and metric system supported What are you waiting for? The best time to start mining was 10 years ago.
row.short_description: Start in your bedroom in year 2010. Build rigs to mine Bitcoin, Ethereum and other crypto coins. Trade on the market to grow wealth. Expand your business into new offices. Hire skilled employees and assign tasks. Use cash from your mega farms to research new technologies.

row.detailed_description: 天空中的是什么啊？ 那个不是地球吗！要是掉下来的话绝对会死翘翘的吧！ 不过不用担心，嘉然一定会保护大家的，她会 搭讪 在地图上的四个区域自由移动，和路过的行人搭讪 反复和她们对话，或是赠送礼物，会帮助你推进进度直到最终局面 ...如果你并不像嘉然这样可爱，请不要做出反复骚扰别人的事 约会 ...终于搞好了关系，那么你们可以一起行动了 镇上新开的咖啡厅是很好的约会地点，几次前往会获得不同的反应 但是这个时候也不要太随意了，错误的行动会降低对方的好感 比如，你不会同时攻略两名对象吧...要是被看到你和其他对象一起约会的话... ...不会有人做那种事的，对吧？ 打工 从驿站获取包裹，并派送给正确的对象 有时在街上会举办露天演唱会，你可以自由参与 和小镇里的角色随机组成队伍，在演出中跟着音乐的节奏打节拍 报酬和你的表现、出场次数相关 ...再怎么说，也不至于落魄到翻垃圾桶吧 *本作为同人游戏，禁止用于任何商业行为*

row.name: Low Oxygen
row.detailed_description: Low Oxygen is a small puzzle platformer about an astronaut that crash-landed on an alien planet, trying to find a way to reach his home, Earth, again. The Objective Explore a strange facility in order to find a way to blast off the surface of your new planet. You'll traverse 50 rooms filled with strange puzzles , and occasionally some fuel canisters, the ticket to your home. The Plants The main mechanic of the game is represented by the strange flora you'll find, plants that grow when they are ridden of their oxygen supply, and now its your time to get used to them, and use them to your advantage! The future My future plans are to expand this by adding a level edtior, steam workshop stuff probably , enabling player to make & share their own hand-crafted experiences! Also controller support ! Closing Thoughts I hope you'll enjoy this small passion project of mine, don't forget to leave a review! I'll try to read through as many of them as possible!
row.short_description: Explore an abandoned facility on the planet you've crashlanded, solving puzzles with strange plants along the way.

row.name: RPG Maker - PiXel ScaLer
row.detailed_description: Convert your map and character assets into RPG Maker Unite specs with “PiXel ScaLer”! PiXel ScaLer is a powerful mini app that can enlarge and convert pixel arts into higher resolution illustrations! With this tool, users can now resize custom or previous RPG Maker assets and modify a little to quickly adapt it into RPG Maker Unite’s graphic standards! *PiXel ScaLer is a product developed by karuta-san - who has kindly granted RPG Maker the rights to distribute it as an RPG Maker Unite official tool. **The previous PiXel ScaLer will continue to be available for download at the author’s sites after our release as an Official Tool. Users of the previous version of PiXel ScaLer can also continue to use it without concerns. PiXel ScaLer can be used with some previous RPG Maker titles! Supports various resolutions! This application is mainly intended for use with the upcoming release of RPG Maker Unite, but it can be used with RPG Maker MV, MZ, and other series as it supports a variety of resolutions! In addition to the 98 x 146 (walking graphics) and 194 x 194 (SV Battler) resolutions, which are the same specifications as the default assets in RPG Maker Unite, the following resolutions are supported. Walking graphics: 48 x 48, 64 x 64, 128 x 128, 256 x 256 SV Battler: 64 x 64, 320 x 320, 512 x 512
row.short_description: PiXel ScaLer is a powerful mini app that can enlarge and convert pixel arts into higher resolution illustrations! With this tool, users can now resize custom or previous RPG Maker assets and modify a little to quickly adapt it into RPG Maker Unite’s graphic standards!

row.name: Ancient Saga: Vikings Journey
row.detailed_description: Take the journey of a lifetime with Thor and the Vikings! Go to Ancient Greece and help Thor, Hercules’ daughter Alexia, and the other warriors save Midgard from Fenrir. Fenrir, a giant wolf, is ready to destroy Midgard and all its inhabitants in his rage. Follow Fenrir’s story and explore the source of his immense anger as he sets off on a path of destruction. Discover a thrilling story and find out what made Fenrir so angry that he has resolved to destroy Midgard. Are you ready to join the Vikings on their epic quest to defeat the Minotaur? You’ll have to prove your worth by solving the Gods’ puzzles. Embark on an unforgettable adventure as you join the Vikings in their mission to bring peace back to the world! Get ready to embark on a journey to the mythical world of Olympus! Go on Zeus’ quest and find a special flower for the goddess Calypso. Along the way, you will explore the mysterious underworld, meet Hades, and uncover secrets about Cerberus.
row.short_description: Thor and the Vikings are on a mission to save Midgard from Fenrir. To achieve their aim, they take a daring journey to Ancient Greece in search of a remedy. However, they soon realize that the task ahead of them will be harder than they imagined.

row.name: PoPuP
row.detailed_description: Let's Create a Paper World Amusement Park! Our game PoPuP, which started with this little thought, is now our own identity! The main play of the game is to help the main character Robin venture into a paper amusement park, collect all the parts and recreate the circus. When you start the game, it starts in the forest, and when you get to the amusement park through the forest, the ticket agent tells you that the circus has collapsed. The main character Robin can move by pulling an item or hanging on a specific section with the power of his flute or arm. If you collect parts beyond various puzzles and traps and move across a large lake, you will meet Boss Corinth. If you run away from Corinth and defeat him, you can rebuild the circus again. Adventure a beautiful paper amusement park with Robin and rebuild the circus!
row.short_description: Puzzle Flatformer Game Adventures Over Obstacles at a Paper Amusement Park

row.name: Golgotha
row.detailed_description: Golgotha is a short first person horror game that delves deep into creeping fear and severe paranoia as you traverse through the sinister grounds of Black Waters Station. Along the way you will discover the horrors that lie within and ultimately disturb those who are not at rest. The lantern and dim lights will guide your way through the station as you explore and find your way towards the exit. There are multiple cutscenes to encounter and items to discover. Golgotha features no combat. This game focuses primarily on atmosphere and dread. The game's main features are realistic immersion, fantastic sound design and disturbing imagery throughout. Black Waters Station is a large vicinity, and it will require some exploring and searching to progress through the game. (Security Cards, Keys Etc.) In 1942, Black Waters Station was overcome by a toxic and poisonous fog that killed thousands of people as they slept in the tunnels and platforms of the station to escape the war. After the horrific ordeal the authorities closed the doors to Black Waters and sealed it off to the public. In 2003 the station was officially reopened to the public. But after several freak accidents and unexplainable deaths, it was once again closed for good. It has been abandoned and undisturbed for over 20 years. Until now…
row.short_description: Dare to explore the most haunted vicinity in all of England? You will leave no stone unturned as you walk along the eerie grounds of the Black Waters Station and uncover the horror that lies within.
row.notes: Themes of Suicide & Horror

row.name: GB BASIC
row.detailed_description: GameBuilder BASIC ( GB BASIC ) is a retro Fantasy Console that generates ROMs compatible with the popular handheld game console. It has everything ready-to-use for writting code, making assets, compiling projects, running with the built-in emulator, exporting to runnable ROM, etc. Why GB BASIC? GB BASIC is programmable in a brand new BASIC dialect. The integrated assets editors are intuitive to use. You can generate real ROMs and play on any GB emulator or hardware. Programming Paradigms Imperative paradigm Non-structured programming Concurrent processing approach Declarative paradigm Data driven approach Features Programmable in BASIC, an easy to learn and fun to use programming language Easy to use API for graphics, input, audio, and other facilities Built-in libraries for scene, actor, controllers, GUI Built-in libraries for collision detection, persistence, RTC, etc. Extension feature including mouse & touch, shell command, debugging, etc. Handy tools for editing tiles, map, scene, actor, font, sound, etc. Project can be exported into real ROM Dozens of example projects Specs CPU : 4.19MHz/8.38MHz for classic/colored respectively Threads : up to 16 concurrent execution contexts Display : 160x144px Code : BASIC, supports multiple source pages Gamepad : 8 buttons (D-Pad + A/B + Select/Start) Mouse and touch : supported by extension Tiles : up to 256 units per page Map : up to 255 tiles in one dimension per page; two layers (graphics, attributes) Sprite : supports 8x8 and 8x16 sprites Scene : up to 255 tiles in one dimension per page; four layers (map, attributes, properties, actors) Actor : up to 8x8 tiles per frame; up to 1024 frames per page Font : supports TrueType (.ttf) and bitmap-based (.png .jpg .bmp .tga); up to 16px; 1bpp or 2bpp Audio : 4 channels; supports importing from JSON, VGM, WAV, FxHammer Palette : 2bit (4 colors) per tile, palette of map and actor is configurable for colored device GUI : supports label, progress bar, menu, etc. Persistence : supported RTC : supported Serial port : supported
row.short_description: GameBuilder BASIC (GB BASIC) is a retro Fantasy Console that generates ROMs compatible with the popular handheld game console.

row.name: Escape From The Depth
row.detailed_description: Escape From the Depth is an interactive 3D horror game. You navigate through the submarine level trying to collect items to escape from a monster that roams the hallways of the submarine. The player is armed with a map and is told where to go and which items they will need to grab, all while trying to avoid the monster. Features Stealth Multiple endings Narrated story Stealth The player can crouch and peek between hallway to ensure that the monster is no lurking nearby. Multiple endings Near the end you are presented with two options. What you choose to interact with, will dictate what ending you will get. Narrated story The story is fully narrated. As the player collects the required items they need. The ships AI will indirectly reveal what happen to the ship and it crew members through conversation with the main character.
row.short_description: Escape From the Depth is a cosmic horror game that takes place in a submarine under the dark, cold, and desolate oceans of Europa. The player must survive while trying to collect the necessary items to safely evacuate the sinking submarine.

row.name: VR Construction Lab
row.detailed_description: The VR Construction Lab comprises game levels where a user is tasked with assembly objectives. Each level has a scoreboard and some levels have a timer that monitors how long a player has been conducting an assembly. Teleport to any location on the job site and pick up components to build a wall. For every rightly placed item, you get a score point. row.name: Sweet Science – The Girls of Silversee Castle
row.detailed_description: What if... ...you went back in time to a place you never wanted to go to? And there you are: at a weird science camp in a prestigious boarding school in Silversee Castle in the 1990s. Will you solve the mystery of how you ended up there? And will you be able to return to your time? And maybe find love? In this visual novel you will meet four extraordinary (and quirky) girls, learn more about your world and uncover the mystery. On the way, original puzzles are challenging you. Master them – or simply chicken out. Dive into the story and find out how sweet science can be! Features & Gameplay: The visual novel includes eight good endings and a few bad ones. Make the right decisions and master the minigames to reach the ending of your choice! The minigames feature unique, science inspired puzzles that will challenge your mind (but you can skip them if it's too hard for you). Moreover, in one of the minigames you will challenge your favorite character to a game of Go, but don't worry: Mr Young is going to explain the rules to you before the game. Sweet Science contains several interwoven story lines. To uncover them all, you will play more than one route. One route contains around 5 hours of gameplay, for all routes we estimate 15-20 hours of game play. On the way, you will encounter hundreds of graphics and a full soundtrack, featuring the song 'Butterfly Lullaby' composed for this game by Alec Weesner, and the song 'Time', sung by Emilia. 'Sweet Science' is waiting for you. – Will you uncover all its secrets? Cast: Artificial Intelligence This is one of the first real AI-generated visual novels: nearly all artwork was generated by AI artists (NovelAI, DALL-E 2, Diffusion Bee). But is this artwork art? The story touches on this and many other questions in an entertaining and open-minded way. Steam Release Special To celebrate the Steam release, we have added one extra scene. You can access it from the main menu at 'Extra+'. It contains mild spoilers, so better watch after finishing at least the first three days of the game. Enjoy! :)
row.short_description: This lighthearted visual novel lets you meet four quirky young women. A fun and highly interactive story taking you back in time – to the 1990s and a castle full of science, mysteries and – perhaps – romance...

row.name: UC Love
row.detailed_description: ABOUT UC Love is a humorous, touching, and wholesome anime-style dating simulator with characters that have three-dimensional personalities. The characters are personifications of many of the University of California schools + a few surprises ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)! There are various locations to visit, minigames to play, and secrets to find! GAME FEATURES 5 Romanceable UC Girls (Left to Right: UCB, UCLA, UCI, UCR, and UCSB) Two Secret Romanceable Characters ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) Cameos of the other UCs! Unique Storylines for Each Romanceable Character! 4 Mini-Games! Sprite Sets and Various Expressions! 9 Endings to explore! Chill original music! Wholesome vibes and funny jokes! TIPS Finish the game by successfully asking one of the characters to the dance! Each UC Lover has a set schedule that they follow each day. Explore the campus and pay attention to when you see your love interest in a particular place! Your UC Lover will only agree to go on a date with you if they are close to you, and will only agree to go to the dance with you if they are really close to you! Love interests will be more open and interested with you as they get closer with you! To build a relationship with someone, talk to them repeatedly and/or give them gifts! Each love interest has a loved gift, liked gifts, and disliked gifts, except for a certain Mr. Tree in the Mud, who hates all gifts. If you are at a dating stage, do well with the date minigame for some extra brownie points! After you are able to successfully ask them out on a date, you may be able to ask them out to the dance! :) EXTRA TIPS (SPOILERS) If you're looking to date Tommy, you can find him by taking a walk in the garden at night! :) If you're looking to date Stan Ford, you can find him in the field after you beat the gym minigame on hard! :) There are 5 cameo UCs hidden around the campus! Explore the campus to find: Mercedes (UCM), Diana (UCSD), Crystal (UCSC), Davina (UCD), Francesca (UCSF), Hailey (UC Hastings) GAME NOTES This was developed as a student project as part of ACM UCLA's 2022 Student Run Studios!
row.short_description: A humorous and wholesome anime-style dating simulator based on personified University of California schools + more ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)! Romance 2D-girls (or guys) with 3D personalities in a cute and funny visual novel format! There are various locations to visit, minigames to play, and secrets to find!

row.name: 雷雨漫漫Endless Thunder
row.detailed_description: 《雷雨漫漫》是由龙科游戏使用Ren'py引擎制作的文字类游戏。 '生或者死，都在一念之差。' 明面繁华闪耀的A市，实际上暗流涌动。 “大巴侧翻，车上乘客无故失踪”；“A市目前行踪不明者超过了100人”...... 结束一周忙碌的工作，正当你踏上回家之路时， 你察觉到背后有人在不断跟着你。 你，会做出怎样的选择呢？ 你的每一步选择，都将影响你的命运。 你，能逃出魔爪吗？ 【多结局判定】 游戏通过您的选择将会触发PE完美结局，NE普通结局，BE坏结局。通过得分机制，了解你的选择正确与否。
row.short_description: 《雷雨漫漫》是由龙科游戏使用Ren'py引擎制作的文字类游戏。游戏中，你将扮演A市一名办公人员，在你的下班路上，你察觉到背后有人在不断跟着你。通过重重选择，活下来。

row.name: Mademoiselle Kshatriya
row.detailed_description: Special Thanks This game is made from 'SMILE GAME BUILDER'. Story A young shrine maiden woke up in her updated dreaming world on Brahmanism. Only Kshatriya and Vaishya who pay their great respects to Brahmana can be admitted into Brahmanism. The young maiden had worshiped the Sun very religiously and God selected her and tried her within her dream on Brahmanism. A Deity is also interested in that religion because Brahmanism keeps ancient magic that is so-called Chakra. The Sun has great Chakra which can attract matters by solar rays and the shrine has worshiped the Sun as the merciful God. A ordinary girl often visited the shrine in which the Sun is worshiped as God. Those who want to live a happy life are very interested in how to be lucky. The girl was not an exception. She knew Vedas as a superstition before she became ridden by Vedas. She had knowledge about four Varnas but she didn't know how to become Kshatriya or Vaishya. She sometime heard about Caste in her neighborhood but she felt like something was not quite right about the meaning of Caste. Game Style JRPG is main style in the game. When camera control is locked, feature of adventure becomes the main. It is something like dark fantasy and dark jokes. Quick learning of Brahmanism is the main theme.
row.short_description: A young shrine maiden and her friend got lost in her dreaming world on Brahmanism. According to Manusmriti, no woman is permitted into four Varnas. A woman is born to be in the same class as the untouchable class. But her destiny helps her with trying to deny the irrational black magic.

row.name: ウワガキアイ
row.detailed_description: ■Story The protagonist wakes up in a strange place and He wakes up in a strange place and gets caught up in a crazy and inorganic experiment by 'someone'. While fighting against what lurks within and searching for a way to escape and discover the tragedy that took place here. ■Features ･Command You need to use your own actions on the game screen and the four commands on the upper side of the screen to advance the story. and four commands on the upper side of the screen to advance the story. However, the commands are not always However, the commands are not always available. You have to win a game with 'someone' and and take away the commands. ･Riddle Solving Element There are several riddles in front of the main character. The player solves the riddles based on the hints that can be found somewhere in the facility. The 'riddles' will become important to reveal the truth. ･Exploration type game The game is an exploration type game in which the player searches for the truth by examining objects in the map. ･Items There are various items hidden in the map. However, they are not used automatically. You, the player, must specify where to use them. ･The stage The main character searches for escape in a place like a laboratory. ■Before starting this game You need to click on commands, images, etc. in the screen. Normal movement can also be done with the cross keys. This game contains death, dark and grotesque expressions. It also contains some horror scenes. The content of the game is the same as that of the free game. It takes about 5 hours to play and has multiple endings. There is an EXTRA on the title screen, and END hints are provided in it. If you find the game difficult to conquer, please refer to the hints. ■About the live broadcast You are welcome to do so. There is no need to put the name of the work, author, or URL in the video. (The use of in-game data for purposes other than gameplay or distribution is prohibited.)
row.short_description: A tragic story of repeated overwriting. Exploration type ADV I woke up in a laboratory. I immediately noticed something strange, but the erosion had begun. （In a certain laboratory, I started an experiment.) (The first and last experiment for me, risking everything...)
row.notes: Violence, Gore, self-harm

row.name: ConnVerse
row.detailed_description: ConnVerse, connect all beautiful scenery and scenes in the world and universe, provide high-quality creation and immersive experience, create the next generation of immersive entertainment products! Players can build all kinds of high-quality real and virtual spaces together, so that people can enjoy the beautiful scenery, parties, entertainment with friends from all over the world without leaving home, and experience tens of thousands of high-quality immersive spaces. -ConnVerse is free of charge and can be used across platforms on VR glasses, computers, mobile phones and other devices. -Use the creator's SDK to create a variety of favorite high-quality spaces and avatars -Discover all kinds of interesting spaces, experience the beauty of the world and all kinds of amazing spaces Join our fast-growing community, and let's create and explore the next generation of 3D Internet! Contact us: support@connverse.cn
row.short_description: ConnVerse, connect all beautiful scenery and scenes in the world and universe, provide high-quality creation and immersive experience, create the next generation of immersive entertainment products!

row.name: Tome of Fates
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in Tome of Fates , an Adventure Gamebook: create, play, and share unique stories through the built-in story editor. Play solo or co-op with friends, craft epic narratives without any coding, then share them on the Steam Workshop for others to enjoy. EDITOR - Story Creation, Simplified Dive into the powerful yet intuitive story editor. This tool allows you to design branching narratives without any programming knowledge, making it easy to bring your imagination to life. WORKSHOP- Share Your Stories Share your stories on Steam Workshop and discover new adventures from the community. MULTIPLAYER - Co-op / Twitch viewer interaction Don't want to play alone? Our unique CO-OP system allows you and your chosen friends to vote on the path the story takes and what choices to make. Bit of a streamer? Use our Twitch Integration system to allow viewers to join in on the fun and influence your story!
row.short_description: Adventure Gamebook: Dive into an interactive experience where you can create, play, and share your own unique stories. Use the intuitive story editor to craft narratives without coding, explore them solo or in co-op with friends, and share them on the Workshop for everyone to enjoy.

row.name: Up All Night: Daybreak
row.detailed_description: Night after night, nightmare after nightmare. Despite the passage of time, Nick Torres just can’t seem to shake the ghosts of his past… and one ghost in particular -- much to Nick’s chagrin -- has found his way back to the waking world. Felix returns in this short kinetic novel, eager for a conversation. Will Nick indulge him? ...Does he have a choice? Up All Night: Daybreak is a direct spin-off of Up All Night , and contains a multitude of spoilers. As such, players are encouraged to experience Up All Night before proceeding with Daybreak . Kinetic story 5,000+ words Custom artwork Original soundtrack Emotionally traumatized Nick Torres
row.short_description: Nick just can't let go of the people he's killed.
row.notes: This game incorporates mature themes including alcohol abuse, physical violence, psychological trauma, and visual and written depictions of gore.

row.name: Cryspace
row.detailed_description: WELCOME TO CRYSPACE Welcome to Cryspace. Fresh out of college, you decide to make an account on the new social media platform. Upon joining, your lifelong friend, Paul Meyer, adds you, and invites you to a house party. Could this be your chance to live the 'college lifestyle' you always dreamed of? If only it were that simple. You may have had enough drinks to feel confident at that party, enough to the point where you could even ask out Sam, someone you've had a crush on for quite a while, but Paul's nowhere to be found. Making your way upstairs in your search, you're met with a frightening scene. Paul is being pressed by a man, Jordan Myra, who happens to be the ex-boyfriend of Paul's current girlfriend, Crystal Mendez. He's threatening violence against Paul, seemingly out of pure jealousy. Will you call the cops on him? Take on the fight for yourself? Maybe you decide to leave the party and not get involved at all? The choice is yours. In this game of tense and fragile relationships, the fate of your friend group and new relationship rests purely in your hands. Will you be able to secure a future for yourself and your significant other? What's really going on behind the scenes in Paul's relationship with Crystal? With countless branching paths, over seventy different endings, and a narrative where rising conflicts are always around the corner, your critical thinking and ability to empathize will be tested thoroughly. One misstep may be all it takes for everything to come crashing down. INFINITE CUSTOMIZATION Make Cryspace your own with many settings available to make the site look just the way you like it. Introduce your character to the world of Cryspace with a custom profile picture, name, and alter the appearance/behavior of the website to your liking. You may also play as either a male or a female, giving you an immersive experience from start-to-finish as you pursue the truth.
row.short_description: Cryspace is a fresh visual novel with a nostalgic flavor. Talk to your friends online, meet with them in-person, and allow your friend group to grow in numbers, or fall into despair through your own decision-making and discretion. Experience the first few dates with Sam for FREE.
row.notes: Cryspace contains references to violence, sexuality, suicide and other generally mature themes. Discretion is advised.

row.name: Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session
row.detailed_description: Join Our Discord!!! About the Game Get ready to rock and groove with Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session! This rhythm-based game takes you on a musical adventure through dimensions, with striking visuals that will keep you mesmerized for hours. Unique gameplay mechanics challenge you to switch between three rows, pressing the action button in time with falling arrows that match your guitar pick. Precision and quick reflexes are key to success as you navigate through each song, avoiding obstacles such as spikes that threaten to disrupt your performance. MAKE YOUR OWN LEVELS: With two exciting charting modes, Drag & Drop and Play-Through, you can create your own custom levels with ease. In Drag & Drop Charting Mode , simply place notes on a grid to build your own song. For a more immersive experience, switch to Play-Through Charting Mode and chart your inputs as you play through the song, letting your musical abilities guide the way. UNIQUE AND INTENSIVE GAMEPLAY: In Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session , you'll experience unique and intense gameplay as you navigate through a world of rhythm and sound. To succeed, you'll need to be quick on your feet and avoid spikes that threaten to disrupt the beat. But what sets this game apart from others is its interdimensional twist – you'll travel through different dimensions, each with its own unique rhythm and challenges. Whether you're a seasoned rhythm game player or a newcomer to the genre, Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat with its innovative and addictive gameplay. EXPERIENCE THE PSYCHEDELIC VISUALS: The game is a spin-off of the Ortheo franchise, and is free to play. The game also supports Gamebanana, making it easy to share your custom levels and songs with other players. Get ready to feel the beat and experience the ultimate rhythm-based gameplay with Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session! INSPIRED BY THE GREATS: Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session is a rhythm game that draws inspiration from some of the greatest rhythm games in the genre. The visual design takes cues from Everhood , offering a psychedelic and trippy experience. The health meter system is inspired by PaRappa the Rapper , adding an additional layer of challenge to the game. Additionally, the game is influenced by the looks of the upcoming Rift of The Necrodancer and Muse Dash . With these great games as inspirations, Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session is set to offer players a unique and unforgettable rhythm experience. CREDITS: Programmer: Dallen Larson Art Director: ZachJaDa Composer: Anthony Hampton
row.short_description: Get lost in the musical madness of Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session. Groove to unique beats, create custom levels with drag & drop or play-through charting, and share your creations with Gamebanana support. Experience trippy visuals, challenging gameplay, and endless fun.

row.name: Vessel Blue
row.detailed_description: Subscribe to Lukas Paver's E-Mail list right now About the Game You've found a mysterious computer, and whilst you don't know why, you try to solve the mysteries of 'Vessel Blue', a cryptic company, through the data and files you find on the machine. However, you are not alone. INTERACT WITH THE ENVIRONMENT Solve text-based puzzles using your computer. Explore the mysterious software of the device by reading documents, encrypting files and entering codes into databases. SOLVE PUZZLES WITH YOUR COMPUTER Examine items that are located on your desk to help you proceed through the game. Read documents to find even more clues. But be aware: while you're trying to solve the mysteries, you're hunted by an evil walking pumpkin monster. DEFEND YOURSELF, YOU CANNOT MOVE You CANNOT MOVE in this game! You're glued to your chair, and have to constantly watch your back to scare the pumpkin man away while solving the puzzles.
row.short_description: Solve text-based puzzles by interacting with a computer you've found and uncover Vessel Blue's secrets. You are bound to your chair, so defending yourself against unwanted guests is difficult.

row.name: VONA / She
row.detailed_description: Vona is a point and click game where the player will perform a Ukrainian housewife’s life and her attempt to “escape” from her house, breaking the daily life loop and obtaining all the Gender Museums' pieces. The game takes place in a house, where the player has to do the housework: cleaning, cooking, doing the laundry… step by step and in time. But, at the moment when the player does something different (take a relaxing bath, wear too much make-up, drink vodka…), the player will open a museum inside a hole in her kitchen. There is a lot of housework and the player must do everything before the day ends. This can feel oppressive. If the player doesn’t make perfect, she will run out of time. But, it’s in this imperfection where the player can find more fun and when the player will progress in the game.
row.short_description: Perform an Ukrainian housewife’s life attempting to breaking the daily life loop

row.name: Real-Time Assist Replay Time　～1 minute until closing～
row.detailed_description: Experience the near-future slot game 'Untap, Girls' featuring infinite ART with no wait time for non-stop spinning! Follow the push-order navigation, and you can earn endlessly until the store closes! Just when you enter the dream-like infinite ART, there's only one minute left until closing time... Every Japanese slot player has gone through the 'bonus rush just before closing.' With frustration and haste, accurately press the lever, bet, and buttons! Show off your concentration and see how much you can collect in a short amount of time! No need for timing precision! By following the on-screen instructions and pressing buttons, you can increase your medals in this game that focuses solely on the most satisfying part of slots - the 'Assist Replay Time (ART).' After launching the game, hit the lever to start! Try to earn as many medals as you can before the time displayed in the upper left corner runs out! Follow the push order navigation (*) There's also an online ranking to see how much you can earn in one minute! Use the medals you collect for the 'Gratitude Lottery'! Aim to complete all 60 items! *Push Order Navigation: The numbers '1,' '2,' and '3' displayed above the three stop buttons. The character will navigate you to press the 'left,' 'middle,' or 'right' buttons next. By pressing the stop buttons in the order shown, you can line up winning combinations and increase your medals. If you press the buttons in the wrong order, the combination won't be successful, and you won't gain any medals.
row.short_description: This is an original slot-style mini-game set in the future where you've hit the ultra-high-speed, high-purity increase, endless ART just one minute before closing! Try to collect as much as possible before time runs out!

row.name: Mechafare
row.detailed_description: The early stages of an RTS I created in a gap year. Create your loadout from a wide assortment of mechs, including some that shoot, some that slash and some that do way to much damage. Send your mechs to battle, capture objectives, to improve your stats and destroy the enemy base. Generate alloys from playing matches to improve your loadout by purchasing mechs from the armoury. Have fun, it will be hard to but have fun Planned updates: -A lot more Mechs -Smoother animations -Cleaner UI -Ability to Purchase Neonites -Colour variants for Mechs - Improved balance
row.short_description: The early stages of an RTS I created in a gap year. Create your loadout, send your mechs to battle, capture objectives and destroy the enemy base
row.reviews: “Amazing. A pioneer of the RTS genre, A refreshing take that is for sure not league of legends + clash royale with extra steps” 1000/10 – Very Real Organization That Reviews Games I Think

row.name: Natural Disaster: A Butterfly's Guide to Mass Destruction
row.detailed_description: “Does the flap of a butterfly’s wings in Brazil set off a tornado in Texas?” –Edward Lorenz, “The Butterfly Effect” Natural Disaster: A Butterfly’s Guide to Mass Destruction is a slapstick puzzle game with inspiration from point-and-click classics of how one very evil butterfly can bring down an empire. Explore a world through a stereoscope, test your limits as a teeny butterfly in a human’s world, and start chains of cause-and-effect that ripple across the seven scenes to disastrous results. A SMALL WORLD OF SMALL PUZZLES Investigate the environment to discover items you can carry, objects you can activate, and places you can land to find how to lead these people to their worst nightmares. PLAY THROUGH A STEREOSCOPE VIEWER Explore seven rich 3D locations through the lens of a stereoscope. Follow the characters through paths with multiple endings as your actions in one scene continue in another. TIME LOOP TRIALS Upon your death, you find yourself back at the beginning, and all of the humans’ peaceful lives restored. It’s a time loop trap…or an opportunity for new methods. A BUTTERFLY NEVER FORGETS Your shenanigans are logged the Scrapbook. It journals everything you’ve learned about your targets across multiple trials and is a guide for what the butterfly might be curious to try next. HOLD ON…A WIZARD? In all your exploits, no one seems to notice that it is a butterfly causing their misfortune. But what happens when somebody does?
row.short_description: Natural Disaster is a point-and-click-inspired adventure game set in a View-Master. Explore a world in scenes and sow the seeds of disaster by virtue of the butterfly effect!

row.name: Maybe tomorrow
row.detailed_description: Photosensitive Epilepsy Warning This game features much flashing lights as well as much patterned lights. Maybe Tomorrow is a casual game where the player drag the stars with a mouse and brighten up the night sky. As the player clears each level, the player learns about Andrew and his habit of saying 'Maybe tomorrow'. Levels are cleared by reaching certain brightness level. Constellations can be formed when stars are close to each other and can help make the sky brighter. Each level features different challenges. Some levels feature obstacles that block lights from the stars, and some levels have objects that can help the players make the sky brighter. Choose your own game difficulty The player can use up to 10 stars per level to clear the level, but players who like challenges can also clear the level by only using certain number of stars per level. Maybe you are the one that motivates Andrew to say 'today'.
row.short_description: 'Maybe Tomorrow' is a casual game in which the player drags the stars in the night sky with a mouse and brighten up the sky. Form constellations with stars and learn about Andrew, who has a habit of saying 'maybe tomorrow'

row.name: XBattleCarsPVP
row.detailed_description: Get ready to engage in battle with XBattleCar PVP! This team-based vehicular combat game allows you to compete against other players in real-time battles. Each vehicle in XBattleCar PVP possesses unique skills that you can use to outmaneuver and outsmart your opponents. Some vehicles are equipped with a boost ability that allows them to gain an edge in speed, while others have devastating weapons that can deal heavy damage. With a wide range of vehicles to choose from, it's important to select one that fits your playstyle and strategy. To make things even more exciting, XBattleCar PVP offers an array of weapons that are scattered throughout the map. Keep your eyes peeled for these powerful weapons and use them to gain an advantage over your opponents. The weapons are spread out in different areas of the map, so it's important to explore and familiarize yourself with the terrain. In XBattleCar PVP, your ability to choose the right vehicle and utilize its skills will determine your success on the battlefield. You'll need to be strategic and adaptive to overcome your opponents and emerge victorious. With intense battles and exciting gameplay, XBattleCar PVP is the perfect game for anyone looking for a thrilling vehicular combat experience. 'Zone Control Mode' Zone Control Mode, there will be multiple zones located across the map that players will need to capture and hold. When a player or team enters a designated zone, a countdown will begin, and if the player or team can hold the zone for the duration of the countdown, the zone will become under their control. Each zone capture will provide the player's team with a certain number of points, and the opposing team's score will decrease accordingly. Players will need to use their driving skills, as well as their teamwork and strategy, to capture and defend zones while also preventing the opposing team from doing the same. This mode encourages both offensive and defensive gameplay, making for an exciting and challenging experience. 'Destruction game mode' Destruction game mode, two teams battle it out to see who can destroy the most enemy vehicles within a set time limit. Players can choose from a variety of vehicles, each with its own unique weapons and abilities.To win, players must strategically plan their attacks and take advantage of their vehicle's strengths while avoiding their weaknesses. Upgrade your vehicles to gain an advantage in battle! By completing matches, you can earn in-game currency which can be used to purchase upgrades for your vehicle. These upgrades can improve your vehicle's health and upgrade weapons to increase their damage, giving you an edge on the battlefield. Customizing your vehicle's capabilities can make you a formidable presence in combat. However, it's important to choose your upgrades carefully. With a limited amount of in-game currency, you need to prioritize which upgrades will be most beneficial to your playstyle and strategy. Careful consideration and planning can mean the difference between victory and defeat on the battlefield. So choose your upgrades wisely, and dominate the competition!
row.short_description: Gear up for battle in XBattleCar PVP! Choose your vehicle and join your teammates in a real-time battle against other players. Strategize with your team and use your unique vehicle abilities to take down enemy vehicles and secure victory. So get behind the wheel and start your engines!

row.name: Tap Shap - The World's First Multi-platform Reaction Game
row.detailed_description: Happy gaming! Test your motor skills with Tap Shap! Tap Shap is a unique, free-to-play, addictive game! Speed the characters through the obstacles while matching their colour patterns. The endless gameplay has one hand control and is good for children to build their motor skills and for older people who could be losing theirs. Unlock new items from the marketplace, improve your reflexes and compete with people around the world to be the best at this fast-paced game! How to play: Tap Shap is an extremely easy-to-play reaction game for all age groups! - Press the space bar to rotate the ball through each obstacle and match the ball with the coloured obstacles. - You must follow the colour pattern on each obstacle to cross it. - If you make the ball pass through the obstacle without coordinating the colours, you will have to start again. - You can change the objects in your game from the marketplace by using the KIDA CREDITS received during the game.
row.short_description: Tap Shap is a unique, free-to-play, addictive game & the world's first multi-platform reaction game!

row.name: Dreamkeeper
row.detailed_description: Uncover A Mystical World! In “Dreamkeeper” you play as Marshmallow, the cute little pet of a girl named Ava who wants to become a heroine. The so called “Dreamkeepers” are pets who have the magical ability to see nightmares and ward them off, while their owners are sleeping. But in Avas home village the Dreamkeepers are getting weaker and weaker and no one knows why. She embarks on a journey to find the cause of the problem and save her village. Help Marshmallow to fend off the nightmares and discover more about Avas world by increasing the score and unlocking more stories! Choose Your Powers By increasing the high-score you can unlock new tarot-cards with different abilities. There are five in total to choose from for every game you play, but you can only choose two in every fight to protect Ava from the Nightmares. Find your very own playstyle and explore the different card-synergies and modifiers to get the highest score! Choose Your Challenge! There are different game modes that offer the right challenge for every player, whether professional or beginner. After unlocking every card and lore-snippet you can customize your own game and choose modifiers to make the game harder or easier. Beat your own record and set new high scores by protecting Ava from all Nightmares!
row.short_description: You play as Marshmallow, the cute little pet of a girl named Ava who wants to become a heroine and save her village from the Nightmares. To protect her you use magical bullets, tarot-cards and try to find your very own playstyle to unlock the story and get the highest score!

row.name: L/Right Reflection
row.detailed_description: 'L/Right Reflection' is an RPG game in which the main character, who is unable to use offensive sorcery, battles by reflecting enemy attacks. The player controls Lumis, a girl who is a sorcerer but cannot use offensive sorcery. How will Lumis defeat the enemies even if she can't attack? The way Lumis defeats the enemies is through reflection sorcery. You can damage the enemy by reflecting the enemy's attack at the right moment. In the battle, enemy attacks are represented by a skill cursor, which looks like a magic circle. At the center of the battle screen, there is an area called a marker. When the skill cursor is just over the marker, press the button for a successful reflection. The game is designed in the style of a rhythm game, in which the player parries the movement of the skill cursor to move in various ways, such as straight lines, curves, waves, and rotations. Also, there is not only one button to press but three different buttons. The enemies use three types of attacks: blows, slashes, and magic, so press the button corresponding to each attack to reflect them. Sorcery In addition to reflection sorcery, Lumis can also use sorcery to advance the battle. Such as, Reflective damage is reduced but slows down the enemy's attack. Reduces HP by half but increases reflective damage Automatically reflect all enemy attacks for one turn, but reflective damage becomes a little These consume MP, but many of them have more powerful effects. Characters This game uses Live2D, so the characters move vividly in conversation and battle scenes! Especially in conversation scenes, the characters' expressions change in detail, making the story more enjoyable.
row.short_description: 'L/Right Reflection' is an RPG game in which the player fights by reflecting enemy attacks. Choose the appropriate magic for each situation, detect the enemy attacks, and face a variety of enemies.
row.notes: Some characters in this game are bloody in some event scenes.

row.name: JetpacToo
row.detailed_description: A mysterious planetoid has appeared in the solar system, in a race to try and exploit its resources different nations send their robot-manned ships to investigate, however as the ships approach a powerful energy wave causes them to crash land almost destroying them. It is now a race between the different factions marooned on the surface to reassemble their ships and head back to claim official ownership to the planetoid. JetpacToo is a single or multi player game supporting cross play between flat-screen and VR. This has been created primarily to test the network and real-time planet terraforming technology for the upcoming god-game Me Igigu and what better way then to recreate an old-school classic in 3D. The game has 2 main modes, All VS All where up to 6 people can compete to find (or steal) the resources to build their ships and protect their launch pad and Team Match, with 2 teams of up to 3 people each.
row.short_description: A totally free reimagining of the classic Jetpac in a sandbox world with All Vs All or Team Match with unique real-time terraforming played over the surface of a planetoid created exclusively to test key components for the upcoming Me Igigu.

row.name: Collect Call
row.detailed_description: Collect Call is a puzzle platformer game. You might work through the puzzles on your own, or you might talk to other characters to piece together a mystery. Features Gameplay Puzzles gradually introduce new mechanics so you learn at a comfortable pace with intuitive elements, including levers, buttons, physics objects, bridges, and more. The game also includes a story told through dialogue with other characters and lore hints hidden in the levels. Your dialogue choices do matter. Steam Deck Works fine on my Steam Deck. The game runs natively on Linux and Windows, controllers are detected automatically, and it will use 800p by default. My Steam Deck gets about two-thousand fps with vsync and the frame-rate limit turned off. Graphics & Performance The game may use pixel art, but there are still graphical options to configure. The game supports most common resolutions all the way up to 8K. You can also toggle v-sync or set a frame rate limit. Modding & Steam Workshop Collect Call can play custom levels from the Steam Workshop. Custom levels can include custom dialogue, puzzle elements, graphics, and more. Levels can even be chained in a sequence for a custom campaign just like the included one. Custom levels can also be installed manually. You will need map editing software to make your own levels. I used Tiled and suggest you do the same, it is free and open-source. You should also format your levels similar to the included ones for compatibility.
row.short_description: A puzzle platformer about cooperating and exploring.

row.name: SoundTown
row.detailed_description: An accessible one-button music game for children with complex needs. Born out of my PhD research at the Glasgow School of Art, SoundTown is a game designed for - and with - children and young people with complex physical and cognitive needs. The initial brief for SoundTown was developed through consultations with several appropriate organisations, including schools and charities with knowledge of accessible play. Built in the Unity game engine and powered by the Wwise audio engine, SoundTown consists of six minigames that are accessed directly through the Main Menu. Players interact with SoundTown using a maximum of two buttons or switches. One button navigates the menus, whilst the other is used to select a minigame or play. Thus, SoundTown is explicitly accessible to players only capable of interaction with a single input device such as a switch, foot pedal, or the Xbox Adaptive Controller. SoundTown is completely free to play and always will be. A huge thank you to: - Menphys - Birkett House School - Kinnaird Primary School - Hazelwood School Created by Alexander Horowitz, with artwork by Carol Studzinski, and voiceover by Susannah Horowitz.
row.short_description: An accessible one-button music game for children and young people with complex physical and cognitive needs.

row.name: Lord of the Other World
row.detailed_description: This game is a more casual strategy war game, it bid farewell to the endless confrontation between players in traditional strategy games! More emphasis on collaboration between players. The game integrates strategy warfare and card development gameplay, simulated business gameplay, team-dungeon gameplay, and designed an urban construction model centered on prosperity and civilization, and innovated a 'private territory' that did not exist in previous strategy games. The new concept of 'safe collection'. At the same time, players can also send business travelers to freely communicate with each other across continents, donate supplies, and prosper together and develop harmoniously! [Exclusive territory, safe collection] Facing a different world that is about to be destroyed, you, as the lord of the city, will become a candidate for the throne and have your own private territory. There you can collect, play wild, and defeat the bosses of monsters, farm safely without being disturbed, focus on improving the construction of the capital, and create your own new world! [Develop civilization and build homes] The fire of civilization is endless. After canceling the concept of combat power in traditional strategy games, we introduced the concepts of civilization and prosperity. As the heir to the throne, force does not determine everything. Therefore, rather than letting players fall into endless battles in the game and constantly pursuing combat effectiveness, we hope that players will help each other, spread civilization and develop cities, and build a prosperous new capital! [Shuttle the mainland, free trade] After canceling the traditional strategy game where players attack each other's cities to plunder resources, we have opened up the runner gameplay of mutual trade between mainlands, six regions, 30 specialties, multiple runner paths, and real-time updates. Trade information, random events. Perhaps not every trade is smooth sailing, but risks and opportunities coexist, challenges and benefits coexist, maybe you are a business wizard in another world! [Wasteland Experience, Relic Treasure Hunting] Stopping in another world, exciting adventure links are also essential! We have opened a wasteland palace that can challenge ourselves. At the same time, as your main city hall level increases, copies of the ruins of different difficulties will also be opened for you. Whether it's dangerous underground caves or desolate desert ruins, you can enjoy the fun of teamwork and multiplayer teaming, and find lost treasures in danger! [Hero Development] Three races, massive heroes, and legendary heroes with various characteristics, each hero has its own mission. They will accompany you all the way in your life in another world, and do their best to help you fight against enemies, fight against monsters, and win the crown! [Territory War] 6 regions, 36 cities, and 36 legendary lords, this continent is full of wealth and opportunities, waiting for your conquest!

Designed to support special education transition-related instruction, these virtual resources are free and available to parents, schools, educators, and students in Michigan. MITTIN is a partnership of the Michigan Association of Administrators of Special Education (MAASE), Michigan Council for Exceptional Children (MCEC), Great Lakes Reality Labs (GLRL), and Public Policy Associates (PPA). The topics covered in this game include: Safety and Independence in the Home Change a Light Bulb Clean the Bedroom Put Away Groceries Use a Microwave Use an Oven Use a Stove Safety and Independence in the Community Cross the Street Shop for Groceries Use Self-Checkout Walk Through a Parking Lot

The current work is unremarkable, but based on your feedback, I will make improvements and update it as a real work on February 28th. Thank you for your cooperation. Attacks can hit even if the enemy is away because they generate shockwaves. Currently, there is only one stage, but as more stages are added in the future, it will become an 'equal game' that can be achieved through player skill and practice, without any skill ups or item equipment. Also, based on your opinions, we will promptly and accurately update to provide a better successful experience.

row.name: Paddle Flap
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Paddle Flap, a minimalist casual arcade game where you control a paddle at the bottom of the screen and flap it left or right to bounce falling balls. Use precise timing to control the direction of the balls and hit right targets, avoiding the spiky ones. Along the way, collect power-ups and earn achievements as you unlock new ball graphics, backgrounds and color themes. Can you master the art of Paddle Flap and become a top scorer? Play now and find out! Features: High speed ball action Simple but engaging gameplay Satisfying paddle interaction Power-ups Achievements Unlockable balls, backgrounds, color themes and music Check out and wishlist our upcoming game, Mechanical Mayhem!

The game features parkour maps + minigames which you can use to train your minigame skills! Currently there are a few maps which are parkour. The map themes are lava and air. The game also has easy to learn game mechanics so everyone at all ages can play without learning alot. Currently there are parkour maps which you have to try and beat, or if you want to try and speedrun them! Parkour maps : There are a few parkour maps, where the point is to try and beat as fast as possible. Minigame maps : There are minigame maps which are supposed to represent classic minigames that you would find on other modern platforms. Multiplayer support(still in works) There is going to be multiplayer support so you and your friends can try all of the maps! Easy to learn game mechanics One of the things focused on the game was the easy to play style. So everyone, at all ages can play this game easily! Completely community-driven game We try to focus new updates and map additions, based off of your feedback! The game has to date only a few maps. The maps are: Lava This is the lava level which you have to try and do the obstacles without falling in the lava. It has a difficult drop, and some easy jumps. row.name: Root Connections
row.detailed_description: Digging deep into the root of his world, you play as the hallucinations of a man struggling with psychotic depression. Puzzling your way through the darkness of alcoholism and the fear of losing loved ones, it is up to you to root connect this man’s life back together again! There are lots of things that this little mandrake will have to hide from, and these huge scary eyes are certainly one of them! Use one of the unique game mechanics by pressing SHIFT to hide yourself as a plant. You may hide for as long as you wish, but you cannot move the player while hiding. row.name: Little Bo Reap
row.detailed_description: Little Bo Peep has lost her sheep, and now she's out for revenge! Play as Bo Peep in a single-player 3D action-RPG where she's overwhelmed with grief and goes on an adventure through Pastoria. Command a variety of sheep flocks for you to fight your way through hordes of fairy-tale creatures on a brutal revenge quest for the sake of all sheep and animals. Use your necromancy powers taught to you by your old mentor, Baba Yaga - It must be because of all of her evil ways that all of your sheep were killed! Battle, train and learn new abilities to gain an advantage on the big trolls, spitting flowers or kamikaze frogs! Earn their souls to upgrade your abilities and unlock new ways of fighting to fit your own playstyle, such as riding your sheep into battle! You must discover the unique aspects of the land, including solving puzzles, platforming or discovering the long lost skulls. Find Baba Yaga and let her know how much those sheep meant to you, though she might be more prepared than you think! Construct your sheep into various shapes to help you on your quest. Lift yourself to the sky by stacking sheep on top of one another. Crash through walls with your Rams to solve puzzles and unlock cool secrets. Cast a breeze of Fluffy Sheep into a vortex to overwhelm your enemies. Launch your sheep at your enemies from a distance. Collect Souls from your enemies to spend on upgrades for your abilities, or even unlock new ones!
row.short_description: Little Bo Peep's sleepiness has led to all of her sheep being killed! Take revenge using powers of necromancy to summon undead flocks of sheep to defeat your foes. Each different flock can assist in your movement or your battles to defeat your foes in an untold number of ways!

row.name: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life — Day 1
row.detailed_description: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life is a visual novel about love and strings of fates intertwined by a single supernatural event. The free version of My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life — Day 1 invites you to plunge into the first out of the four days in this mystical story, try on the shoes of a real Japanese student, and see the plot unfold around you. The protagonist was just a regular young man from Tallinn, but after dozing off on a train commute he wakes up a completely different person in far-off Japan. The main character's name is Maksim Laas. He is a simple guy from Tallinn, leading the most ordinary life with its own ups and downs. Though, admittedly, the latter have lately been somewhat more prevalent for him. After breaking up with his ex, the world has lost its usual colors for Maksim, and his life quickly grew into gray, dreary, and inescapable routine. At least that was what he thought... Because something unbelievable happened without warning: the moment Maksim dozed off for a second during a commute, he suddenly woke up in another country... in someone else's body! From this moment onward, the hero will have to live several unforgettable days as Akira Kojima (no relation to THAT Kojima) and make acquaintance with some very charming girls. Perhaps this little summer adventure will alter the protagonist's fate? Or is there more than just his future that is at stake here? Key Features: A love story where your choice affects the characters' destiny! A narrative full of humor and drama where your decisions influence the rest of the story. Find out where your choice may lead you and see how it influences those around you! Win hearts or break them You will meet two pretty girls, each with their own backstory, feelings, and worries. Kyoko is your friendly and kind-hearted next-door neighbour, always ready to help. Haruko is the complete opposite: she is brazen and even rude at times, leaving her true personality a mystery for the protagonist to unravel. Think carefully before you decide to open up to either one of them! Colorful anime scenery A myriad of detailed backgrounds and illustrations will immerse you in the atmosphere of romantic anime and fill you with nostalgia for school days, warm summers, and adventures of the heart!
row.short_description: A strange incident turns the life of an ordinary young man upside down when, having fallen asleep on a regular train commute, he wakes up in another country... in a body of a Japanese student! An unforgettable summer adventure awaits, promising many fateful meetings and momentous occasions.

So you have to use your time wisely. 2. Simple UI, simple operation we didn't set up many complex or meaningless functions 3. A sense of discovery. We have many maps, you will see many beautiful scenery.

row.name: Halls of Torment: Prelude
row.detailed_description: Halls of Torment PRELUDE is a casual roguelite action RPG with a pre-rendered retro look reminiscent of RPGs from the late 90s. Choose one of three hero characters and descend into the deadly Halls of Torment. Fight unholy horrors from beyond and survive wave after wave of enemies until you face one of the tormented Lords. Strengthen your hero with character traits, abilities, and items. Create a new powerful build during each run. Explore various underground expanses and find new powerful items that enable you to venture even deeper into the abyss. PRELUDE Features Quick and casual 30 minute runs Old school pre-rendered art style Quest-based meta progression Diverse bosses featuring unique mechanics and attack patterns Unique items can be sent up to the overworld and used to customize future runs PRELUDE Content 2 stages with dynamic progression 6+ unique bosses 20+ unique monsters 3 playable characters 6 different upgradable abilities 8 blessings that make you stronger for each run 30+ different items to retrieve and unlock 200+ traits that upgrade characters and abilities 30+ quests to complete Many more features and content are available in the main game. Save games from Halls Of Torment PRELUDE can be imported over to the main Halls Of Torment game.
row.short_description: Slay hordes of terrifying monsters in this horde survival roguelite. Descend into the Halls of Torment where the Lords of the underworld await you. Treasures, magical trinkets, and a growing cast of heroes will grant you the power to vanquish these horrors from beyond. How long can you survive?
row.notes: Halls of Torment contains cartoon violence against undead and demonic creatures with some gore from a top down non-detailed perspective.

row.name: Rudra: A Tale of Time
row.detailed_description: A game made by students at the University of Utah. Narrative Live the story of Rudra. As a hero determined to protect humanity, you travel through the different Yugas(Eras) of the world to find the source of malignant corruption. As you travel through the beautiful landscapes of each Yuga, cleanse the orbs of corruption blocking Ma Ganga’s flow. From the divine Satya Yuga to the darkest Kali Yuga, you will experience the full Chatur Yuga cycle. As you progress, immerse yourself into the world of Hindu culture. Explore the inner workings of Chakras, stories from Hindu scripture, and much more. Combat You’ve faced enemies from the Nordic and Greek regions. Now it is time to face the evil from Hindu scriptures. Take on Pishachas, Rakshasas, Bhishani, and even Asuras! Unleash the power of Varunastra, a gift from the gods. Use this legendary weapon to perform a variety of epic combos. Use powerful incantations known as Mantras to aid you on the battlefield and morph Varunastra into several weapons from ancient India. Features Richly detailed world inspired by Hindu scriptures. Epic storyline that takes you through the four Yugas of the universe. Dynamic combat system that allows you to use Mantras and Varunastra to defeat your enemies. Challenging boss battles against legendary creatures from Hindu scriptures. Exploration of the inner workings of Chakras and stories from Hindu scripture. Immersive soundscapes that transport you to a mystical realm. Stunning graphics that bring the world to life.
row.short_description: Rudra: A Tale of Time is an action RPG inspired by Hindu scriptures. Embark on a journey of self-discovery by unlocking chakras and using mantras to save the universe from the forces of evil. Are you ready to unleash your inner warrior and restore balance to the universe?

row.name: Monster Battle
row.detailed_description: 'Monster Battle' is a fun and charming roguelike deckbuilder game featuring a colorful cast of cute monsters. Players will journey through a randomly generated world, using their deckbuilding skills to collect and train an army of monsters to defeat dangerous foes and reach their ultimate goal. With fast-paced, turn-based battles and a constantly changing world, 'Monster Battle' offers a fun and challenging experience for players of all skill levels. The cute and playful art style, combined with the deep and engaging gameplay, make this game a joy to play for fans of roguelike deckbuilding games. Resource Management: Manage your resources carefully to acquire new cards and abilities, and improve your chances of survival against the enemies of the night. Customizable Decks: Build your own custom deck of cards by selecting from a range of powerful abilities, equipment, and allies, and tailor it to your preferred playstyle. Unique Enemies: Battle against a variety of enemies that pose different threats, including undead creatures, hunters, and other supernatural beings. Evolving Gameplay: Over time, new cards and abilities become available, making the gameplay richer and more complex as you progress through the game. Multiple Paths to Victory: Discover different strategies to defeat your enemies and emerge victorious, whether through combat, diplomacy, or stealth. Beautiful Artwork: Enjoy stunning artwork that captures the dark and brooding atmosphere of the vampire world, from haunting landscapes to terrifying creatures. Replayability: With a wide range of cards, enemies, and game modes, the game offers high replayability, providing hours of entertainment for both casual and hardcore players. Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: The game is easy to learn, but hard to master, making it accessible to players of all skill levels, while still providing a satisfying challenge for experienced players.
row.short_description: 'Monster Battle' is a cute and charming roguelike deck builder featuring adorable monsters. Journey through a randomly generated world, build an army of monsters and defeat foes with strategic deckbuilding.

Hot parties every day and you don’t need an excuse to show your moves on the dance floor! Getting bored from all the fun? Start a business, earn game currency and become successful. row.short_description: Welcome to the new virtual reality! Metaverse Maska is a home to interesting people, fun parties, exploration and fulfilling relationships! You create your own world, from your unique persona to their exciting adventures.
