row.name: Shapeless
row.detailed_description: In this short action game, you start off as a prisoner locked up in a jail cell. The game features various obstacles and challenges that players must overcome to progress. As you escape the prison, you encounter guards and other enemies that are determined to stop you from escaping. The game incorporates combat elements, allowing you to fight and defeat these enemies. You must be strategic and tactical in your approach, as you face stronger enemies as you progress through the level. The game also features a puzzle that you would have to solve to unlock the good ending. As you progress through the game, you encounter NPCs who may offer advice and guidance, and also provide clues to help you solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. The game is not easy and may require several attempts to beat. Overall, the game is a short action-packed adventure that tests players' combat, puzzle-solving, and strategic skills.
row.short_description: A short action game set in a medieval castle with NPCs and enemies appearing in the form of different shapes. You must escape imprisonment and find a way out of the castle.

row.name: Rabbi-T
row.detailed_description: You are Rabbi-T, the latest Rabbit Robot developed by Wilson Company, the leading toy company of the time. Your mission is to subdue the giant robot 'ACTO' that is going on a rampage in an underground incinerator. Get to the top of his head in a blink of an eye using your specialty, running. And hit his weakness, the red button. Incinerator will be full of obstacles, and ACTO will create a number of creative disruptions. Fortunately, you have a powerful punch that can blow them up. Keep an eye on the obstacles as they approach and punch them out. Destruction of the obstacle will give you higher speed. The faster you run, the faster ACTO falls. The number of electronic carrots you will receive will increase as well.
row.short_description: Save Wilson Toys Inc. from the villainous robot ACTO and be a hero. Rabbi-T is a running action game that pursues destruction and speed. Destroy obstacles to run faster. Reach the boss's weakness as fast as possible.

row.name: ToyLand
row.detailed_description: Help Hana, who has fallen into the world of abandoned toys, 'Toyland', return to the real world!! If you defend at the right timing of the enemy's attack, you can parry, and you can create a command attack by combining weak and heavy mouse attacks. Combine the attacks to defeat the toys and the boss King Crown that attack one, and listen to the story behind them!! Toyland is a 3D back view hack and slash game where you advance while defeating the waves of enemies. Feel the cool action feeling in Toy Land! Do you remember playing with your eldest son when you were little? If you remember playing with toys, where are the older boys now? Here is Toyland, a world of toys forgotten and abandoned by their owners! - This game supports operation through a gamepad.
row.short_description: Toyland is a world of abandoned and forgotten toys. Please help 'Hana' crash landing on this Toyland go back to the real world!!

row.name: Revenant
row.detailed_description: This is a Demo version. We're in process. Revenant is a 2D pixel-art style shooting game set in the near future. Enjoy the fun of the main character Beta sweeping away his enemies to get freedom! Different than typical 2D shooting games, We have a unique system called 'Precise Aim' The hit detection only occurs when the cursor is aiming enemy's hitbox. With this unique system, you can enjoy our energetic battle! Thanks! This is chungkang college of cultural industries graduation project. Sorry for a lot of bugs :( Contact us Team Leader - Hwanjin You hwanjin771@naver.com -Special Thanks- KOR->JPN - Masa Kei
row.short_description: Revenant is a pixel-art style shooting game set in the near future.

row.name: Ocean Man
row.detailed_description: This is a role-playing turn-based game. In the game, you will play a captain and lead your team to explore the ocean and find the treasure! You need to sail in the ocean, explore different islands, sometimes encounter sea monsters. You will find new partners, expand your team and adventure with them. Feature: Beautiful Ocean The real and fantasy sea, your ship sails on the sea, Different weather and day and night systems make you immersive. Ocean Adventure There are many different marine life in the sea, Including dolphins, turtles, sharks and more than 20 kinds of creatures, Some sea creatures will frighten and run away when they see you, There are also some sea creatures that will actively attack you, You can even capture them as partners, Make sea adventure more exciting and fun. Many Game Modes A variety of different game modes, such as island exploration, ocean battle, sea monster challenges, and more. Pet Systems The pet system is very special, each pet has different characteristics, Some are born geniuses, some are late bloomers, with Superman cards, It can be said that there are many ways to play, and there are many different genres. Global PVP The game contains the function of global PVP, Players can duel with players from all over the world, Further deepen the interaction between players.
row.short_description: This is a role-playing turn-based game. In the game, you will play a captain and lead your team to explore the ocean and find the treasure! You need to sail in the ocean, explore different islands, sometimes encounter sea monsters. You will find new partners, expand your team and adventure with them

row.name: 3 Days War
row.detailed_description: Background: In 2069, humanity discovered a high-energy density mineral, the Black Stone. Countries vied for control of this resource, leading to conflicts that culminated in a global war in 2085, known as the First Black Stone War. Five years after the war began, humanity developed the Core-Gear, a giant war machine powered by Black Stone. Its immense combat capabilities had an immediate impact on the war, and within a year, the world briefly returned to peace. The world split into three major factions: the Black Eagle Union representing democracy and freedom, the White Bear Front representing the people, and the neutral Suzaku Covenant in the East. However, true peace never arrived, and the crisis of war continues... Features: Innovative Real-time 4X Game A creative fusion of RTS and 4X core experience, with real-time battles and minimalistic operation, allowing players to focus more on development, strategy, and social interaction. Grid-based strategic rules Expansion, construction, development, and battles occur in real-time and intuitively in the 'grid'. A large battlefield composed of over 10,000 grids supports dozens of players to cooperate and compete. RougeLike elements in strategy building In the process of developing an empire, players will continuously have the opportunity to choose 'pondering cards'. After dozens of random three-choice selections, you will eventually build your own strategic card combination. Heroic mechas that determine the outcome of battles Dozens of distinct heroes drive Core-Gear to gallop across the battlefield. With the reasonable use of heroes' 'active strategic skills', one can dominate the war. Game modes: Adventure mode Follow the plot to become familiar with the basic game rules, and gradually deepen your understanding of the game's world view. Evacuation mode 16 players participate in a 3-day grand strategic confrontation. Find a teammate, become the commander and lead everyone to victory! Alliance mode 18 players are divided into three factions for a 5-day grand strategic confrontation. Instead of simply eliminating opponents, become a true strategist through cooperation and alliances! Camp Introduction White Bear Front Arms The design mainly highlights the characteristics of heavy industry and heavy machinery and uses heavy bomb weapons and electromagnetic weapons. For example, the K-47 Aviation Fortress: the only weapon in the game that can provide a powerful ground strike in the air, and it is very difficult to sink Black Hawk Combined Arms The design mainly highlights the characteristics of modern high-tech combat troops, and a large number of optical weapons are used.For example, Rhino Heavy Tank: is the toughest tank in the game, has an energy shield, and can withstand high damage in frontline combat Vermilion Phoenix Alliance Force. The design mainly emphasizes the combination of classical and technological elements, and the tech tree features an Eastern mystical style. Currently, still in the design and production stage... Discord: Tieba: Taptap:
row.short_description: 3 Days War is a unique multiplayer strategy war game. Integrating the mechanics of RTS+4X, it allows dozens of players to engage in a three-day real-time strategy competitionon. Commanders, use your skills, strategies, games and even deception to become the ultimate winner!

row.name: Yondu's Journey
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Yondu's Journey, an interactive movie where every decision you make can lead to life or death. Take on the role of Yondu The Fearless and face the challenges that await you in this exciting game. As you play through the game, you will be presented with a series of difficult decisions that will test your courage and quick thinking. Do you want to fight or flee? The choice is yours, but be prepared to act fast - you only have a few seconds to make each decision. Each decision you make will impact the outcome of the game, so choose wisely. Will you be the hero that saves the day, or will you succumb to the dangers that await you? The fate of Yondu The Fearless is in your hands. With stunning graphics and intense action, Yondu's Journey is a game that you won't want to miss. So gather your courage and get ready for an adventure that will test your skills and leave you on the edge of your seat. Are you ready to face the challenges of Yondu's Journey? The choice is yours.
row.short_description: Join legendary warrior Yondu in this interactive fmv adventure as he battles for survival in hostile territory. With his cunning, strength, and unwavering spirit, Yondu rises above adversity in this epic tale of survival and adventure. Get ready for an unforgettable journey with Yondu the Fearless!
row.notes: Beinhaltet Darstellungen intensiver Gewalt und Blut.

row.name: Tales of the Magic Ball: The Lost Sorcerer
row.detailed_description: You, the magic ball, have lost your sorcerer and in order not to perish you must find him again. For this reason, you start your journey. Initially, you'll find yourself in a magical, dreamy world that matches the ball. During your journey, however, your real adventure begins. Tales of the Magic Ball is a puzzle platformer where you'll experience a fantastic story during your adventure in a magical world. Use your magic to solve puzzles. Use magic to defeat your enemies. Interact with the inhabitants and get help. Face the challenges and try to survive. Let the world enchant you. - Play with a physically simulated ball and solve difficult bouncing passages . - Let the puzzles challenge you . - Use your magic to defeat your enemies and solve puzzles . - Fight your opponent and adjust your tactics . - Enjoy the story . - Explore hand-built levels . Wildmonkeygames is a small 1-man-team with a few freelancers who, besides their regular work, have dedicated themselves to game development with a lot of love and passion. Originally 'Tales of the Magic Ball' was planned as a fast skill game/roller ball, but in the course of development more and more a more modern kind of roller ball crystallized out, meanwhile it became an adventure platformer, in which you can experience a story. The whole thing is spiced with puzzle game elements and packed in a beautiful fantasy world. I hope you will enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed developing it.
row.short_description: Tales of the Magic Ball is a puzzle platformer where you'll experience an adventure in a fantasy world. Explore, puzzle, experience a story, fight and overcome obstacles. Solve the tasks given to you in an interesting and fun way.

row.name: School Booster
row.detailed_description: School booster is a 2D parenting simulation game. The gameplay is designed to be half roguelike, which requires players to build a baby and raise her up and end with a result of this baby's future. players only need a mouse to play, manage attribute tokens and buy certain items to help to boost the baby's study result. * School Booster was initially designed as an idle game that came with one objective, which is to play around with your attributes numbers and think of a strategy to get as higher numbers as possible. Players are required only use a mouse cursor to play the game. * In the School Booster, you will play the role of being a parent raising your girl to an adult (18). her grow-up journey will come from heaven, baby, kid, teenager, these four sages. And each stage has slightly different playing mechanics. Tutorials are included at the start of each level to assist in understanding a few mechanics at each stage.
row.short_description: In the School Booster, you will play the role of being a parent raising your girl to an adult (18). her grow-up journey will come from heaven, baby, kid, teenager, these four sages. And each stage has slightly different playing mechanics.

row.name: Russian Psychiatric Pastoral: Prologue
row.detailed_description: This is an introductory demonstration version of the game. This episode is meant to test the game mechanics, after which the players can decide whether they are interested in buying the whole game. In the prologue, the player will be given the opportunity to try out one interactive fighting sequence and put on a role of psychiatrist to interview a patient who suffers from schizotypal disorder. The Russian Psychiatric Pastoral - despondency, cruelty, lawlessness, and mental disorders. What else do you need to describe our reality? Immerse yourself in a multi-genre interactive movie, combining a psychiatrist simulator, a noir detective and unique fighting sequences built from a variety of video fragments. Take on the role of a professional psychiatrist, confront various psychiatric diagnoses, and investigate missing people. At the center of the plot is you, a protégé of the authorities from Moscow. You find yourself in a small provincial town, which is famous for housing one of the largest psychiatric hospitals in the whole country: it holds the most dangerous criminals. In the depressing atmosphere of the Russian countryside you will meet a variety of crippled-by-fate locals, each of them adapted their own way to survive in this merciless reality. As you interact with them, you will find more and more details about the disappearance of people whose fate nobody cares about anymore. You will also analyze their mental disorders, from schizophrenia to bipolar disorder. Key features: - Varied dialogues, where you need to skillfully select proper words for every patient. As a reward, you learn more about their diagnoses; - Collecting and matching information about missing people piece by piece; - Explore a variety of mental diagnoses using educational charts and speadsheets; - Exciting interactive fights, where your survival depends on your reaction; - Unique aesthetics and atmosphere of the Russian countryside.
row.short_description: Introductory demonstration version. An interactive movie that combines a psychiatrist simulator, a detective story and unique fight sequences. Take on the role of a psychiatrist, encounter various psychiatric diagnoses, and investigate disappearances of various people.

row.name: Duel Revolution
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Duel Revolution, the ultimate monster battling MMO! In this game, you will explore the island of Bitacora filled with all kinds of monsters, known as Evo. Catch and train these creatures to become the strongest Evo duelist and engage in intense real-time battles against other players. Key features of Duel Revolution: Catch and Train: 50 unique Evo, each with its own set of abilities. Every Evo in Duel Revolution is unique. It's up to you to figure out the best strategy for using each Evo in battle. Keep an eye out as we're constantly adding new Evo with upcoming updates! Intense Duels: Challenge other players in real-time duels or face off against wild Evo and other duelists as you explore the island. Engaged Community: Join a community of enthusiastic Evo duelists, share tips and strategies, and make new friends. Skilltree-based Leveling System: With 12 meaningful levels, you can tailor the skills and strengths of your Evo to match your gameplay style. Customize Your Character: Choose from various customization options to make your character stand out and showcase your style in the game. Regular Updates and New Content: We are committed to delivering regular updates and fresh content to keep the game exciting. Gameplay Preview: Encounter wild Evo on the way. Go to the Duel Stop to heal your Evo, buy items or duel against others. The Deep Cave is filled with challenging co-op puzzles, strong Evo and various secrets. Watch the duel of others by a tap on the bouncing box over their head. Enjoy surfing on the beach with your friends. Each level let's you choose a new attack or ability. Customize your character to your preferences. Welcome new players at the station in Lapin City. Play the FREE open beta now!
row.short_description: Duel Revolution: the ultimate monster taming MMORPG. Train powerful Evo creatures for dynamic battles against other players. Customize with unique skill tree system. Play with friends in multiplayer. Available on Windows, Mac, Android, and iOS.

row.name: PlanetSprite
row.detailed_description: PlanetSprite is an online MMO where you create your own character, customize, interact, trade and play with other fellow players! Please NOTE that the game is not fully released and there are so many content that are being released part by part. In the world of PlanetSprite here are some of the features that are already available in early access: -Player customization with your own inventory and equipment! -Player owned house -Chat and interact with players, objects, and non-player characters -Minigames And many more features to come!!
row.short_description: PlanetSprite is an online MMO where you create your own character, customize, interact, trade and play with other fellow players!

row.name: Vemari Worlds
row.detailed_description: Vemari Worlds is the place to gather your online community into a 3D space. The whole point of Vemari is to meet new people that are like you. And they can be from anywhere in the world. Whether it be an online forum or a livestreaming community, your community world exists here. If you have nowhere to be, then you belong here.
row.short_description: Vemari Worlds is your place for fostering fulfilling interactions and meeting people in your online community.

row.name: The Bean Trials
row.detailed_description: The Bean Trials is a unique multiplayer mini game versus where you take on the role of a “bean” and compete against other beans to see who is the best! Compete in over 20 unique mini games and customize yourself with over 2,000,000 possible combinations! Using coins earned from doing challenges or winning games you can purchase new looks and items to make your bean just like what you dreamed of! Join the lively world with upbeat music and in-game text and voice chat! The possibilities of what you and your bean can do are endless! Feel stuck? Try practice mode to work on your skills to destroy the competition! Want to play with friends? Hop into a private match and get up to 15 other beans to compete against! Think you’re the greatest? Try to top the Leaderboards to show true superiority! So why wait any longer? Get on in, customize yourself to your dream bean, and show everyone what it means to dominate the competition!
row.short_description: In The Bean Trials, join your friends in competing to see who is the best! Play in over 20 different minigames all while trying to top the Leaderboards! Talk in text or voice chat with other beans while you complete challenges, win to earn coins, and unlock over 100 unique items for your bean!

row.name: The Very Brief and Meaningless Adventure of Hero Man
row.detailed_description: Hero Man, Hero Man, only doing what a Hero Man can. Whether he can actually save the world and bring home the glory is another question entirely. And so we enter this retro-inspired RPG world where YOU determine the outcome! Your choices will determine the fate of Hero Man and the world at large. Help Hero Man save the world of Somewhere from the sinister Lord Doldrum ... or do nothing of the sort if you so please! Will you help bring peace to the world or break the story line in some horrible way? The answer is up to you! In this satirical take on an old-school JRPG, you'll guide Hero Man on a journey that is very brief and meaningless indeed, and find up to 18 fun, heroic, and grisly endings that take 2-20 minutes each! Unlock different endings depending on your moral actions, party composition, character levels, and more. Look forward to the following new features, as well! Original Graphics and Music Assets. 18 Endings that can be found in almost any order, depending on your actions. Keep track of every ending you've found on one save file. What will happen when you find them all? Enlist the aid of Marionette characters to help Hero Man on his adventure! Recruit helpers such as the Solider, Mage, Cleric and... that's it. Quality of Life features that gradually unlock as you find more endings, such as the ability to turn off random encounters or restart your current run.
row.short_description: Help Hero Man save the world of Somewhere from a terrible evil ... or do nothing of the sort if you so please in this small, satirical RPG!

row.name: Super Cakeboy
row.detailed_description: Once again take the role of Cakeboy in this sequel to Khimera: Destroy all Monster Girls ' 'game-within-a-game'. Run, jump, punch and use the variety of pastry-themed weapons at your disposal to blast through 9 action-packed stages. Face off against Cakeboy's eternal rival, the enigmatic Dark Cake and send him packing! Items no chef should leave at home: Pick up far-away items with the Croissant Boomerang , set traps with the exploding Cupcake Bomb , perform trick-shots with the bouncing Super Donut , or just punch them in the face! The choice is yours! Short and Sweet: This snack-sized game's nine levels can be completed in about 20 minutes but hidden collectable ingredients, achievements and other secrets give you extra goals for subsequent play-throughs.
row.short_description: When a group of unsanitary chefs threaten all that is good and just in Cakeland, it's up to Cakeboy to serve up punishment. Fight your foes with pastry-themed items in this bite-sized 2D platforming adventure!

row.name: Kore VR
row.detailed_description: Available with Meta Quest Kore VR offers a unique experience that transports you to the heart of a traditional Korean Hanok village. From there, you can explore a futuristic and interactive orb that teaches you the sounds of each Korean alphabet, as well as a shooting arena where you'll use a laser blaster to shoot letters and gather ingredients for delicious Korean dishes in just three minutes. But beware - if you don't get the letters right, you'll be 'roasted' in Korean! With Kore VR, you can immerse yourself in the Korean language and culture in a fun and engaging way. The serene landscape of the Hanok village creates the perfect backdrop for learning the characters and pronunciation of Hangeul. And as you explore the village and its surroundings, you'll gain a deeper understanding and appreciation for Korean culture. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced learner, Kore VR is an innovative and effective way to build a strong foundation in the Korean language. Through its combination of language learning and cultural immersion, Kore VR can enhance your overall language skills and provide you with a truly unforgettable experience.
row.short_description: Want to learn the Korean alphabet on the Meta Quest? Hop into Kore VR where you get to learn the alphabet in an interactive orb and shoot away letters in an interactive arena to win ingredients for delicious Korean dishes. Get those letters right or you will get roasted in Korean!

row.name: GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN is a casual shooting game where 8 animal toys battle it out in action-packed matches! The 'Furr-sting Showdown' to steal toy parts and survive begins now. Join the fluffiest battle in the world and become the last animal toy standing! GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN begin early access in the 5th of November 2024, It is planned to be officially released in Q4 2025 to support mobile and Nintendo Switch cross-platforms. Key Features With a streamlined team battle royale format, anyone can jump in and enjoy the fun! You don’t have to bully other toys to feel the thrill of growth. Our unique yet simple graphics shine even on low-spec PCs and consoles, giving you smooth gameplay no matter your setup. Challenge players from around the globe in team battles and show off your skills to become the ultimate toy champion! Hunt down Fearsome Monsters! Team up with your crew to take down monsters, survive, gain experience, and level up. Work together to divide roles, plan your optimal farming and leveling routes, and execute your strategy flawlessly. Explore the Map and Grow Stronger! Send out your trusty chick drone to expand your territory and uncover hidden spaces. Hunt down monsters guarding these areas and claim valuable items that give you a tactical edge in battle. Be the Last Team Standing! As you explore, you’ll encounter rival toy teams. When that happens, don’t hesitate—use every weapon and artifact you’ve got to take them down!Even if you fall, as long as one of your teammates is still alive, there’s hope for revival. Take down the other three teams, and victory is yours! Join the battlefield of the GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN, see what we're building alongside our community, and help shape the future of the game!
row.short_description: Jump into fast-paced team battle royale action, where unique armial toys clash for survival! Explore, strategize, and dominate the battlefield to become the ultimate champion! Join the fluffiest battle in the world now and become the last animal toy standing!

row.name: Farm Empire
row.detailed_description: Farm Empire is an idle / clicker game where you will be making crazy amounts of money from farming. You start the game with just one chicken, but soon you can expand into tomatoes, tractors, factories and many other assets. Hire managers to do the clicking, upgrade your assets and reach your milestones. You can also expand your empire to other countries like Australia, Madagascar, Denmark and even Antarctica. Farm Empire was originally released in 2016, but has been in active development ever since. Content updates are out every other month, ensuring there will always be ways to expand your empire. Thousands of milestones to play towards. Seven empires to unlock and complete: USA, China, Australia, Denmark, Norway, Madagascar and Antarctica (yes, you can farm there!) Each empire has 36 cool, interesting or funny assets to unlock and upgrade: How about an Australian banjo frog, an arctic sea pig or a Chinese dragon? Discover the best combination of assets for each empire to optimize your earnings - the path you take is important, but you can always restart to try another. Speed up your earnings with the help of friendly workers gained from restarting your empire - restart often, to keep your worker force growing. 15 golden eggs for free each day, and even more if you create your own golden egg farms. Your game data is stored on the mighty Farm Empire server - log on from any device, and your empire will be at where your last left it.
row.short_description: Would you like to be the world's richest farmer? In Farm Empire, you'll start your own farm from scratch, but with the right strategy, you'll soon have an entire empire.

row.name: Zefyr: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Add the full game to your wishlist About the Game Free version of 'Zefyr: A Thief's Melody'. In a colorful archipelago, play as a young thief studying at the Guild. Investigate kidnappings, steer clear of roaming pirates or fight them. Sail the ocean on a cute turtle and climb on every island. Cure sick animals and reveal the truth. 'Zefyr: Prologue' contains the first chapter of 'Zefyr: a Thief's Melody'. It's a tribute to old adventure games like 'Beyond Good & Evil' and 'Zelda Windwaker'; it features exploration, dialogs, fights, puzzles, collectibles and huge Boss battles, all wrapped in a colorful world with a contemplative and feel-good atmosphere. Run, jump, and climb wherever you want, travel between islands on a turtle, and discover a colorful open world! Be it pirates, guards, robots or other thieves, you'll face many challenges during your missions. You are free to play sneakily or go straight to confrontation. But choose carefully! During your journey, you'll find ancient Guardians. Some will block your path, others will be well hidden. Will you be able to bring back peace to these giant creatures? Look for sick animals and cure them with fruits! Collect flowers, discover lost paintings... Many side quests await you in this feel-good world. Will you find them all? Freely explore a colorful open world. Learn various skills: climbing, stealth, fighting, bow, bombs, grapple and much more! Confront or avoid pirates, guards and robots. Cure sick animals all over the world. Collect gemstones, paintings and flowers. Defy giant Guardians during epic battles. Discover cute and funny characters. Save the world! Er no, I mean 'be a true hero!' Er no, I mean 'help your sister.' Well, you have to start somewhere, kid... Oh, yeah! And ride a cute turtle! But I guess you already got that from the picture. Hi there! I'm Mathias and I've been creating video games since I was a child. I love coding, playing music and drawing. So what's better than creating a video game to do all of this at the same time? I do everything alone because I love every part of it and I'm a curious guy who likes to know how it works! I hope you'll like it :) If you want to support me or learn more, don't hesitate to check out my website, where you can find all the links to social media, my dev blog and other stuff. Thank you so much!
row.short_description: Free version of 'Zefyr: A Thief's Melody'. In a colorful archipelago, play as a young thief studying at the Guild. Investigate kidnappings, steer clear of roaming pirates or fight them. Sail the ocean on a cute turtle and climb on every island. Cure sick animals and reveal the truth.

row.name: Midnight at the Disco
row.detailed_description: Midnight at the Disco is a fast-paced, top-down roguelike twin-stick shooter where you must survive a dance floor overrun by grotesque alien eyeball monsters. Annihilate massive hordes of the interdimensional invaders. Collect vinyl records to level up an insanely deep skill tree, unlocking game-changing perks and abilities. Break open chests for powerful items and gear up for each frantic, bite-sized run. Over 20 unique enemy types, each with distinctive attack patterns, will relentlessly pursue you. Thankfully, you can create wildly different builds by mixing and matching a huge array of upgrades, power-ups, and random modifiers - ensuring no two runs play out the same. Oh, and watch your step...there's poop. Features: Huge build variety for limitless replayability Short roguelike runs perfect for pick-up-and-play Online leaderboards Intense and fast paced gameplay Massive enemy hordes with unique, challenging behaviors
row.short_description: Annihilate grotesque eyeball monsters in this top-down, roguelike, bullet purgatory, twin-stick shooter. Survive a full day raging on the dance floor by blasting baddies using unique builds combos on each frantic run to nab a spot on the online leaderboards.

row.name: 天羽Online
row.detailed_description: 「天羽Online」是一款由 開發的 2D 奇幻 MMORPG 遊戲，免費開玩。 遊戲最大亮點是其深入的寵物系統，玩家可以捕捉遊戲中的幾乎所有怪物，將其培養為個人化的戰鬥夥伴。遊戲的升級速度較快，在創建角色後一小時左右即可完成新手任務，並裝備精良，快速上手。 ＊遊戲特色＊ 寵物系統：捕抓怪物為寵物，並培養牠們成長，幫助您徵戰沙場。 角色裝扮系統：自由 DIY 角色外觀，隨心所欲設計髮型、頭飾、衣服、背飾和尾巴。 婚姻系統：與伴侶共同探險，體驗浪漫的冒險旅程。 師徒系統：拜師學藝，與玩家師父結盟，享受升級帶來的額外獎勵。 武器製作：製作專屬超級武器，並鑲嵌寶石提升屬性。 ＊五大職業＊ 武士：力量與體質為主的近戰職業，以超高生命值和強大的物理攻擊力著稱。 劍客：擅長遠程物理攻擊，使用長劍以劍氣傷敵，具備力量與耐力的優勢。 天師：智力型的強力輸出職業，生命值較低，但法術威力龐大，能造成毀滅性打擊。 術士：智力與精神兼具的職業，擅長使用詛咒法術削弱敵人，依賴寵物戰鬥。 祭師：精神為主的輔助職業，能為隊友提供增益效果並進行治療。 「天羽Online」以獨特的系統和豐富的玩法為玩家打造一個充滿奇幻色彩的冒險世界。
row.short_description: 「天羽Online」是一款 2D 奇幻 MMORPG 遊戲，免費開玩。 寵物養成：捕抓怪物為寵物，並培養牠們成長，助您徵戰沙場。 自由換裝：自由 DIY 角色外觀，隨心所欲設計髮型、頭飾、衣服、背飾和尾巴。

row.name: Kingdom Heroes M
row.detailed_description: 《三國群英傳M》以忠實還原《三國群英傳Online》為目標，掌握原始美術風格、職業、打寶吃王、武魂、國戰等核心玩法，讓老玩家能隨時隨地重懷過往三國旅程。 【遊戲特色】 ■ 延續三國經典喚回你的熱血感動 超過百張地圖還原線上遊戲世界，知名歷史武魂再現三國群英，經典橫向捲軸玩法，體驗的不只是最初的回憶，還有熱血與感動。 ■ 暢玩三群一手掌握 跨世代操作，打破電腦設備和環境等因素，實現全民皆兵的目標。 ■ 千軍萬馬盡在掌中 養成專屬自己的士兵護衛，透過不同的兵種配置應付不同的戰況，玩法變化多元，超越遊戲的特別體驗 ■ 全區指揮熱血參戰 「指揮系統」全區掌控，不需要語音和打字溝通即可讓軍團長快速掌握戰局，決戰千里之外。 ■ 自動掛機線上競標 超高自由度的競標系統，體現自給自足的自由經濟；最完善的掛機功能，享受最佳「打寶」樂趣。 ■ 百煉戰甲神兵鍛造 解放裝備限制，簡化強化需求，只要有心，每件裝備都會成為神之兵器。 ■ 武魂重現萬人國戰 化身三國名將，小卒也能成英雄；實現萬人國戰，打造國戰最佳體驗。 ■ 三國名將盡在指間 化身三國名將，與同伴一起征戰沙場，親臨古戰場，感受名場面 ※ 依遊戲軟體分級管理辦法分類為輔15級。遊戲情節涉及暴力、菸酒、性(輕微裸露)。 ※ 您須年滿15歲始得使用本遊戲。 ※ 請注意遊戲時間，避免沉迷於遊戲，可能影響身心健康。 ※ 本遊戲為免費使用，遊戲內另提供購買虛擬遊戲幣、物品等付費服務。 ※ 勿用他人代儲以免觸法。 ©USERJOY Technology Co., Ltd. All Rights Reserved.
row.short_description: 歷經20年的感動，給你最原汁原味的《三國群英傳M》

row.name: Dynopunk: Welcome to Synth-City
row.detailed_description: Dynopunk is an ironic adventure set in a cyberpunk world where dinosaurkind has replaced humanity. Run a repair shop, fix gadgets, find a personalized approach to every customer by offering them beverages and having deep heart-to-heart conversations. All to sort out your private life and chase your ultimate dream! The free version of Dynopunk: Welcome to Synth-City offers a chance to live a full 7-day week as a resident of a futuristic cyber city, but there is a catch — you will now have to deal with having much shorter arms! Imagine that a meteor had never struck the Earth, so the dinosaurs did not go extinct but continued to evolve. Now, millions of years later, they inhabit high-tech megalopolises. One such dino is Chris, a repair shop owner who dreams of building a Time Machine to travel to the past and find true love, because he is the last remaining T-Rex on the planet! Meet Cyberpunk Dinosaurs Enjoy pixel art that pays homage to 1990s retro games. Meet a cast of memorable characters from an alternative future where predatory, carnivorous dinosaurs have come to rule the world. Relax to the sound of a Lo-fi soundtrack as you progress through the story and make plot-altering decisions. Fix Gadgets Elicit relevant information from your clients to find the source of the problem and fix their gadgets. Perform your work neatly and carefully — your income depends on it. Chat up the Customers Strike up heart-to-heart conversations with customers and offer them a beverage to their liking. A glass of cool fizz or a cup of hot coffee increases your chances of getting tips. Follow the Dream You play as the last surviving T-Rex on Earth, trying to build a Time Machine and travel to the past to find true love. Will this dream ever come true? Features: Seven in-game days of running your own workshop and repairing equipment to learn the tricks of the trade. Disassemble and replace parts by carving out the required chips. You can even play a prank on your customers if you wish... or have an ulterior motive. Just be ready to face the consequences! Great opportunity to exchange pleasantries with a quirky assistant — a talking printer that enjoys teasing Chris about his little arms and likes to give questionable business advice. Drink-serving simulator, which affects not only the customers' mood but also the size of your tip. Original, 1980s-inspired Lo-fi soundtrack! Pour yourself a cup of hot tea, then sit back, relax, and get immersed in the story. A variety of interesting characters that will pay a visit to your repair shop. Each of them comes with unique traits, dreams, and a personal story that can be influenced by player choice. Dialogues full of irony, jokes, references, and Easter eggs to cheer you up! Pixelated graphics inspired by 1990s retro gaming.
row.short_description: An ironic adventure with cyberpunk aesthetics set in a world where humans have been replaced by dinosaurs. Become a top-notch repair shop mechanic: fix gadgets, have heart-to-heart talks, and offer drinks to your customers — everything to fulfill your ultimate dream.

row.name: The Druid
row.detailed_description: STORY Long ago, the Celts and their culture ruled much of the land. But various natural disasters and invasions by other peoples decimated their population and brought their culture to the brink of extinction. Before this, the Celtic gods were devastated but accepted the fate that had been imposed on them. All except the evil Morrigan, who decided to corrupt the much-revered land of the Celts to prevent that fate. The Druid is a roguelike 2D platform game where we play as a druid, created from Dagda, whose mission is to stop Morrigan and free the land of its corruption. KEY FEATURES A modular generation system to offer a great experience in different levels of the game. Up to 54 available upgrades to combine with our character and obtain new abilities. The game will feature three playable areas that will be full of enemies, from the simplest to bosses that will make a difference in combat. The Celtic god Dagda asks for help to defeat the evil Morrigan and stop the corruption she is spreading through the world. Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.
row.short_description: We embody the spirit of The Dagda, king of the Celtic gods, with the objective of liberating his territory from the corruption of the goddess Morrigan in a 2D roguelike platformer full of intensity.

row.name: Not Anyone's Business But My Own
row.detailed_description: Navigate a local princess through the pages of a hand-crafted fairy tale and help her solve the mystery of a golden ring in this narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game with multiple endings. Yup, it’s a short game. It will only take you about 15 minutes to complete it. Well, maybe 30 minutes if you are a real achievement hunter. Every action (and inaction) has its consequences. Every decision can lead to catastrophic results. Like whether you decide to dig up a skeleton in a peaceful forest clearing or let it rest. Or cross a rickety bridge over a deep ravine. Or… well, you’ll discover the rest yourself. This game has five endings. Sad, epic, controversial… Some are happier than others. Will you dare to unlock all of them? Like any self-respecting fairy tale, this story has a charismatic narrator, an adventurous hero, and a couple of mysterious strangers. All of them have voices - literally and metaphorically. This game is crafted in full 2D. Like back in the day, when the grass was greener and the third dimension was a subject of legends and myths. Just come on in and play. There is no microtransactions, NFTs, paywalls, or other greedy creatures. Enjoy the journey!
row.short_description: Navigate a local princess through the pages of a hand-crafted fairy tale and help her solve the mystery of a golden ring in this narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game with multiple endings.

row.name: SeaFeud
row.detailed_description: SeaFeud is an underwater arcade racing game made by students at SMU Guildhall. Players race on fish and dynamically change their “vehicle” stats by colliding and swapping with other fish on the course. While in typical racing games, players select their vehicle or customize their vehicle prior to starting the game, SeaFeud switches things up by defaulting everyone to a basic fish at the beginning of the race. Throughout the race, the player can swap to other fish, giving them a statistical edge. While on these fish, their stamina will run down before swapping back, encouraging the player to try different playstyles. Four Funky Fish Types There are four types of fish in the game, each with unique abilities and access to unique items. The default fish (Mahi Mahi) has basic turning, speed, and acceleration stats and access to the entire item pool. The Electric Eel has better speed than the default fish, better turning, and the ability to boost forward while leaving a wall of electricity behind. As a defensive fish, the eel can pick up and shoot forward bombs to impede those in front of them. The Swordfish, though having the worst acceleration, has one of the highest speeds. Riding this fish will give the players the passive ability to attack players that are within range and boost quickly ahead. As an offensive fish, swordfish can pick up and drop a whirlpool item that lingers on the course and slows anyone who runs into it. The Pufferfish gives the players a defensive ability by expanding and pushing any opposition away. It also is immune to any attacks while using this ability. Pufferfish pick up a boost item and use it to launch ahead of their enemies. Three Sunken Courses Navigate through three beautiful underwater courses: Express-wave, Sea-nic Drive, and Night Fishtrict. These courses display a post-apocalyptic city that has been engulfed by rising sea levels. They feature decayed skyscrapers covered with algae and are populated with colorful sea life sprawling the seafloor. Eight Zany Characters There are 8 different characters that the player can choose from, all distinct with their own unique features and names, from Bruno the scuba shark to Kat the feline diver. Made by Students at SMU Guildhall This game was made by a team of graduate student developers at SMU Guildhall over a 12-week production as part of their TGP2 course. Given the short development time, the team's emphasis is on quality over quantity. About SMU Guildhall Recognized as one of the best graduate schools for game design, SMU Guildhall trains the next generation of game developers. With a faculty of industry veterans and specializations in all four cornerstones of game development, we have been commended for our multi-disciplinary Team Game Production curriculum, which yields award-winning student games.
row.short_description: SeaFeud is an underwater arcade racing game where players ride on a variety of fast fish. Swap fish mid-race to dynamically change your abilities, items, and stats. With eight different characters and three different courses to select from, players can have endless fun racing the seas.
