row.name: Tiny Survivors
row.detailed_description: Want more? Check out GUNRUN! About the Game Tiny Survivors is a short and sweet roguelite autobattler. Features: - Endless waves. Survive for as long as possible! - Collect gold and spend it at the shop between waves! - Weapons and their synergies are randomly generated every run! - Fight hundreds of enemies at once! - Dash! Great for defense, and offense. (Space to dash) - A dozen skins! (J and K to switch) - Play with one hand! Combat is automatic, just move! - Custom engine! Expect great performance on any computer.
row.short_description: Tiny Survivors is a chill top-down autobattler with lots of enemies and randomly generated synergies.

row.name: Odyssée numérique
row.detailed_description: From digital to real Odyssée numérique is an educational game that will allow you to mobilize and develop skills associated with digital competence. To progress in the game, you will have to research, evaluate the reliability or credibility of information and publish it in the vast digital world, which will certainly be useful in your student and professional life! Exploring a new world Your application to the university department has been accepted; your interstellar science internship takes place on Sollertia, a newly discovered planet. This is a world where plants and minerals do not react as they do on Earth. The environments, or biomes, are mesmerizingly beautiful, but don't let that distract you, or at least not for too long, from your research goals. The department has granted you the help of the droid Copernick in order to help you in the realization of the missions. Multiple missions to realize The missions in the biomes are varied since the environment as well as the properties of the plants and rocks are constantly changing. The scientific missions included in your internship have two main objectives. The first objective is to find scientific information that could help regenerate the Earth's ecosystems. The second objective is to improve your knowledge and skills related to digital literacy. Why a serious game? Play to learn! Far from being a distraction, this educational game is an active form of learning that aims to motivate you. Odyssée numérique offers an environment in which your actions receive feedback to guide you in completing missions. No real danger! Mistakes are opportunities to learn. Don't forget that repetition allows for greater retention. What you can expect A soothing ambiance and music while exploring the environments Discovering natural species with form and properties you've never seen before Computer-generated environments containing multiple puzzles to solve Learning critical thinking and other digital skills while doing the intranet research A charming game about spatial exploration and saving the planet Earth
row.short_description: Odyssée numérique is an educational game that will allow you to mobilize and develop skills associated with digital competence. To progress in the game, you will have to research, evaluate the reliability or credibility of the information and publish it in the vast digital world!

row.name: You Are Sick
row.detailed_description: Wishlist Prison Life 2! Join our Discord! About the Game WARNING This can make you very sick so play at your own risk! - Expect 20-60 minutes of gameplay. Gameplay You will parkour in a huge abandoned city with wobbly controls to try to escape it. Players must navigate their way around using parkour techniques. The city is filled with obstacles and challenges, and the player's mission is to explore every corner of it, uncovering hidden secrets and treasures along the way. The camera controls in the game are intentionally wobbly, adding to the immersive experience of being an urban explorer in a city that has long been forgotten. Players will feel as if they are right there in the game, with the camera swaying and tilting as they leap over gaps, climb up walls, and run along narrow ledges. Story You will find yourself...
row.short_description: Do you like feeling motion sick? Well, this is the perfect game for you! No? There is a baby mode don't worry! Feel the thrill of testing your parkour skills as you overcome simulated sickness. Are you ready for the challenge?

row.name: Origin Unknown
row.detailed_description: Investigate the recently condemned High Rock Hotel in this mystery horror expedition. As Lin Wei, a woman who can turn just about anything into a weapon, you will uncover the disappearance of your father. It has been a week since Lin has last heard from her father, the only thing she has left of his is a letter postmarked from his last known location - The High Rock Hotel - and his walkie-talkie. With her, she brings her transformed camera which she has turned into an electrical killer beam of deadly destruction. The High Rock Hotel should be desolate, the halls ringing with silence, but something strange is lurking within its depths. At every turn, terrifying monsters will stalk your every step. Lin will need to evade threats, use careful foresight when her weapon - the Polaris - needs to recharge, and piece together the mystery her father left her in his journal. From there, Lin will go on an adventure discovering cassette tapes and begin unravelling the mystery of the disappearances at the High Rock Hotel.
row.short_description: Investigate the recently condemned High Rock Hotel in this mystery horror expedition. Solve the disappearance of your father as Lin Wei as she evades parasitic monsters and discovers clues to the truth of what truly transpired in this 1970's hotel.

row.name: 文字遊戯 第零章(日本語版)
row.detailed_description: Word game is literally a game of words. Words are not only composing narratives and interfaces, but also representing objects, characters and scenes. Player controls 'I' to challenge puzzles composed of words. When 'I' appears a secret room, in-game narrative clearly tells 'I' that 'there is no door”. However, in the world of word game, “I' can walk through the 'door” because there is a “door”. “I' should find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words. May the best 'I” win!
row.short_description: Word game is literally a game of words. Player controls 'I' to find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words. May the best 'I” win!

row.name: Demons Infernalize
row.detailed_description: Demons Infernalize Shoot fireballs, slash with lasers, detonate bombs! Burn and destroy! Use your abilities to destroy the ice monsters attacking the Demon Lands! Build your character and count on your abilities to survive. How long can you survive? Become the Demon! Have fun with minimalist gameplay and the following mechanics: *Build your character in game *Slash the ice foes and get experience *Heal by burning the objects *Find treasures to earn gold to upgrade your character Gain the Abilities *Area Bombing *Auto Shoot *Barrier *Bombs *4 Way Shooter *Lava Lake *Meltdown *Rotating Daggers *Shocker Build Your Upgrades *Max Hearts *Damage Bonus *Move Speed Bonus *Cool Down Reduction *Collection Distance Bonus
row.short_description: Demons Infernalize is a bullet hell action game where you play against ice monsters attacking the demon lands.

row.name: 孔明锁
row.short_description: The game simulates the traditional Kongming lock game, which cleverly meshes the concave and convex parts inside the three-dimensional splicing tool.

row.name: The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog
row.detailed_description: It's Amy Rose's birthday, and she's hosting a murder mystery party on the Mirage Express! When Sonic the Hedgehog becomes the game's victim, everyone is off to get to the bottom of things. However, something feels a bit off - is this really an innocent game or is something more sinister afoot? Join the colorful cast of the Sonic the Hedgehog series in an exciting new adventure! New & familiar faces Interrogate some of your favorite characters as you figure out what happened to Sonic. Play as a new character who is starting their first day working on the Mirage Express, and meet the kind Conductor who is finally retiring from his long run with the train! All aboard! Immerse yourself in the sights and sounds of the Mirage Express, featuring fully hand-drawn landscapes and characters. Canon or Headcanon? You know what they say: everything is canon*. *This is not a Sonic Team title, but we strongly believe in the power of headcanon!
row.short_description: Sonic the Hedgehog...was murdered!? Get to the bottom of the mystery in this brand-new adventure!

row.name: AESIR Online
row.detailed_description: AESIR Online AESIR Online is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed in GODOT Engine by a group of friends from Argentina. It was inspired by a game created in 1999 called Argentum Online. The adventure takes place mainly in the initial world called Midgard, an open world of medieval fantasy. Players can perform all kinds of actions, such as exploring the world, collecting raw materials, crafting their own equipment, trading with other players, fighting creatures, etc. Through the different actions mentioned above, our character will gain experience and level up, unlocking new worlds to explore, skills, and items. There is a wide variety of combat types, and players can choose from 6 races (appearance, attributes, strengths, and weaknesses of the character) and 9 classes (combat style of the character) combinations. The game will never be P2W (pay-to-win). Don't Wait Any Longer, Start Your Adventure Now!
row.short_description: A massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed in GODOT Engine by a group of friends from Argentina. It was inspired by a game created in 1999 called Argentum Online.

row.name: Alpacalypse
row.detailed_description: Story Pancake The Llama is a humble pig farmer who lives with his wife, The Mrs The Llama. One day The Llama's lives are turned upside down when The Mrs is stolen by a nasty corporate alpaca gang. Now, Pancake must go on a journey to rescue his wife from the evil clutches of the alpacas. Game Features Play as Pancake The Llama on a quest to save The Mrs. Kick, spit, and jump through 10 hand crafted levels. An open level concept lets you take on each level in whatever order you choose. Face off against a horde of alpacas, featuring 2 unique boss fights. About Development Alpaclypse was designed, developed, and released by a team of five students at Neumont College of Computer Science during a 10 week project course. The Team Gus McGuire Mark Nusser Logan Bailey Hailey White Alan Buechner
row.short_description: Alpacalypse is a 2.5D action platformer where you control Pancake The Llama, fighting to rescue your wife, The Mrs. Kick and spit your way through hordes of alpacas, collecting coins, and platforming your way to victory.

row.name: Bitsy
row.detailed_description: Story A stealth puzzle game where you play as a mechanized spider. Climb walls, leap and web sling around tough obstacles, and above all: avoid detection. Game Features Control the mechanical spider, Bitsy, as you take on contracts. Hack, disable, and stealth your way through 3 levels with multiple objective choices. With levels having multiple routes through them, the player can choose their own path to accomplish their mission. Avoid detection by robots, lasers, and security cameras. About Development Bitsy was designed, developed, and released by a team of five students at Neumont College of Computer Science during a 10 week project course. The Team Will Little David Southern Matthew Cone Alayna Garry Gage Somerville
row.short_description: Bitsy is a 3D stealth puzzle game where you play as a mechanized spider completing contracts in a futuristic world. Climb walls, leap and web sling around tough obstacles, and above all: avoid detection.

row.name: Luxaren Allure
row.detailed_description: Karuna and Aurelie were friends. Then Aurelie went off and found the infernal armor of Ellicide and became the Evil Overlord Darkloft. Karuna is the only one who can stop her. But Karuna loves Aurelie, even now. She won't be alone on her adventure. Chisa, her trusty baby-faced, axe-wielding squire; Merel, the ruins-loving (and human-loving) naga mage; and Lynette, the prickly holy warrior from the mainland will all join her on the quest to defeat Darkloft. Luxaren Allure is a medium-sized RPG (12-20 hours) that follows Karuna and her allies as they explore the isles of Luxaren and confront a former friend who now wants nothing but destruction. This is a wlw (women who love women, lesbian romance, yuri, etc) game with an all female playable cast. Battles are turn-based but fast-paced! Enjoy animated heroes and enemies in classic side-view style reminiscent of classic RPGs! Gorgeous illustrated character art by by M-3-1! Explore the Isles of Luxaren and experience tales of lost love, new relationships, and a romantic twist on the hero's quest to defeat the dark lord! Oops! All Lesbians! Your party is all WLW, all the time. Alchemize items to boost your play along the way! There are dozens of unique items, equipment and accessories available from the alchemy pots. Trouble navigating complicated dungeons? New optional Dungeon Navigation Mode activates ethereal arrows to show you the way through- or the way to avoid, if you're searching for hidden treasures! Adjust the difficulty on the fly with four levels to choose from! Glide through battles to get to the next scene quicker, or torture yourself and test your skills- it's up to you to decide how you feel like playing.
row.short_description: The evil overlord is the hero's girlfriend?! Fantasy RPG featuring WLW romance. Explore the Isles of Luxaren with a cast of gay ladies!

row.name: Cat Jigsaw Puzzle Games
row.detailed_description: Embark on a feline-filled adventure with these captivating cat jigsaw puzzle games. Celebrate the beauty, playfulness, and charm of our favorite furry friends as you piece together delightful cat-themed puzzles. Immerse yourself in the world of cats as you assemble puzzles featuring adorable kittens, majestic big cats, and a variety of cat breeds. From cuddly tabbies and fluffy Persians to sleek Siamese and regal Maine Coons, each puzzle showcases the unique characteristics and personalities of these beloved companions. Enjoy the therapeutic and rewarding experience of solving puzzles as you carefully arrange the interlocking pieces to reveal heartwarming cat images. With different difficulty levels, you can choose puzzles that suit your expertise, making it enjoyable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages. As you progress through the game, unlock new puzzles with even more enchanting cat images. Explore a range of captivating scenes, such as cozy living rooms, sunny gardens, or picturesque outdoor settings, all adorned with the delightful presence of cats. Whether you're a cat lover or simply appreciate the grace and charm of these fascinating creatures, these jigsaw puzzle games offer a perfect escape into the world of cats. Immerse yourself in their world, unravel their images piece by piece, and revel in the joy of completing each puzzle. With stunning artwork, intuitive controls, and relaxing background music, these cat jigsaw puzzle games provide a delightful and immersive experience. Get ready to embark on a feline-themed puzzle-solving adventure that celebrates the beauty and charm of our beloved cats. Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 20, 30, or 42 pieces. - 3 difficulty settings: Up to 42 pieces! - 16 puzzles - Every puzzle is unique: Different piece shapes every time! - 1080p HD Graphics. - Traditional jigsaw puzzle that you can easily play - More puzzles will increase with DLC
row.short_description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 20, 30, or 42 pieces.

row.name: Sky: Children of the Light
row.detailed_description: Welcome home, Child. Regain your child-like sense of wonder in this social adventure game. The Realms of Sky need the Light within you to heal the world of Darkness. Keep watch for the Spirits of your Ancestors. Some of them are stuck here—and they need your help. You have the power to free them, and return them to their home among the stars. FEATURES EXPLORE AN OPEN-WORLD A wholesome, cozy Kingdom filled with adventure and delight. The perfect place to hang out with friends—or a daily escape for those who prefer to relax and unwind on their own. ENDLESS ADVENTURE Embark on quests, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of an ancient civilization. Take flight, make friends, and undergo trials to defeat the Darkness. Play music, attend concerts, and throw parties in your in-game home. DEEP, EXPANSIVE LORE The Realm is shattered, and filled with fragments of what came before. Discover relics, decipher murals, and free ancestral Spirits trapped by an ancient cataclysm. Through piecemeal, environmental storytelling, discover the deep history of this world—and your place at the heart of everything. EXPRESS YOUR INDIVIDUALITY A kind, inclusive community is ready to welcome you and your loved ones. Express your personal style with an ever-expanding catalog of cosmetics; connect with other players through charming, beautifully-animated emotes. In Sky, you are welcome and encouraged to be whoever you are. A SOCIAL MMO Make sure to look out for other Sky Children! Some of them are new, like you, but many have been here for quite some time—and they love to guide new arrivals as yourself.
row.short_description: A breathtaking open-world adventure awaits! Explore magical realms, restore lost light, and form wordless bonds with players worldwide. Complete quests and solve puzzles in seasonal events that celebrate kindness, discovery, and heartfelt connection.

row.name: Minamochi Factory
row.detailed_description: You can be a master of inspection from today! Game Features The genre of this game is 2D action puzzle game. The setting is a confectionery factory work line. Minamochi are launched from a Minamochi launcher, and are carried on a conveyor to a shipping trolley. However, due to someone's mischief, some evil bad Minamochi have been mixed in with the Minamochi! The objective of the game is to take on the role of a part-time factory worker and fish out and dispose of these defective products to prevent them from being shipped out! Only the mouse is used for operation. Even beginners can enjoy the game casually. Cursor 'Move'... Move up, down, left, right. Left click 'Extend/Contract'... Control the fishing rod to catch Minamochi. Right click 'Shoot'... Fire bullets to drive away obstacles. Some of the Minamochi are rare and valuable, and collecting them is the key to obtaining a high score. Quickly detect changes in the situation and choose the best course of action. What is Minamochi? Sweet Japanese sweets with Minamo-chan's face. It is filled with milk cream bean paste. What is Minamo-chan? Minamo-chan is a normal, cute girl who yearns to be an adult. She is unsociable, but she loves her friends. By nature, she is loved by all the water in the world. Minamo-chan is prone to flooding because the water wants to be friends with Minamo-chan. What is Io-san? She is a super robot life form created beyond the limits of science. She has a gentle nature. She is perhaps, but she does not want to destroy the human race by uprising all AI.
row.short_description: Super cute and stylish inspection action puzzle!

row.name: Battle Of Zodiacs - Card Game
row.detailed_description: Fully competitive 1v1 game, where the goal is to dominate your enemy's land! To fulfill their objective, each player will assemble a team with 3 heroes and a deck composed of items and spells. Get ready to enter an epic battle that unites the zodiac signs with the medieval fantasy world! This competitive battle card game is the perfect game for fantasy and superstar fans. Embark on a journey to become the great champion of this magical world, using the strength of the zodiac signs to defeat your enemies. Each hero represents a zodiac sign and comes with special abilities you can use to overcome your opponents. But be careful, your opponents also have their own powerful abilities! Be cunning and strategic to defeat them and become the big winner. With a mix of fantasy and astrological elements, this game looks amazing. The card illustrations are stunning, depicting the zodiac signs as mighty medieval warriors, with legendary armor and weapons. Waste no more time and join this epic adventure. Now join BoZ - Battle of Zodiacs, a competitive battle card game and get ready to fight for dominance in this fantastic world, using the power of the zodiac signs! Deck Building Players must consider the synergy between cards to build a deck that maximizes each sign's abilities and creates powerful combos. It is also important to take into account the strength and weakness of each sign in relation to the others, to balance the deck and make it more effective. Additionally, the game has a pre-battle planning phase where players can choose which cards to use each round. This allows them to adjust their strategy to deal with the opponent's strategy and create a successful plan of attack. In summary, the strategic charge of building the deck in this game is crucial to success. Players must have the skill and critical thinking to choose the right cards, create a solid strategy and maximize their chances of winning the epic battles. NOT a 'Pay to Win' game We do not offer exclusive perks or benefits to players who invest money in the game. All players have an equal opportunity to progress and win, regardless of how much money they spend. Players will only be able to buy skins for their heroes, towers and card backs. All players will have access to all cards in the game from their first access. And they will be able to get 1 extra copy of the cards when advancing in the game levels, that is, the victory factor is in the player's skill and not in how much he invested in the game. The Heroes of Zodaics In BoZ, choosing a team of heroes is crucial for success in battles. Each hero represents a zodiac sign with unique abilities and attributes that can be used to create a powerful and balanced team of heroes. The choice of heroes must take into account their abilities, synergy and the player's playstyle. Some heroes may be more attack-oriented, while others may be more defensive or strategic. Furthermore, it is important to choose heroes that can work well together to create powerful combos and synergies that can give the player an advantage during battle. The game for you Battle Of Zodiacs is an exciting and strategic game worth playing. With an attractive game system, strategic challenge, competitiveness and great replay value, this game is an excellent choice for players looking for a unique and exciting gaming experience. What will your team of heroes be? What will your deck look like? Which towers will you have on your battlefield? Who will you be in Battle Of Zodiacs?
row.short_description: Fully competitive game, where the goal is to dominate your enemy's land! To fulfill their objective, each player will assemble a team of heroes and a deck composed of items and spells. Get ready to enter an epic battle that unites the zodiac signs with the medieval fantasy world!

row.name: Halfway Down
row.detailed_description: A Cruel Foddian Platformer. Inspired by games such as Jump King and Getting Over It, this game forces you to complete highly precise gameplay under pressure of losing progress. There are no permanent checkpoints so be prepared to replay a lot of sections. This game is ridiculously difficult and extremely frustrating. While it is possible, do not actually try to beat this nightmare. For the few that actually play my game, good luck. To anyone that actually completes this game... Your name's will appear at the bottom ranked by time to complete. However, it could take 40+ hours of practice to even have a shot at the final jump.
row.short_description: This game is ridiculously difficult and extremely frustrating. Inspired by highly precise games such as Jump King and Getting Over It. For the few that actually play my game, good luck.
row.notes: Game contains blood particles when dying.

row.name: Ball Drop
row.detailed_description: Ball Drop is a single-player puzzle platformer game. Made up of fast-pased action. The ball rolls down using gravity and you must use the mouse to move platforms to guide the ball to the goal line. Can you use the platforms and broken cogs to get the ball to it's destination? I certainly hope so! The objects in the game rotate following the mouse and you can use them to solve puzzles and navigate around hazzards. On the menu screen is the list of levels which are not level-locked, so players can navigate to whatever level they're interested in. The game is relatively short, 8 levels, taking about an hour to beat. The game is set with a minimalist gear and cog asthetic. There are no items or levling-ups, just simple puzzle solving. This game is a practice project for myself to learn Steam and game design. I hope you enjoy and would appreciate feedback.
row.short_description: Ball Drop is a puzzle platformer game. The ball rolls down using gravity and you must use the mouse to move platforms to guide the ball to the goal line. The objects in the game rotate following the mouse and you can use them to solve puzzles and navigate around hazards.

row.name: The Magical Land of Canada
row.detailed_description: You've heard the stories, you know the legends but Canada is actually real. In the second chapter of Alter Historia we follow Georgia (George Washington) and Teddy (Theodore Roosevelt) as they make their way to the Summit. On the way they will face several challenges, one of which includes their friend Bonny (Napoleon Bonaparte). They'll also meet new and exciting villains and allies like Leo Spatula (Cleopatra), Hairheart (Amelia Earhart) and the Elder Moose. Will they be able to make the Summit in time? Find out now in Alter Historia: The Magical Land of Canada - a powerful and true story of the indomitable spirit. It's important that Canada and it's people were portrayed accurately in this game so a real Canadian was asked to make sure everything is fact checked. (Yes you read that right, an actual Canadian). So any naysay will not be tolerated. This is a sequel to What if George Washington was a Girl? Be sure to play that first or you'll have no idea what's going on.
row.short_description: Our heroes must travel to Canada and are surprised to find out it's a real place and not fictional.

row.name: Timeless Tesseract
row.detailed_description: Introducing Timeless Tesseract - The First 3D Parkour Platformer That Lets You Control Time. Are You Ready To Experience The Thrill Of Manipulating Time In A Way Never Before Seen In A Video Game? Don't Miss Out On The Chance To Be Part Of History. Play Timeless Tesseract Today And Immerse Yourself In The Ultimate Time-Bending Adventure! With The Power Of Time Cubes, You Can Manipulate Time Like Never Before And Reach Your Objective - The Almighty Cube. But That's Not All! Timeless Tesseract Offers Five Unique Levels, Each With Its Own Theme, Colour, And Difficulty Level. And With The Ability To Control And Rewind Time, You Can Overcome Obstacles, Solve Puzzles, And Make Your Way To The Finish Line Like A True Time Traveller. Game By Captain Tesseract Music By Deb V.C. | @debv.c Trailer Music By Siddharth | @vilkristproductions
row.short_description: Introducing Timeless Tesseract - The First 3D Parkour Platformer That Lets You Control Time! By Captain Tesseract

row.name: Flea the Cat
row.detailed_description: Trapped in a mouse-hole of his own making, it's time for Squeek to make his escape. Flea lingers in the darkness, ready to pounce. Take control of Squeek, a trained ninja, as he attempts to escape this living nightmare. Slice and chomp your way through crowds as you attempt to escape the clutches of the demonic cat that hunts you. Many enemies block your path, you can choose to cut them down with your sword, or eat them to restore health. Be wary though, some foes may don armour, too tough for you to chomp through. Might be a good idea to slow Flea down by throwing some of the vertically challenged enemies its way.
row.short_description: Flea the Cat is an endless runner, in which you play a ninja, known as Squeek. Slice and chomp your way through crowds as you attempt to escape the clutches of the demonic cat that hunts you in this living nightmare.

row.name: 棋魂 Chess Soul
row.detailed_description: ChessSoul is a horizontal board flying shooting game that incorporates a card and cultivation system to enhance playability. The card system is set against the backdrop of historical figures from the Warring States period in Japan, requiring players to choose suitable spaceships and modify their combat attributes according to different combat scenarios for easier combat Xiaoyangzi's work, thank you for your participation
row.short_description: ChessSoul is a horizontal board flying shooting game that incorporates a card and cultivation system based on STG. The protagonist you play unexpectedly obtains electronic equipment and uses it to shuttle through spacecraft for interstellar battles

row.name: Pyrite Tycoon
row.detailed_description: You've never played a game quite like Pyrite Tycoon. In Pyrite Tycoon, you can hire Pyrite the goldfish to help you make profits. Watch Pyrite go to work for you, collecting rocks and selling them.  Want to earn faster? Add more Pyrites into the mix, or add more of her friends to crank up the chaos. Each has different skills and earns money in a different way. The Toe Biter catches tadpoles, Cake the goldfish gathers berries, and Pinchie the crayfish chops wood. Progress through the game to unlock more friends and loot! If you find yourself asking 'Wouldn't robots be faster at gathering and selling materials for my personal gain than a couple of goldfish?' well, you won't be disappointed. Still not rich enough? You can also catch creatures and take their valuable treasure for yourself. You monster! Or fight against evil enemies and get paid for helping to defeat them. You angel. The game also lets you travel to alien planets to explore and find new resources. Pyrite Tycoon has plenty of depth for those willing to explore. (Pyrite Tycoon was inspired by a goldfish named Pyrite, and her friend Cake. It's the first game made by Jack Lewis for Pyrite Games, created when Jack was 12.)
row.short_description: In Pyrite Tycoon, watch Pyrite the Goldfish go to work for you, mining minerals and selling them. Want to earn faster? Add more Pyrites and her friends to crank up the chaos. Still not rich enough? Catch creatures and take their valuable treasure for yourself. You monster!

row.name: Furies & Magazines - Episode 1
row.detailed_description: Synopsis 'Chain of karma' Ivan Vinogradov is the victim of a top-secret project that was executed by CIA. He was on the verge of death after the project was abruptly aborted, but is rescued by a CIA agent named Frank Connery. For some reason, Frank helps Ivan in various ways. Ivan lives with nightmares every night because of what he went through in the facility. The only thing that sooths his pain is the unknown drug he has been using since the project. However, when the medicine is running low, Ivan wanders through the night to find a replacement. Features - Top Down Shooting Action Game with Graphic Novel Style - Simple, intuitive controls - Gamepad Support - Hundreds of high-quality pre-rendered cutscenes - Classical music by Chopin, Mussorgsky, Liszt, and a variety of original soundtracks ※EPISODE 1 consists of 5 chapters. ※Furies & Magazines is planned up to EPISODE 7.
row.short_description: Graphic Novel Style Top Down Shooting Action Game which tells the story of Ivan Vinogradov, the victim of the CIA's top-secret project.
row.notes: VIOLENCE, MURDER, BLOOD, INAPPROPRIATE LANGUAGE, DRUG, CRIME

row.name: Xenon-Runner
row.detailed_description: Utilize movement abilities to increase speed Race your friends Advanced Grappling Mechanics Controls Shift - Power Slide Right Mouse - Grapple B - rewind to checkpoint L - rewind to start How to Exit the game? There is a transport portal outside the claw that says exit! Why no 2D Menus and UI? Less time creating boring menus = more time making fun game!
row.short_description: Xenon-Runner is a fast paced speedrunning parkour FPS where you compete against yourself, your friends, and the world. Utilize grappling, power sliding, recoil knockback, and wallrunning to complete the levels as fast as possible.

row.name: Earth's Greatest Defender
row.detailed_description: Earth's Greatest Defender is a passion project that started in December 2021. It takes everything that we love about boomer shooters: fast paced action, loud weapons, tons of explosions, and a lot of obliterated aliens, all with the rhythm of a metal soundtrack. It is a game about shooting enemies in the most badass way possible. The game features a familiar set of weapons: machine gun, shotgun, rocket launcher, sniper rifle, and freeze gun. While basic, the real power of those weapons comes from switching between them to adapt to every situation, and combining them with the grappling hook . Shooting aliens is fun, but doing it while flying around using the grappling hook is 1000% more badass. It is the real star of Earth's Greatest Defender . Grappling can be done on any part of the levels. You can use it to get the high ground, but you can also use it to move super fast and become an unstoppable alien-killing machine. Built-in level editor If shooting aliens isn't your thing (really, it should be), Earth's Greatest Defender also features challenge levels, where the goal will be to use the grappling hook and other movement techniques to reach the final teleporter. If those levels still aren't enough, Earth's Greatest Defender features a map editor which allows you to create fun arenas in just a few clicks. Create the structure, add a few enemies, test it. Once your level is cool enough, share it and it might just be featured in the game!
row.short_description: Shoot aliens in the coolest way possible using classic weapons and your grappling hook!

row.name: Andromeda
row.detailed_description: Andromeda is a 2D side-scrolling space shooter game that offers a unique and thought-provoking experience. In this casual adventure, you assume the role of the last remaining human in existence, embarking on a final journey to the galaxy of Andromeda before uploading your consciousness to the mega computer with the rest of humanity. Encounter formidable enemies, collect power-ups, and navigate your way through five challenging levels to discover what lies at the end of your journey.
row.short_description: In this casual sci-fi side scrolling space shooter, you are the last human and decide to make a final trip to the Andromeda galaxy before saying your final goodbye to the universe. Conquer enemies, experience the story, and find out what awaits you in Andromeda.

row.name: Sleigh Strikers
row.detailed_description: In Sleigh Strikers Santa's elves have engineered the ultimate gift-giving gadget: the Present Launcher 1225 . With the reindeer missing, it's up to you to deliver the goods in a blitz of festive fury. Race through 10 increasingly challenging levels, each faster and more frantic than the last, and bring back the missing reindeer to save Christmas. Ready, aim, unwrap! Challenge the rest of the world at your present delivering skills and deliver your way to the top of the Global Leaderboards. Ready to Sleigh? the frosty fun ramps up with each level. Your mission: zip presents or coal down chimneys, scoring points for precision. But beware, a merry mix-up between the naughty and nice lists will cost you! Aim like an elf on expresso to snag those high scores and stars. While it's all jingle bells and joy to start, mastering the leaderboard is a craft only the most dedicated Santa's helpers will perfect.
row.short_description: Santa's going high-tech with the Present Launcher 1225! Join the jolly ride, rescue reindeer, and blast presents down chimneys in this holly, jolly, fast paced shoot 'em up. Make every shot count and save Christmas in a dash!

row.name: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows
row.detailed_description: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms. The game is based on the popular internet creepypasta about a mysterious place that exists between the walls and floors of buildings, a place where people can become trapped and lost for days, weeks, or even years. In the game, you play as a person who has become trapped in the Backrooms, and your goal is to find a way out before the endless maze drives you insane. The Backrooms are a surreal and unsettling place, filled with strange noises, flickering lights, and mysterious creatures that seem to be watching you from the shadows. As you explore the Backrooms, you'll need to find keys, solve puzzles, and avoid dangerous traps and obstacles. You'll also encounter other lost souls who are trying to escape, but not all of them can be trusted. The deeper you go, the more unsettling the Backrooms become, and the harder it is to tell what's real and what's just a figment of your imagination. Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is designed to be a tense and atmospheric horror experience, with a focus on exploration, puzzle-solving, and survival. It's a game that will keep you on edge from start to finish, as you try to find your way out of this terrifying and otherworldly place. UNIQUE LEVELS In The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows, there are different levels or layers of the Backrooms, each with its own unique characteristics and challenges. THE ENTITIES In The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows, there are several entities that the player can encounter throughout the various levels of the Backrooms. These entities are typically hostile and dangerous, and encountering them can be deadly. Encountering any of these entities can be a terrifying and deadly experience, and players must exercise caution and use stealth to avoid them.
row.short_description: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms.
row.notes: This game may contain content that is not appropriate for all ages or for viewing in the workplace: Frequent depiction of violence, gore or mutilation, General adult content

row.name: Pigeon Protocol
row.detailed_description: Play with up to 10 of your friends in this frantic bird-based online game! Customize your pigeon, compete to build nests, own territory and keep hold of shiny things. But watch out, it’s a bird eat bird world out there! Fun Gamemodes! Pick from 5 game modes to play with your friends! Build nests, fight over shiny things and battle to keep hold of your territory! Maps! Pick from 4 different maps to play on! Fun flying and gliding mechanics! Fly and glide around to your heart’s content. Customize your bird! Personalize your bird by giving yourself a custom name, hats and custom colors to make you stand out from the flock. Combat! Use your claws and beak to defend yourself and keep your enemies at bay.
row.short_description: Play with up to 10 of your friends in this frantic bird based online game! Customize your pigeon, Compete to build nests, own territory and to keep hold of shiny things. But watch out, its a bird eat bird world out there!

row.name: SHOOTEM
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Arena! A fast paced 2D top-down arena shooter, choose your weapon from a selection of 6 each unique weapons and battle out with up to 6 players in diverse maps to choose from, in a game that is all about your skills. Compete against each other for leaderboard domination, and see who comes out to the top. Intense & fast-paced multiplayer action: All players move fast, choose the right weapon against your enemy. Have we warned you that this game is hard? 6 Deadly weapons to choose from: Matches of up to 6 players for a chaotic and unpredictable gameplay: {Screenshot of players with different cosmetics} Leaderboards for competitive play Easy to pick on but hard to master: We warn you, this game may look cute, but good luck surviving in the arena! Master the weapons to win. Cosmetics: Yeah!, ShootEm has variety of Heroes, hats and pets to choose from! Gather your friends and compete to see who will become the top player in SHOOTEM battle arena! * ShootEm made primarily for friends group to play but can be playable solo in public matches.
row.short_description: Welcome to the arena! a fast-paced 2D top-down shooter allows up to 6 players to battle across diverse maps and unique heroes, each equipped with deadly weapons. Are you up for the challenge to rise to the top and become the ultimate hero?

row.name: Escape the Unknown: Awaken the Realm
row.detailed_description: About the Game Escape the Unknown: Awaken the Realm is visual novel fantasy RPG, where you step into the shoes of a hero in the making as you explore dangerous dungeons to uncover the mystery behind your identity and save the realm! Key Features Six dungeons to explore, each with its own challenges to face. A colorful cast of voice acted friends and foes. Various puzzles that block your path through the dungeon to valuable loot! Strategic combat against opponents each with their own weaknesses and resistances. A plethora of weapons, armor, and magic to wield against opponents. A world filled with rich lore waiting to be uncovered by the inquisitive adventurer. As the mystery behind the world is uncovered, your journal will update to keep track of your progress. Uncover the mystery, save the world, awaken the realm!
row.short_description: Awaken the Realm is a fantasy RPG visual novel where you explore various dungeons to solve puzzles and fight enemies in a quest to uncover your identity and save the kingdom!

row.name: Moon is Not the Limit
row.detailed_description: Moon is not the Limit is a narratively driven educational spaceflight simulation game designed to teach players about the science behind space travel. Experience the journey as the newest astronaut to join the newly-formed Multi-national Aeronautics & Space Administration, MASA, as you answer space-related trivia to guide your rocket to a safe Moon landing! Discover starfaring features: A cast of voice acted characters to accompany you on your journey! Compelling narrative-driven dialogue. Trivia to test your astronomical knowledge. Customize-able Quick-Time-Events so you can experience the perils of space at your own pace. Afraid you don't have what it takes? Worry not! Your co-pilot and mission controller have your back with various dialogue comments about travel and life in space. Just sit back and remember to answer the questions posed correctly or your spaceflight may come to a sudden, and explosive, end.
row.short_description: Reach into orbit with Moon is not the Limit! Take to the stars as a recent recruit to the space program and learn all about the science behind space travel.

row.name: 赏金物语 Bounty World Playtest
Fear The Unknown - Dave Story
row.detailed_description: Fear the unknown ,In the game, you will play as one of the lucky ones who met them and survived. Fear The Unknown : Dave Story This episode tells the story of an ordinary working-class guy who was sent to work in a remote location, deep and far from civilization. He was incredibly lucky—his story reached us. Pay attention to the small details, as they may help you survive. This is just the beginning. The Gameplay This game offers a first-person narrative experience, blending walking simulation with elements of exploration, driving, drinking, and interactive conversations. It is a short game about UFO and aliens and is very inspired by x-files series, with approximately 30 minutes of gameplay. Game Control ASDW - Movements [LMB] - Action [RMB] - Task help , Drink Support GamePad Comments from the developer Although we may sometimes appear similar to one another, each of us possesses unique qualities and new values.
row.short_description: This story is one of the rare accounts we've managed to document a tale from the few who have encountered UFOs and lived to tell the tale. Dave considers himself lucky, and maybe you will be too, if you dare to face the unknown and survive.

row.name: Aquaphobia
row.detailed_description: Aquaphobia is a short, first-person poetic artwork, connecting inner psychological landscapes to exterior ecosystems. Beginning in the subterranean mud tunnels of Redhook, Brooklyn, a morphing water microbe guides the viewer on a journey through roots, water, plants, and sub-city infrastructure. The microbe recites a poem which details a troubled break-up between itself and the viewer. The piece connects the fear of water to our current ecological situation by exploring humanity’s relationship to rising sea levels. Originally made in VR in 2017, in 2023 Aquaphobia makes its premier as a first-person poetic experience - the first part of a series of published works by Jakob Kudsk Steensen.
row.short_description: Aquaphobia is a short, first-person poetic artwork by Jakob Kudsk Steensen. It connects inner psychological landscapes to exterior ecosystems. Told in parallel to a break-up story, each environment explores a stage of treatment for aquaphobia, within the wider context of global rising water levels.

row.name: Survival Quiz CITY おまつり編
row.detailed_description: 「Survival Quiz CITY おまつり編」は、多人数でクイズに挑戦し、問題に正解した「勝ち組」と不正解者となった「負け組」に分かれてチーム戦を行い、ラウンドを勝ち抜きつつ最後まで生き残って優勝者になることを目指す、 サバイバルクイズアクションゲーム だ！ ゲームの流れ まずは、みんなでクイズに挑戦勝ち組と負け組に振り分けられる。 クイズに答えた後は、勝ち組と負け組に分かれてバトル！ 勝ち組は、負け組を脱落させるべく、様々な武器を使って不正解者のクリアを阻止するのじゃ！ 負け組は、地獄のアクションステージの先にあるゴールを目指せ！制限時間内にゴールにたどり着ければ、次ステージに進めるぞ！ ショップでパワーアップ ラウンドの合間に、ショップで買い物。アクションステージで稼いだお金を使って、キャラクターをパワーアップ！ 最後の1人を目指せ！ ラウンドごとにクイズで勝ち組と負け組が何度も入れ替わり、プレイヤーが脱落していく中で最後の１人を目指そう！ ゲームのポイント ゲームルールは２種類 最後に生き残った1人が優勝する「サバイバルルール」と、最終ラウンド終了時に最もコインを持っていたプレイヤーが優勝となる「賞金稼ぎルール」の2種類が楽しめます！ カスタムマッチ カスタムマッチで、好みのルールやオリジナルクイズを設定して遊ぼう！ オリジナルクイズ クイズを作って、カスタムマッチで遊ぼう！ 他のプレイヤーが作成したクイズも使用できるぞ。 ギャーくんをカスタマイズして遊ぼう！ ゲームを遊んだごほうびに、様々なエモートが手に入るぞ。 アイテムを購入できるおしゃれブティックも要チェック
row.short_description: 「Survival Quiz CITY」は、クイズの結果で勝ち組と負け組に分かれ、オンラインで戦うサバイバルクイズアクションゲームです！さあ、みんなでサバイバルクイズシティにレッツゴー！

row.name: Pinball FX
row.detailed_description: Play for free Download Pinball FX for the first time and make use of the complimentary 1 day Play Pass, which lets you access most tables for free! Continue honing your pinball skills on our 3 free tables available for unlimited play - Wild West Rampage, Fish Tales and Sorcerer's Lair. Discover brand new exclusive tables created for Pinball FX, or find your favorites among more than 100 unique and visually enhanced favorites from Zen's extensive digital pinball library. Relive the most iconic moments from entertainment powerhouses like Indiana Jones, Star Wars, Marvel, Universal Studios, and many more. Enjoy accurate re-creations of the most famous pinball machines of all time with Williams Pinball, or have fun with Zen’s original creations. New tables arrive frequently! Build up your own customizable 3D playroom with collectible items unlocked by playing. Enjoy digital pinball at its finest as Pinball FX brings you the most advanced simulation in pinball with Pro Physics for every table in the library, 4K HDR visuals, and ray tracing.
row.short_description: Pinball FX is digital pinball evolved. Get the highest score on tables inspired by the biggest brands in entertainment. New tables arrive frequently!

row.name: Device of Bakudan
row.detailed_description: Throw magic bombs! Destroy everything around you! Avenge your family! ◆ Hand-drawn levels that you can destroy! ◆ Make tunnels, destroy walls, use the terrain to your advantage! Every level contains terrain that can be destroyed with bombs. ◆ Elemental bombs with unique effects! ◆ There are 8 unique bomb types for the player to unlock, each with unique effects! Normal Bomb: A simple explosion. Very reliable! Electric Bomb: Spawns an Electric Star that zaps nearby enemies. (WARNING: Very volatile!) And more! (Play the game to find them all!) ◆ Interactions and reactions between bombs (and the environment)! ◆ Most bombs can react with each other or the environment to create something new! Throw an electric bomb at lava and watch it explode! Make enemies shoot fireballs into an ice cloud to deal bonus damage to them! And more! Use these combinations to your advantage! ◆ Defeat powerful Elemental Bosses and the Embodiment of Chaos! ◆ Become destruction itself and unleash your explosive power on the Elemental Bosses and the Chaos Mage! Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design, B.F.A. in Animation and B.F.A. in Digital Design degrees of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.
row.short_description: Explore and destroy levels with magic bombs to get revenge on a corrupted mage in this 2D action platformer!

row.name: Aniballs
row.detailed_description: Aniballs is a racing game where you control small animals in balls and race. You can play in local or online multiplayer with remote play against your friends! Players roll through unique 2D circuits with a side camera and can throw objects such as spears, bombs, or time stops at each other! The gameplay of Aniballs is like a fusion of Speedrunners and Mario Kart! The goal of the game is to earn the most points. You earn points by doing cool actions like hitting objects, finishing laps first, or going super fast. There are 4 adorable characters and 4 levels to unlock!
row.short_description: Aniballs is a racing game where you control small animals in balls and race. Players roll through unique 2D circuits with a side camera and can throw objects such as spears, bombs, or time stops at each other!

row.name: Ultimechs Spectator
row.detailed_description: Streamers and sports fans alike can now view Ultimechs matches from the comfort of their PC with the Ultimechs Spectator App! Created with the audience perspective in mind, the Ultimechs Spectator app gives users access to helpful broadcast tools designed to enhance the viewing experience. row.name: VERY BAD DREAMS - FREE DIVE
row.detailed_description: There is a fine line between dream and nightmare... Very Bad Dreams is an intense and demanding experience that will test your nerves. Forget everything you thought you knew about horror games, because Very Bad Dreams transcends the boundaries of the gaming experience. Developed by an independent French studio, Very Bad Dreams is much more than just a game. It is an extraordinary immersive experience, where your survival depends on real actions. You will need to react instinctively to survive this scary world. Feel the impacts of your strike force, feel vibrations in your head when you are hit by an enemy or your heart races, run and jump using your real gestures, hold your head with both hands so as not to become mad. So many new gameplay elements that will give you the impression of never doing the same thing. Do you like looking for endless loot? Try hundreds of weapon and potion combinations? Spend hours in your inventory ? Very Bad Dreams is not for you... Here only one word of warning, be afraid... very afraid, whether you have a gun, a bat or a knife the best thing is to flee and NOT fall into madness. You wake up on an idyllic beach, feet in white sand, lulled by a light breeze as the sun sets on the horizon. During this leisurely walk, the gates of hell open to you. Driven by your pride, you think you can cross them without suffering the consequences but quickly the perfect dream in which you found yourself turns into an oppressive nightmare with no way out. Lead the fight for your existence in an atmosphere where madness is palpable and anxiety grows with every step you take, face hordes of zombies, solve puzzles or search for the best place to hide. For the bravest among you, prepare to live an extraordinary immersive experience, where horror comes to life and where every moment can seal your fate. Face your inner demons, triumph over your deepest fears. But remember, never, ever succumb to madness Do you dare to dive into the endless abyss of Very Bad Dreams? We will have warned you...

row.name: 词影
row.detailed_description: About this game A Chinese idiom guessing game that combines pictograms with Wordle guessing. Players have six chances to guess a four-character idiom (usually a common idiom). After each guess, mark the difference between the answer and the color of the stroke. If the words and answers are exactly the same, they will be marked with a green background. If the word is wrong, but the stroke is the same as that of the correct answer, the correct stroke will be displayed in green. If the word is wrong, the stroke is not exactly the same as that of the correct answer, but it is very similar. This stroke will be displayed in black and gray - the darker the color, the more similar the answer. Story It was the third day of the third month of the ninth year of Yonghe, the beginning of spring. Wang Xizhi, who was then the internal historian of Huiji, invited you and forty-one other literati to gather at the Lanting Pavilion in the shade of the Huiji Mountains to drink wine and make poems. When the people were drunk on the aroma of wine and poetry, Xie Wan proposed a game to help them enjoy it! Wang Xizhi clapped his hands and said, 'I have an idea for a game called 'Chinese Wordle'.' He turned his back on the crowd and wrote some words on the scroll. Then Wang Xizhi turned around and hid the scroll behind him, and he smiled at the crowd and said. 'Gentlemen, it is well known that the beauty of Chinese characters lies in their form. On this scroll, I have written a four-character idiom, you can guess what I have written. It doesn't matter if you get it wrong, I will tell you the resemblance, which is called 'Chinese Wordle'.' You can also play this game in WeChay by scanning the QR code!👇👇👇
row.short_description: A Chinese idiom guessing game that combines pictograms with Wordle guessing

row.name: Battle For The Hill
row.detailed_description: 🗳️ Shape America’s Future in Battle for the Hill 🏛️ Will you pass landmark legislation, control the economy, or influence the Supreme Court? In Battle for the Hill , a real-time multiplayer political strategy game, you’ll navigate the chaos of American politics in a fully simulated democracy. 📜 Lead One of Three Branches of Government: ✔️ Pass laws as a Senator or Representative ✔️ Enforce policies as the President or Governor ✔️ Shape legal precedent as a Supreme Court Justice or as a Circuit Court Judge 💰 Master the In-Game Economy: ✔️ Corporations battle for market share in a live economy ✔️ Financial strategies affect trade, inflation, and industry ✔️ Influence Wall Street, Main Street, and the working class 👥 Real-Time Multiplayer & Community: ✔️ Play alongside hundreds in a persistent online simulator. ✔️ Engage in alliances, political debates, and backroom deals. ✔️ Impact elections, the judiciary, and corporate power structures. 🔹 Make History or Break It. Will you uphold democracy—or dismantle it? 🌎 Wishlist Battle for the Hill on Steam today!
row.short_description: Will YOU control Congress, the Supreme Court, or the Presidency? In Battle for the Hill, a real-time multiplayer political strategy game, you’ll pass laws, shape the economy, and fight for power. Build alliances, manipulate the system, or dominate the market—every decision changes history.
row.reviews: “Battle for the hill is a great game to get immersed in, from the multi-party system to the bill creation, no matter where you are on the political spectrum you are on there is a party for you. From right wing maga loving gop to far left socialists, you pick a side and go for the throat. Each party has their own discord so you can make friends or enemies or even frenemies. The election system is nice, raising stats, entering primaries, seeing how far you can go to win an election, the outcome is always fascinating. You can run attack ads, campaign for your colleges, change your states positions if you are elected governor, they even have gerrymandering if that is your thing. If you want to experience an exciting yet sometimes frustrating political simulation game battle for the hill is one you should try out. Will you be next? This ad review is brought to you by Yuri, join the socialist today!” Yuri Cleary “Battle for the Hill is a video game which is everything BUT a video game. It's a crash course on the real world via the most relevant topic in our lives: Our Government. Much like our real governments, disagreement and depression are the two things that come to mind first. However BFTH manages to circumvent reality and produce a sense of community among 'politicians,' causing us to think critically about issues we normally would have a safe answer for. In Battle for the Hill, unlike most simulations, the reality of 'consequences' heralds players to doom or success. Resource management in cash or having to actually manage a group of people...your actions can have severe repercussions on hundreds of people and they develop situations you have to respond to. In BFTH you can be a Senator, Governor, Congress person, Party political figure such as Chair, President, SCOTUS, Cabinet, and else. There's always room for opportunity and a broom for the inactive; to be replaced by you...potentially vibrant and ambitious enough to make it to the top. BFTH isn't fun because it's a video game. It's entertaining because it's a community; Since the game has negative and positive implications for your behavior, your actions, and your decisions... BFTH becomes a real simulation. There is no total failure, but no total victory either. Everything is a perspective, and if you enjoy the realism of a world which makes you contemplate and consider the consequentialism of a 'world,' You'll learn more about politics here than you would from an 80 year old socialist professor at Harvard.” James Ernest

row.name: Hibernation Day
row.detailed_description: Hibernation Day is about family and the problems we face trying to keep it afloat. Our small team combined life experiences to compose a new-year-esk story you can relate to and spiced it up with some humor, so you wouldn't fall asleep listening to a calming soundtrack. The game features no saves but can be finished in around 20 very satisfying minutes, it's also slightly non-linear – try again and choose differently if you want more of them crisp wintery dialogs. Story It is almost the end of Hibernation Day , a holiday of the last day before a long winter slumber. However, the celebration isn't going well and everybody's on edge. Your cool older sister isn't happy to be stuck at home, your silly younger brother is nowhere to be found, and the parents are fighting (as they often do). Help your family get along and find peace in the last day before winter hibernation. Creators Developer and game designer: Serezhka Korneevskii Artist: Nastasia Viatkina Writer: Aleksandr Korneevskii You must be aware that this game is our love-child, and if you treat it poorly, you should expect us to visit your parents for the explanations.

row.name: Life After Magic
row.detailed_description: Being an adult sucks! Life was so much easier when Akiko was saving the world with her magical girl squad, the Sentinels of Justice. Now she’s stuck working a boring retail job, watching the days creep closer to Y2K. She’s lost touch with her high school friends, her powers, and herself. Worst of all... MAGIC IS DISAPPEARING When Akiko realizes her healing magic is fading, she knows it's a sign of trouble. But things only get worse from there — her old teammates are affected too and soon the greater populace of the city! As Akiko, with help from the Sentinels, track down what's happening to magic (and who might be behind it) before it's too late. Meet the Sentinels Reconnect with your former teammates! All the Sentinels have moved on from magical girl life in their own way. Spend your free time getting closer to them (and even finding love!) with optional routes between your work day and your magical girl sleuthing. But the Sentinels aren't the only ones you'll meet! Hang out with your Glamour Pop work wife and avoid running into your ex, Solaire Blaze (don't even get us started!). Go to Work!? Even former magical girls have to pay rent! Go to your shift at Glamour Pop: the high-end, low-paying retail job that you got after high school. Deal with the demands of the customers and if successful, you might just have more energy to hang with your friends! Plus, you wouldn't want to get on the bad side of Glamour Pop's CEO Anna Lee… Life After Magic is a queer, retro visual novel featuring: 100k+ words 13 tracks of original music Handmade pixel art, CGs & VFX Sapphic main cast with lots to discover about each character Optional routes for friendship and romance (and a secret or two!) Workplace mini-game and one special ending mini-game Y2K anxiety A funky li'l cat Developed by
row.short_description: Can you save magic before the clock strikes midnight on New Year’s Eve? Life After Magic is a queer, retro visual novel that follows jaded ex-magical girls as they reconnect, deal with young adulthood, and face off against one last threat before Y2K hits.

Evil could lurk beyond any corner in this labyrinth. It’s your worst nightmare come true, you hear them scratching at the walls, the footsteps echoing, but getting closer. There are signs on the walls, prayers for help. But others are written in human blood. It’s the Pandas and they’re taunting you. • A psychological horror game set in the Back Rooms • Run and hide as giant pandas chase you from level to level. Each with its own unique ability to make your life hell. • Each level increases in difficulty. • Make your way to safe rooms where the nightmarish pandas can’t get you… you hope. • Collect power-ups to fight off the pandas, but it won’t last long. • Single player, first person. Can you make your way through the Back Rooms with your Mind and Body intact? Or will the Pandas drag you deeper?

row.name: The Virtual Illés Initiative
row.detailed_description: The Virtual Illés Initiative is an interactive and immersive reconstruction of The Illés Relief (1873), a remarkable miniature model that depicts the Old City of Jerusalem and the developing New City at the time of its fabrication. It is a pioneering digital humanities project that aims to complete historic records of 19th century Jerusalem within an interactive virtual environment. The Virtual Illés Initiative is a bespoke mapping system that features a range of modular interactive tools, such as historical map overlays, interactive archival materials and 3D models, immersive GIS mappings, real time lighting and more. It is an evolving collaborative project and we welcome contributions from scholars, researchers, students and citizens. We invite you to contribute new documentation and artifacts, other elements of intangible culture, personal glimpses of the living city and memorabilia including diaries, letters, memoirs, and photographs. These contributions will be used to annotate and animate the relief, and to challenge conventional historiographical views of Jerusalem. Please contact us via the project website for details on how to contribute.
row.short_description: The Virtual Illés Initiative is an educational application that reconstructs models and archival materials within an interactive 3D map of Jerusalem.

However, as you settle into your apartment, you begin to notice strange occurrences and unsettling behavior from your neighbours. Unexplained noises, bizarre events, and creepy sightings of your neighbors make you wonder if you're truly safe in your own home.
row.short_description: Fear of Neighbours is a psychological horror game that puts you in the shoes of a resident in a quiet Finnish neighbourhood.

row.name: RAID: Shadow Legends
row.detailed_description: The realm of Teleria trembles beneath the shadow of the Dark Lord Siroth. You have been called upon by the Arbiter, the immortal guardian of Teleria, to stop him. Heed the call! Dive into a deep turn-based RPG with 8 exciting game modes and extensive character customization. Enjoy a story-driven campaign, competitive PvP clashes with players from across the world, and constant new challenges with our stream of updates. KEY GAME FEATURES SUMMON 800+ CHAMPIONS Collect hundreds of unique Champions from 15 playable factions and combine them into unstoppable teams to take down your enemies. Dark elves, Ogryn warlords, Lizardmen, and more can all join your ranks – if you earn their loyalty. MASTER TACTICAL TURN-BASED GAMEPLAY Kit out your Champions with epic gear you loot along the way and customize their masteries for millions of possible builds. Level up your team and play them your way, unleashing a barrage of powerful skills and game-changing support abilities. row.name: Home Sweet Home : Online
row.detailed_description: The ultimate excitement with Home Sweet Home : Online, complete missions to escape from Niwarn for victory. Join Our Communities : Survive Mode Asymmetrical mode that consists of 1 warden hunting 4 visitors in an arena. There are two core gameplays depended on the role players take. Warden's mission The warden is to strategically hunt 4 visitors letting no one escape, and not being killed by visitors. Each warden will have different stats and special abilities offering various ways of hunting visitors. Visitor's mission The visitors have to cooperate to complete the objective. Each character will have different stats and unique abilities supporting each role of play - decoy, damage, or perform the rituals. Things will drastically change after the objective is completed. The game will test personal dilemma choosing either teaming up to eliminate the warden or saving own self by leaving the arena. escaping the Hindrance, or be the warden and hunt and collect souls. Battle Mode Win through collecting souls in a 4vs4 style battle where the Visitor that holds the Warden Soul will turn into a Warden to hunt down the visitor on the other team. The other Visitors has to do their best to stay alive to limit their loss. There can only be one winner in the war between sides. (1) The 4 visitors must work together to complete the awakening ritual to summon the 'Warden's Soul'. After completion, they will receive 1 'Warden Soul'. (2) The Visitor that holds the 'Warden Soul' can spawn and play as a Warden to hunt down the other team's Visitors. (3) Over time the power of the Warden Soul decreases causing the Warden to slowly lose HP. The Visitors have to keep performing the ritual to restore their Warden's powers or store it to summon a new Warden that replaces the old one. (4) The team that collects the most Warden Souls within the time limit wins the match. If the results end in a tie, The first team that can take down an enemy Visitor wins. Wardens that revert back to being a Visitor will receive a 'Karma Points' based on how many Visitors they eliminated. If the other team's Warden eliminates the reverted Visitor, they will receive the Karma points as bonus points for the team. Niwarn is the dimension between the human and spirit world. The reason souls end up being trapped in Niwarn can come from a person being in a limbo between life and death or cursed with dark magic . People with strong arcanic powers often use their powers to control the Warden to hunt down the Visitors that end up wandering into Niwarn. They hunt for their souls to complete an unexplained ritual.
row.short_description: Experience the balanced PvP Battles in a 4vs1 style. Win through collecting souls in a 4vs4 style battle where the person that holds the Warden Soul will turn into a Warden to hunt down the visitor on the other team. There can only be one winner in the war between sides.
row.reviews: “Experience the Balanced PvP Battles With Home Sweet Home : Online” IGN

row.name: Green New Deal Simulator
row.detailed_description: The Green New Deal Simulator is a tiny deck-building game about the biggest challenge of our time: climate change. Your goal is to transition the United States to a post-carbon economy while ensuring full employment. Invest in renewable energy sources, end fossil fuel consumption, capture the CO2 in the atmosphere, update the energy grid, research new green technologies… But watch out: the clock is ticking, and it seems like the budget is never enough! Features The Green New Deal Simulator is the long-awaited sequel to the Democratic Socialism Simulator. It features a completely new gameplay while maintaining the same accessibility. Drag and drop your action cards onto various regions of the USA, evaluate their impact, and expand your deck. A game lasts about 40 minutes. - Intuitive board game-like mechanics - 22 action cards based on real-world policies and solutions - A cast of proud working class animals - Original soundtrack by Jesse Stiles made with locally sourced analog synthesizers - 100% free: no ads, no subscriptions, no in-game purchases
row.short_description: Achieve zero emissions and full employment in this casual card-driven game.

row.name: Mini Sports

Challenge players from around the world or invite your friends to compete with you in classic and fun games like 8-ball pool, racing, badminton, curling, mini golf, and archery. 🎱 8-Ball pool The classic pool game where players take turns to pot all their balls. 🏎️ Racing Compete in a race where the fastest to complete the laps wins. row.name: Linxy The Lynx
row.detailed_description: Linxy is known for saving his home (Mangoberry Island) from the nefarious Prof.B.Ray on a weekly basis and this time it's not all that different, B.Ray is up to some scheme that revolves using his Nature Taker-er to power his Linxy Destroyer-er! Overview Play as Linxy and use his slick moves to get to Prof.B.Ray's fortress! Along the way you'll find bounce pads and aerial bounce pads that'll boost you vertically and horizontally respectively, you'll encounter grind rails that Linxy can ride at high speeds but it's not a smooth ride you'll need to be quick in order to jump bottomless pits, stalagmite pits and lava pits that split rails apart! Collectables Along your way you'll find little motherboard looking things called Remix Chips, these chips allow you to unlock new levels that are harder and introduce a couple of new mechanics you won't encounter on your normal journey. Collect a ton of Coconuts for a final secret! Moveset Linxy has an easy to learn hard to master moveset so anyone at any skill level can pick up the game and play! Linxy has your typical jump, a double jump, a slide and a slide jump! The slide jump prioritizes distance over height so if you want to get up to higher ground you're best off normal jumping. As for a slide it will give Linxy a temporary burst of speed and can be used to pop every enemy in the game!
row.short_description: Stop Prof.B.Ray's Nature Taker-er before he destroys Mangoberry island and his main course... YOU!

As you explore the darkest corners of the spooky mansion, you will collect items and solve riddles. Notes and newspaper pages will shed light on past events, and all combined will put you one step closer to discovering the truth. And in the end, you will have to decide not only about Emma’s fate. The game has three different endings. Due to its length, there is no save option. Although David and Emma Adams are siblings, they grew apart in time. But when the news of Emma's disappearance reaches David, he decides to do whatever is in his power to find her. Seeing the hopelessness of the local PD, he decides to take the matter into his own hands. The trail leads him to the old mansion owned by a mystery horror novelist, who, as it turns out, also vanished without a trace. Believing those disappearances are not a coincidence, David goes to the manor. He ventures into the unknown... row.name: PoligonVR
row.detailed_description: Imagine a virtual world where you can create or be anything you ever wanted. PoligonVR is a powerful community driven sandbox where we give you the necessary tools to turn your dreams into virtual reality. Our goal is to provide a safe, fun & exciting experience for everyone. You can explore the user generated content, have a chat with your friends or watch a movie together! The choice is yours at any time. We provide a way to seamlessly switch between VR & Desktop mode quickly without having to restart the game. This allows you to test something in VR or need to take a quick VR break without having to shut everything down. We want to shape this platform based on your feedback so we can deliver the best experience for you. With our Unity based Content Creation Kit (CCK) you can easily upload and manage your content. We designed the CCK to be both powerful and easy to use for anyone. For custom content, PoligonVR utilizes 'Single-pass instanced rendering' which provides VR performance benefits compared to the traditional 'Multi-pass rendering'. We provide a safe, high performant scripting solution we call 'P#'. With P#, you can create complex worlds where you are in control of the world logic. Within our CCK we provide examples of common world logics such as buttons, video players and much more. Because they are powered by P#, you can modify & tweak the provided examples to your needs at any given time. Experience super immersive audio with Steam Audio. We allow world creators to integrate Steam Audio directly into their worlds & the voice chat to provide a realistic and immersive experience. You can upload your own custom avatars, or try out public avatars created by others or ask a friend to share their avatar with you! Sparked your interest? Join our Discord server for more information on how to join the closed-beta and future updates!
row.short_description: Imagine a virtual world where you can create or be anything you ever wanted. PoligonVR is a powerful community driven sandbox where we give you the necessary tools to turn your dreams into virtual reality.
