row.name: Sky division
row.detailed_description: Sky division is a visual novel, where the player plays the role of a human pilot fighting a war against an alien race to conquer their planet. During a reconnaissance mission the protagonist is shot down on a desert island and finds a wounded enemy pilot. The story focuses on the relationship between the two and the mutual understanding between two races that are in conflict. Sky division is a visual novel set in a dystopian future in which humanity abandoned Terra for unknown reasons. After traveling 600 years through the inhospitable darkness of space in huge spaceships called 'arks', governed with an iron fist by 'the federation', a conglomerate of countries that united with the purpose of avoiding the extinction of the entire race. After 6 generations away from home, mankind forgot the languages they used in terra, the religions and even the feelings, to the point that love and sentimental relationships were left in the past. A few books were preserved but are considered forbidden to the general population. The planet to which they were traveling was considered a paradise for the proliferation of the race, with no intelligent life and abundant resources. But when they arrived they saw how wrong they were, there was intelligent life on the planet and the planet was immersed in a territorial war and for the survival of the different races that inhabited it. (8.0) -New scenarios were added, such as the forest at night and the place where the dax fighter fell. -New songs and sounds to improve the atmosphere. -A voice actor to play some of Dax's words and moans. -Fixed some bugs that prevented you from continuing if you collected fruits instead of hunting animals.
row.short_description: Lost on a desert island with a wounded enemy pilot and no resources, can you cooperate even though you are enemies? or will you kill each other? Sky division is a visual novel that deals with themes such as the meaninglessness of war and unrequited love.
row.notes: Sky division is a gay/furry game with graphic scenes of blood and sex. There are many gay sex scenes shown and at the beginning there is a scene with some blood when the enemy pilot is wounded and the player has to heal his wounds.

row.name: Airborne
row.detailed_description: LISTEN TO THE SOUNDTRACK About the Game Airborne is a combination of 2D Platformers, Rage Games, Parkour, while also being packed with Action. You need to get to the end of the level by dodging Spikes, Bullets, Turrets, Lasers and more! This game is not easy, as you will need quick reflexes and platforming skills, while also being able to be played casually. You will need to escape precise levels that are designed to test the limits of your abilities. Your goal is to make it to the end of each level by dodging obstacles such as spikes, bullets, turrets, and lasers. You'll also need to use launch pads strategically to make death-defying jumps and reach seemingly impossible places. But the fun (and rage) doesn't stop there! There is also a vast library of community-made levels, created by players just like you using the integrated level editor. With new levels being added all the time, there's practically infinite content being made by players all around the world. Airborne has an advanced level editor with almost all features from the base game with the ability to publish your levels to the world using Steam Workshop! You can make pretty much anything your heart desires and share it with your friends - It is guaranteed to make them rage. If you're a fan of precision platformers and adrenaline-fueled gameplay, then this is the game for you. With its intense rage platforming, interesting level design, and community-made content, you'll never run out of levels to beat!. the cube can jump btw
row.short_description: Airborne is a combination of 2D Platformers, Rage Games, Parkour, while also being packed with Action. You need to get to the end of the level by dodging Spikes, Bullets, Turrets, Lasers and more!

row.name: Irradiant
row.detailed_description: Irradiant is a minimal 2D, score-attack action game where you're faced with destroying mischievous spirits bewitching a shrine as fast as possible. You'll need to thread the needle on precision movement, button mashing and careful use of soul charges - your resource for unleashing devastation screen-wide slashes. Do you play safely at the cost of score? Or push your skills to the limit to shave off precious seconds? Your achievements can be viewed by all, with the online leaderboard. Replay your best run or watch others to see what techniques they use. Will you live long enough to face Kaizen and bring silence to the shrine? Highly responsive controls, it's up to you to master your abilities to obtain the best score you can. Time ticks away, hesitation will only hurt you. Light attacks are as quick as your fingers and give you air time. Heavy attacks have a cooldown but deal extra damage and fling you upwards. Collect soul charges to unleash a powerful slash attack, but beware: enemies you kill with it won't reward you with more soul charges. Use the environment to your advantage with wall jumps and dashes to speed towards enemies as they appear. Compete for the top of the leaderboard, where every second counts. Watch replays of leaderboard scores to discover new techniques. Custom engine with minimal hardware requirements. Playing with a controller is highly recommended. Music by Peritune. Voice effects by Voicevox.
row.short_description: Silence the shrine. Irradiant is a small score-attack action game by a solo developer, where you're faced with destroying mischievous spirits bewitching a shrine as fast as possible.

row.name: Shiner
row.detailed_description: Shiner is a turn-based strategy game where you learn all the attacks of the enemies you beat! Starting with only the knowledge of how to do a simple punch, can you snowball yourself into an avatar of (fuzzy) destruction? Make friends with a cast of cute and colorful characters! Every character in the game has a unique personality and a unique set of attacks for you to learn if you can beat them. “Why would I fight my friends,” you ask? Look, relationships are complicated. Buds can horse around is all I’m saying. Craft powerful builds! You’ll learn a ton of attacks, but you can only bring 4 of them into each fight. Can you find the right combination to beat an opponent who heals to full health every turn? What about someone who reflects all the damage you deal right back at you? Every battle is a puzzle and an opportunity for you to find a new way to break the game. 4 zones to battle your way through. A fully voice-acted cast of characters. 'One-Punch Mode' if the battles get too tough. A bite-sized experience! The game's only 1 or 2 hours long. Ranch dressing elemental. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Learn every attack that gets used against you in this turn-based strategy game. Meet (and battle) a colorful cast of fully voice-acted characters as you search for the bully who wronged you.

row.name: VIRA
row.detailed_description: Max Bludnev is the main character, who returns to his native land after a year of absence. He is finding out news about his Father, who got into trouble and Maxim will have to help him out and at the same time get to the truth of all his father's problems. 2015 year! The good old 2D Quest on the principle of Point and Click. Jokes, Black Humor and simple controls are present! - A short but interesting story about the adventures of Maxim. - A system of saving on the principle of entering a Pin code! - Real-life locations! Look for: MAZA (2025)
row.short_description: Maxim Bludnev helps his father, who got into a mess. A funny 2D Quest that will show a simple story with black humor and interesting details!
row.notes: Does not exist sexual content Blood Kill

row.name: Dream Ploy Will
row.detailed_description: This is a 1V1 game, including round system, war chess, and strategy play. You can freely match your deck, command heroes, summon monsters, and release spells! Compete with game friends or strangers! This is a 1V1 game, including round system, war chess, and strategy play. You can freely match your deck, command heroes, summon monsters, and release spells! Compete with game friends or strangers! Introduction to play 1. Open card/secret card: two cards can be played each round, one open card and one secret card. Open cards can be seen by opponents, and dark cards need to be guessed 2. First hand/second hand: after the end of each round, the first hand/second hand will exchange, the first hand will play first and attack first; But the clear card of the first hand will also be seen by the second hand. 3.1 Fee/fee: two 1-fee cards or one 2-fee card can be played each round 4. Chessboard: The positions of both sides are 5X5 squares. Use the squares reasonably to maximize the strategic value! Custom deck You can match your card set freely Hero You can choose your hero freely Real-time combat Fight with friends or strangers in real time
row.short_description: This is a 1V1 game, including round system, war chess, and strategy play. You can freely match your deck, command heroes, summon monsters, and release spells! Compete with game friends or strangers!

row.name: Heart vs HP
row.detailed_description: This is an auto-scroller game where you control a heart to move up or down to avoid incoming obstacles while maintaining your HP. Other than obstacles, there will be damage zone in red and heal zone in green which decreases and increases the heart's HP. Make sure to manage your HP well to get the high score!
row.short_description: Avoid all incoming obstacles while managing your HP! There are only 2 ways to die. One, is be hit by an obstacle, and two, when your HP is 0. Try to get as many points as possible to renew your high score!

row.name: DHL Box Stacker Pro
row.detailed_description: Beat the best in DHL Box Stacker Pro . In this single player VR experience, you are tasked with stacking boxes correctly on the shelving as you ascend at an ever-increasing pace. Start at the floor and work your way up! A single challenge that's easy to start but increasingly difficult to master. 📦 Stack boxes as fast as possible to rise above the competition ⏱️ Quick game sessions 🔥 Intense gameplay 🏆 Global leaderboards ❓ How high can you try?
row.short_description: Beat the best in DHL Box Stacker Pro. Stack boxes as fast as possible to rise above the competition. This single player VR experience features intense gameplay. How high can you try?

row.name: Knightmares
row.detailed_description: Knightmares, the Ultimate Deckbuilding Adventure! Prepare to embark on an epic journey into a world filled with darkness, strategy, and the power of fusion. In this groundbreaking deckbuilding game, you'll have the opportunity to create the most formidable combinations imaginable, all while battling against the relentless nightmares that haunt the land. Knightmares offers a vast array of cards, each with its own unique abilities and strengths. As you progress through the game, you'll discover new cards to add to your ever-growing deck, allowing for endless possibilities and customization. The strategic choices you make during deck construction will determine your chances of success as you face off against the nightmares. One of the most exciting features of Knightmares is the fusion system. By combining specific cards in your deck, you can unlock even more powerful combinations and abilities. Experiment with different fusions to find the perfect synergy and unleash devastating attacks upon your enemies. But be warned: the nightmares you'll encounter are not to be taken lightly. Each nightmare possesses its own set of challenges and requires careful planning to overcome. Your deckbuilding skills will be put to the test as you strategize your way through intense battles and unlock new levels of power. Features: More than 100 cards to fuse. More than 80 fusions to discover. A wide variety of decks. Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design degree of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.
row.short_description: Face yourself in an epic tale of honor, courage and fusions. Knightmares will make you see fantasy from... A different point of view.

row.name: 沉舟：序章
row.detailed_description: During the time that the demo was released, I received a lot of complaints about the poor art style, and I have been struggling with this problem. But I wanted to give you a better experience and a more satisfying answer for myself. I finally decided to change to the art style that was more suitable for the story, which meant that almost all of the art assets we had used in the past had to be abandoned and redrawn, which was a challenge for the project in terms of money and time. But please rest assured, the remake is currently underway, and the pictures displayed on the store page are in the style of the old version, and after the first part is completed, I will update it to the store page in time to share with you! Stay tuned! ----------------------------------------------------- The story setting: In April 1943, the Japanese Eleventh Army gathered a large number of troops, intending to eliminate the main forces of the defenders of the 6th Theater of China, open up the middle and upper reaches of the Yangtze River, and seize the ship materials of the Chinese army. Around the war situation in the 6th Theater, the forces of all sides strategize, fight openly and secretly, and launch a fierce and bloody competition. Unexpectedly, Nanjing, this faraway city becomes the key to victory in this battle. And our story begins here... Identity crisis, Mystery Visitor, Loyalty and betrayal, abandonment or abandonment... Play as a group of underground workers fighting in the dark and make some important decisions. These choices may affect not only yourself, but also the lives of others. BUT please remember that the victory always needs price. Bright spots: In this game, players will complete the entire story through different chapters and different characters' perspectives. Even if a character dies or is imprisoned due to your choices, the game will not end. The world does not stop by anybody, even the protagonist of this story. There will be others who will continue to fight for the same goal. Main elements of the game: Plot direction, spy war, explore, forties of the last century, great heroine, love elements but low proportion, pixel style... Solemnly declare: This story is purely fictional, a story created in a historical context, not a complete historical fact. At present, the production progress is 10%, the story is born out of a novel written a few years ago, as a game script, the main plot has been completed, the branch plot needs to be improved, and now it is mainly after the art materials are in place, the progress will be accelerated.
row.short_description: Play as a group of underground workers who fight in the dark, and stage a treacherous spy war story in Nanjing during World War II. How will you respond to identity crises, betrayals, and collapsed beliefs? Loyalty or betrayal, abandon others or be abandoned...
row.notes: This game is set in a time of war, and the content may be violent and cruel.

row.name: Manic Archers - Bullseye DEMO
row.detailed_description: FREE BULLSEYE DEMO This free Manic Archers Demo will be released to complement the official release of Manic Archers (changed from Early Access) on March, 20th 2023. It features a limited game mode selection, limited map selection, limited powerups and will automatically quit after a few minutes (can be restarted though). Other than that it behaves equivalent to the full version you can purchase on Steam as well: ULTIMATE LOCAL MULTIPLAYER RETROGAMING ARCADE Manic Archers is a game that I personally would have liked to play back then, but it was not possible in the 16bit era because of technical limitations. A game that overflows with gems inspired by the arcade 2D high-times - 1000s of sprites and interlocking effects cumulating into a sensory overload of 16bit hype - while keeping that absolute, direct and perfectly controllable arcade grip. It took 2 years to perfect this game as a solo-developer. WHY YOU SHOULD GET THE FULL VERSION OF MANIC ARCHERS NOW Manic Archers is the first topdown Zelda-type versus game ever ! On-the-point gameplay and simple yet deep mechanics First rpg-style top-down versus fighting game with an arcade feel Lovely, hand-animated pixelart, inspired by the golden age of 2d arcade games Highly strategic matches vs. complete chaotic infernos Interactive levels Many common multiplayer modes AI support and coop-mode to practice without your friends Atmospheric music and hard hitting sound-effects Easy to play, hard to master Authentic classic RPG-scale sprites and environment expanded to HD resolution Official release planned for Switch, Playstation and Xbox separately till mid 2023. GAMEPLAY FIRST MANIC ARCHERS is an atmospheric and extremely addictive local and online multiplayer arcade game in pixelart-style. It features simplistic and on-the-point gameplay with amazing game mechanics and lovely pixelart-details. It is playable with up to 4 players simultaneously on one single screen in several well known multiplayer variants. THE MOST SIMPLE GAME OF ALL TIME One screen and 3 buttons is all you need to know - jump, shoot and dash/block . The depth of good gameplay is found in simplicity accompanied by great mechanics . THINK ZELDA AND DEATHMATCH With the intention to make a multiplayer match top-down game, MANIC ARCHERS owes to and actually should remind of the heritage of all top-down games like the Zelda and Final Fantasy series. Imagine the same love for details put into a competitive multiplayer arcade game for 4 players simultaneously. APPROVED MULTIPLAYER FUN In versus-mode players each control an archer, shooting the opposing archers until only one archer is left - besides Free-For-All versus, Manic Archers is featuring several other well known multiplayer modes . During the game a lot of combinable and game changing powerups and special arrows appear on the playing field, enabling players to turn the game around in an instant. AI TO KEEP YOU GAMING In case you need one more player to start a 2on2 teamplay match or if you are alone and want to train, Manic Archers got AI opponents to fill up the slots . RETRO CAUSE WE DO NOT NEED 3D FOR THAT The game takes place on a single screen with classic arcade wrap-around scrolling . The players make use of the top-down environment strategically such as water, higher grounds, obstacles and interactive map parts such as switches, explosives, burnable trees and more. Key Features Up to 4 players local and online Play arcade style locally AND online with up to 4 Players (via Remote Play Together). Versus Simple Free-For-All match, fast paced, deep gameplay mechanics (also available for Teamplay). King of the hill Keep control of the center of the map to gain points and secure the round (also available for Teamplay). Catch the fool with the chicken All players match against the one who got the chicken - the one who keeps the chicken longest wins the round. Conquer Dominate parts of the map to gain points, the one who dominated most flags the longest wins. Survival Coop How long can you and your friends survive against hordes of enemies? Manic Archers features a small coop-campaign that is also playable alone. Though DO NOT buy Manic Archers just for the coop-campaign - Manic Archers is primarily meant as a versus game. Deep gameplay mechanics The gameplay is set up for competitive and fun matches through deep but easy to learn game mechanics. AI Opponents Fill up the remaining slots with AI opponents with adjustable skill or create matches alone to train. Interactive and individual maps Interactive maps allow strategic advances which are easy to understand and use. The interactive elements available vary in each map SPECIAL MOVES Though you will probably find out these yourself, as they're pretty simple... SUPER DASH - Dash while on the way down of a jump, shortly before you hit the ground STOMP JUMP - Hit the JUMP button again while in mid air SHIELD - Hold down the dash button to shield yourself against attacks you are facing
row.short_description: Manic Archers is the very first topdown Zelda-type versus game ever! It features simplistic and on-the-point gameplay with amazing game mechanics and lovely arcade style pixelart-details. It is playable with up to 4 players simultaneously on one screen in several variants.
row.reviews: “@manicarchers is one of the best party games I've played in awhile! The powerups are unique, the artstyle is our nostalgia, and the gameplay is just hilarious/random. This is a great party game, and love it's Steam Co-Op compatible. @IGCollective #indiegames #pixelart” Indie Game Collective / TheShiny1 (during Early Access) “Manic Archers is an absolutely frenetic multiplayer twinstick brawler. Good range of maps and play modes for replayability. It looks and sounds great and is super intense if a little too fast for me (editor: reviewed during Early Access, before speed selection). Manic Archers is an awesome brawler! It gives me Street Fighter cross Little Fighter vibes and everything about it is exciting. [...]” CSH Picone (during Early Access)

row.name: RoboHunters
row.detailed_description: RoboHunters is a fast-paced top down action shooter. Destroy swarms of rogue machines, level up, and fight the Robo Sentry boss! As you level up, your characer will gain new abilities such as Napalm Boots, Gravity Vortex, and the Destroyer Disc! Leveling up the same ability more than once will increase its power. How to Play This game plays best with a mouse and keyboard. Move your character with WASD, and use the mouse to aim. Abilities can be triggered with Left mouse click, Right mouse click, and 1-4 on your keyboard. Controller support is limited to in-game play. Menus do not yet all work with the controller. Move with the left stick, aim with the right. Left bumper, right bumper, and the 4 gamepad buttons will activate your abilities Game credits Made as a collaborate project for HomeTeam GameDev. row.short_description: Top-down 3D action shooter. Fight against swarms of rogue AI machines and survive as long as you can!

row.name: EPOCHRYPHA
row.detailed_description: Epochrypha calls you and your friends to hack and slash through time as you work together to unscramble it. Choose from a band of unique warriors as you play hot-potato with unstable relics, fight through fast paced combat, and restore order to the timeline. Epocrypha features fast paced Hack and Slash combat combined with high stakes hot-potato. Players are responsible for transporting important items through hostile environments to restore time to its natural state. These relics are too unstable to be held for long, so players must strategically split the burden of carrying it as they navigate through enemies and obstacles to get to the boss. 1-2 Controllers are required for Local Multiplayer functionality.
row.short_description: Epochrypha calls you and your friends to hack and slash through time as you work together to unscramble it. Choose from a band of unique warriors as you play hot-potato with unstable relics, fight through fast paced combat, and restore order to the timeline.

row.name: Hell Of A Racket
row.detailed_description: Play as a fallen angel seeking redemption by punishing satanic worshipers who don't play the holiest of sports....tennis! Use your blessed racket to wreak havoc and show these satanic practices have no standing in God's land! Hell of a Racket is a unique twist on an old-school genre: First-Person Shooter? No. First-Person Swinger! Engage with enemies in a unique way by reflecting projectiles at them with your racket or simply smacking them! Jump, dash, run, or wall-climb your way around the arena and kill your enemies as you work your way to the final boss: Pickle Ball Satan! Core Mechanics and Features: - Reflect projectiles and launch enemies into each other with a swing of your tennis racket. - Charge your swing to send out faster projectiles. - Dynamic environment that utilizes your skillset - Be mindful of your timing, get it wrong, and suffer from inaccuracy. - Rack up kills against enemies in exciting ways to increase your multiplier and achieve a high score! - Utilize powerups to increase your strength or mobility! Includes a slew of accessibility features to make this game playable for a broad audience.
row.short_description: Play as a fallen angel seeking redemption by punishing satanic worshipers who don't play the holiest of sports....tennis!
row.reviews: “This game is like Doom, but with a tennis racket and burgers. It’s not exactly the most traditional take on hell — or tennis — but it’s a delightful romp through some silly territory.” Polygon “Who needs a BFG when you can kill demons with a sports implement?” The Escapist

row.name: Angels of Darkness Angels of Light
row.detailed_description: Play as either an angel of Darkness or an Angel of Light. A war between Angels from the distant past is reimagined in a Medieval Mindset. Rival factions battle it out in an attempt to commit iconoclast against each other. The choice is yours which side you affiliate with. Each side has a choice of six Angel classes and one human servant class. Each class having it's own strengths and weaknesses. There is also the choice of having bots or no bots in the game Primary weapon and secondary weapon/ability for each class Kick System built in Text Chat (Global or Team) Unique and specially written soundtrack for this title and three sister games Male and female protagonists Medieval and Classical environments Ten levels and more to be added Regular updates planned.
row.short_description: Play as either an angel of Darkness or an Angel of Light. A war between Angels from the distant past is reimagined in a Medieval Mindset. Rival factions battle it out in an attempt to commit iconoclast against each other. The choice is yours which side you affiliate with.
row.notes: There are some classical (Roma/Greek) statues which have genitals.

row.name: Fatrifice
row.detailed_description: In order to summon a demon, one girl must stuff herself to be the ultimate fatrifice! Help her expand into new shapes and sizes by feeding her! FEATURES A cute girl who gains weight. A fun and lovable story. Timed-clicking minigame. Gallery to revisit your favorite moments. Normal and hard difficulties. 2 endings. Censored and uncensored options.
row.short_description: In order to summon a demon, one girl must stuff herself to be the ultimate fatrifice! Help her expand into new shapes and sizes by feeding her!
row.notes: Contains expansive female nudity and fetishes.

row.name: Lobby Loitering
row.detailed_description: A young man named Marcel goes to the mall with his older brother late one afternoon. While wandering around, he quickly finds himself in a bizarre version of the place he was just in. An odd entity in a dark hotel room fills him in on his situation, and it's not looking good -- Marcel has transported himself to an alternate reality, and he's got a long journey back home. In Lobby Loitering , it's up to you to help Marcel return to his world by exploring the chain of odd hotels he gets transferred to. Help eccentric strangers with their daily problems, discover secrets and lore about the worlds you traverse, and get into plenty of places you shouldn't be in.
row.short_description: Have you ever felt like, in a single step, the world around you changed, and you didn't notice until it was too late? Explore a collection of alternate realities in an attempt to get Marcel back to the reality he belongs in.
row.notes: Mature Content Notice: To varying degrees, characters make mention of suicidal thoughts, war, depression, drug use, murder, and sexual innuendos. A character is also drugged on screen, but this is done without sexual intent or mention of sex anywhere before or after. Sexual innuendos are localized to side characters or easter eggs that do not need to be interacted with in order to proceed.

row.name: R2BEAT（アールツービート）
row.detailed_description: Rhythm Racing Beat, R2BEAT! The running Rhythm game is back! Enjoy a rhythm game full of speed! R2BEAT is a game that combines sound games and race games in which characters wearing inline skates run through various courses while avoiding obstacles to the rhythm. This title was in service in Japan from October 2006 to September 2009, and even after its service was terminated in Japan, it has been enjoyed by many players in Korea, China, and many other countries around the world. Now, the latest version of the game, with the addition of new songs, is finally returning to Japan as a 'racing rhythm game' that combines 'rhythm' and 'racing'! The unique world of 'R2BEAT' will bring a sense of nostalgia not only to those who have played the game in the past, but also to those who are experiencing it for the first time. R2BEAT' is a highly anticipated revival title that is sure to get everyone hooked on its easy-to-use controls, diverse music, and racing tactics.
row.short_description: Rhythm Racing Beat, R2BEAT! The running Rhythm game is back! Enjoy a rhythm game full of speed! R2BEAT is a game that combines sound games and race games in which characters wearing inline skates run through various courses while avoiding obstacles to the rhythm.

row.name: Winnie-the-Pooh's book writing speedrunner
row.detailed_description: Join the community! About the Game Winnie-the-Pooh's book writing speedrunner is an exciting game that challenges players to write the entire original Winnie-the-Pooh book chapter by chapter, all while racing against the clock. In this game, players are tasked with writing the complete 10 chapters as quickly as possible, with their time being tracked and recorded for competition with other players around the world.
row.short_description: Write the complete 10 chapters of the original 1926 Winni-the-Pooh's book as fast as you can and compete for the first place in the leaderboards.

row.name: Don't Die In The West Playtest
Barrett Foster : Prologue
row.detailed_description: Barrett Foster is a riddle game in which you will have to solve puzzles to progress and solve a personal investigation: The dramatic disappearance of Emma, a close friend of Barrett. In a realistic universe and in first person view, you will have to explore emma’s home to discover all the secrets of her disappearance: Identify and analyze the objects present in the place but also activate mechanisms and secret codes to conduct the investigation! Beware of noises and your gestures because they can and will have consequences! .
row.short_description: Play as Inspector Barrett Foster in this exciting and immersive enigma game that mixes mystery and suspense at the same time. The expression 'The devil is in the details' takes on its full meaning in this game that will make you think and certainly more...
row.notes: Contient du contenu gore (traces de sang, et outils de torture).

row.name: Akpala
row.detailed_description: Cast spells by chanting, and striking heroic poses for enhanced magic effects. Learn and perform different spells according to the needs of the battle. Movement, strategic thinking and resource management are crucial in every duel! Be sure that you use every tool in your arsenal. Engage in voice-based communication with 3D AI characters! During the tutorial stages, you will not only be able to learn everything about the game but also 'chit-chat' with the character that is guiding you with AI-generated conversations. Be sure that you don't get captivated by Lukia and actually finish the tutorial! Supports up to four players in multiplayer mode with 1v1 or 2v2 team battles and battle royales. Grab your partner or join solo with our matchmaking feature and get to play with other Wizards from all around the world. In multiplayer, strategically create and place blocks on the stage to build advantageous positions or snipe from above. These blocks can make a huge difference in different scenarios. Need to go higher? Build a ladder! Plain battleground? Create some cover! Take advantage of different perks and jumping-pads to move through the battlefield. Collect black orbs that yield random outcomes and mana orbs to keep casting your spells. Flex your wits, move your body, and chant magic loudly on the battlefield!
row.short_description: Don't you want to play a magical battle, chanting magic with your voice in VR space? A thrilling action game that offers three new experiences like never before has arrived! Multiplayer VR game for up to 4 players, featuring 2v2 team battles and a battle royale mode.

row.name: 神灵石之劫 Tales of Spark Playtest
Military Tanks
row.detailed_description: War Tanks is one of the best free-to-play tank games available today! Dive into this modern tank warfare game, where you can engage in fast-paced, realistic tank battles with millions of players from all over the world. Command armored vehicles, from light tanks to heavy tanks, and experience the thrill of real-time PvP combat. Join players in tactical team-based battles across a variety of battle arenas, where every decision counts. With customizable tanks and extensive tank upgrades, you’ll be able to build your own war machine, unlocking modern tanks with unique abilities. War Tanks offers a blend of realistic tank simulation and an engaging arcade-style shooter, giving players an immersive and exciting experience. Whether you prefer fast tank tactics or strategic planning, this game has something for everyone. FEATURES: Variety tanks: Choose from light, medium, and heavy tanks, each offering different speeds and strengths for dynamic tank physics. Upgrades and customization: Modify your battle tanks with advanced weapons and equipment to gain the upper hand in combat. Global tournaments and leaderboards: Compete in global PvP to top the tank battle leaderboards and show off your skills. Destructible environments: Fight in real-time tank battles with destructible environments, adding a layer of strategy to your gameplay. Modern tank tactics: Lead your team through strategic maneuvers in team-based multiplayer battles, dominating the battlefield. ONLINE MULTIPLAYER AND MAP VARIETY: Take part in multiplayer tank battles across realistic maps and diverse terrains. Explore desert battlefields, mountain passes, winter plains, and more, with detailed environments designed for intense tank combat. PERFORMANCE AND OPTIMIZATION: The game is fully optimized for most modern gaming devices, ensuring high FPS and seamless gameplay. The tank destruction physics and stunning 3D graphics provide an unmatched immersive experience. Additionally, Military Tanks is regularly updated with new tanks, maps, and special events to keep the action fresh. Join the fight today, build your perfect tank, and dominate the battlefield in this modern tank shooter! Experience fast-paced tank action, unlock new technologies, and climb the ranks to become the ultimate tank commander.
row.short_description: Do you like tanks game? Are you ready to feel the full power of a tank games?

row.name: Dubspace - Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Dubspace revolves around physical interactions that rely on forces and impulses. Mailcom navigates the zero-gravity environment using his jetpack, as well as weapons, pushing and pulling objects and obstacles. He may move fast, but he must be careful. Mailcom will explore dark and foreboding space stations, each with its own unique environment and set of challenges. These stations are filled with obstacles, traps, and other hazards. Launching a heavy object into the path of an enemy, redirecting the projectile with a well-timed push or solving an environmental puzzle, players must make use of properties such as mass and bounciness to their advantage. Enemies come in many forms and shapes, spawned in a variety of ways to create endless combat situations. With a choice of weapons, grenades and items at their disposal, players can eliminate enemies in any way they see fit. NOTE: Controller is required for local multiplayer
row.short_description: Embark on a cyberpunk action-adventure in zero-gravity as brother Mailcom, on a mission to uncover dark conspiracies and determine the fate of Zion space station. Enjoy physics-based movement, environmental puzzles, emergent combat, all set to a mighty dub soundtrack.

row.name: TOONCOP
row.detailed_description: Play for Free. Survive the Cartoon Apocalypse. Tooncop is a fast-paced, first-person horde shooter prototype where you take on waves of chaotic, rogue cartoon enemies spilling into the real world. There’s no pay-to-win, no microtransactions, and no cosmetic grinding—just raw arcade-style gameplay focused on survival, score chasing, and moment-to-moment chaos. Each run gives you 15 minutes to survive increasingly aggressive enemy waves, collect XP, chain power-ups, and push for high scores. The game is designed to be simple, snappy, and satisfying—with a growing emphasis on muscle memory and flow state combat . Whether you're testing your reflexes or just blasting rogue Pomchis for fun, Tooncop is all about gameplay first. 💡 This is an early prototype created by a solo developer. Expect frequent updates, new maps, and evolving mechanics as the project grows. Play now for free on Steam and help shape what comes next.
row.short_description: Battle rogue cartoons in Tooncop, a fast-paced FPS horde shooter! Survive 15 minutes, level up, and rack up cash while taking down waves of chaotic, mischievous toons.

row.name: Twell
row.detailed_description: This adventure is about you as a player waking up in this world named Twell. You don't have any memory from before and the only thing you can do now is explore what this world has to offer. You will explore 8 unique dungeons, discover many secrets and visit multiple populated locations. This is an adventure game full of puzzles and with a simple action battle system. It is made in RPG Maker XP. This free game will to entertain you as a player with a variety of challenges and motivating you to explore what it offers, without too much talking and too much grinding. Why is it free? I get this question a lot. I truly hope that you will play the game and enjoy it. That's more important to me. - Every dungeon has unique puzzles, enemies, bosses and theme. - Use key items to solve puzzles and uncover new areas. - The look of the character depends on which equipment you wear. - Visit many locations with unique characters to interact with. - Choose which type of sword you want and which skills you want to learn. - Side quests are available to you at the start, solve them whenever you want. - Feel free to play the game in your own order. No hand-holding, but it's clear where to go next. - The game keeps your progress when it's game over, you just choose a location to start. - You can unlock extra challenges for Battle Mode. - You can also start the game on hard difficulty for some extra challenge.
row.short_description: This adventure is about you waking up in this world named Twell. The only thing you can do now is explore what this world has to offer. Explore 8 unique dungeons, discover many secrets and visit many locations.

row.name: Titanic II: Orchestra for Dying at Sea
row.detailed_description: 2023 Independent Games Festival Nuovo Award Nominated and 2022 AMAZE Berlin Audience Award Winner The Much Anticipated Sequel Originally released as an after credits bonus scene in The Titanic, but most people left the theater before getting a chance to see it because The Titanic is already 3 hours long. Now remastered in HD and brought directly to you via Steam. This Tragedy Features First Person Exploration ~40minute gameplay Bass Blasted Celin Dion Beloved and Familiar Characters No Jump Scares Plenty to Be Scared Of Other Emotions Too
row.short_description: A downloadable tragedy for Windows and macOS
row.reviews: “A fever-dream dive into the depths—alongside the sinking ocean liner—Titanic 2 is, at the same time, eerily tranquil and profoundly unsettling.” PC Gamer “A short, free, moody, silly, serious and incredibly unique game” Games Hub “Titanic II: Orchestra for Dying at Sea takes players through a journey into the afterlife and the complicated, snarled feelings that surround death.” Game Developer

row.name: Deep Space Scoundrel
row.detailed_description: Deep Space Scoundrel is a rogue-like space adventure where you use a variety of classic arcade mechanics to explore the universe, customize your ship, land at spaceports, and fraternize with other aliens and low-lives. Use a galaxy of customizable guns and ship parts to build the perfect battle unit and blast through the epic armies hunting you down.
row.short_description: Deep Space Scoundrel is a rogue-like space adventure where you use a variety of classic arcade mechanics to explore the universe, customize your ship, land at spaceports, and fraternize with other aliens and low-lives.

row.name: Hollow Mission
row.detailed_description: In this Single player game, you will follow a soldier first-person Pov , that has been send out to find out what has happened to one of their camps that has made it go complete dark. You will have to explore the area to find out what has happened and be on high alert because who knows what is lurking around. As you play you will expect to do mini puzzles and have to explore to find a way to the next area while evading or confronting what lies ahead you will also find little snippets of the lore of this camp.
row.short_description: Single player First person Puzzle Base Casual Story base game that follows a soldier in his mission to find out what has happened to a lab out in the woods.

row.name: My Bath Tub Companion
row.detailed_description: Relax & recover in this short free 3D environment where you take control of your favorite bath tub girl. My Bath Tub Companion is an experience, to induce a calm & peaceful (and mildly horny) feeling. You'll feel satisfied sitting back, feel yourself relax as you watch her relax. Watch her from a distance, become her rubber duck toy, or see through her eyes. Take control and watch her enjoy herself with props around the room. Gain answers to some of life's biggest questions, like: What is my girlfriend doing when she is in the bath tub for so long? How did we use up so much hot water on the utility bill? Why is there a charge for 50 rubber ducks on my credit card? People have places to be, stress to worry about, but not you. Sit back, relax, listen to the sounds, enjoy the soothing visuals. Relaxation is the key to a blissful bath tub experience, and we've got you covered. Calm music & a beautiful girl to look at. Features List Create ducks in the bath tub Possess the rubber duck & see what she does with it Possess her to see through her eyes Relaxing music About This is a fun project we decided to work on together to develop our skills. If you like what you see, consider joining our Discord to see our latest art & full game releases as they come.
row.short_description: My Bath Tub Companion is a free experience, to induce a calm & peaceful (and mildly horny) feeling. You'll feel satisfied sitting back, feel yourself relax as you watch her relax. Relaxation is the key to a blissful bath tub experience. Calm music & a beautiful girl to look at.
row.notes: Sexually explicit acts & nudity. All characters are 18+

row.name: PolyFight
row.detailed_description: JUST FIGHT There's a simple pleasure to jumping into a quick match against a friend or foe. With a minimalist art style and straight-forward controls you'll feel at home in the familiar game-play yet challenged by the adaptability of your opponents. PolyFight is a test of your reaction time, positional play, and accuracy with a mouse. Up to 8 players! NO ROUND THE SAME Each round greets you with a refreshed layout of moveable walls. Could there be a mountain of obstacles between you and your opponent? Could there be nothing? Will you get lucky and spawn behind cover? How quickly can you adapt to the changing environment? CUSTOMIZE Squares, purples, triangles, yellows. There's a shade and shape for every player to play their way.
row.short_description: Duel your adversary and prove your skills to be superior.

row.name: Wretched Depths
row.detailed_description: Sam, an avid fishing fan, has traveled to the remote Twin Pines to cast into the mysterious Lake Imperium. However as she begins to adjust to her surroundings. Odd and unexplainable events begin to occur left and right in a town where the people seem strange, and the fish even stranger. Play as Sam and fish to your hearts content, sell the fish you've caught, collect better gear, and use it to explore deeper into the depths of the lake. But, be warned as no one knows what lies at the bottom of Lake Imperium. Do you really want to find out what lurks below...? Wretched Depths is a PSX-style horror-fishing game created by students in the University of Utah's Entertainment Arts & Engineering capstone class. Key Features: A dynamic fishing system A manageable, grid-based inventory An environment filled with unique fish Strange encounters wherever you look A system of equipment upgrades and collectables
row.short_description: Play as Sam and fish to your hearts content, sell fish you've caught, collect better gear, and use it to explore the depths of the mysterious lake, but be warned as no one knows what lies at the bottom. Wretched Depths is a PSX-style horror fishing game created by students at the University of Utah.
row.notes: The nature of this town is quite dark. Players will naturally find quite violent things around and in the lake as they fish. They may also encounter the occasional jump-scare as the game is played.

row.name: KILLING DREAMWORKS
row.detailed_description: Free Announcement To celebrate the launch of Black Myth Wukong, we have decided to open it to Steam users for free. We would like to express our sincerest gratitude to the users who have purchased the game before, and thank you for your strong support. About the Game It's a murderous adventure filled with whimsy, grotesque ghosts and high-powered weapons. It may take a little bit of strategic thinking and a little bit of luck to complete this big adventure. If you encounter setbacks, try a few more times and rationally allocate the resources in your hands, and there may be a solution. When you no longer meet the current difficulty of the game, remember to properly increase the number of monsters before the game starts, and you will discover a new world. QQ：883417277 Cards：Killing monsters has a chance to get rich cards. Draw cards to randomly get weapons, props, passive skills, etc., so that you can be full of combat power at any time. AI teammates：There are many different types of AI teammates with special skills in the game. Find and use their powerful abilities to help you complete the final mission. Squad mode：You can enter the squad mode at any time in the game to edit your squad formation or configure the cards you own to deal with various dangerous situations. Explore：Explore the rooms randomly distributed in the map, you can get rich rewards, of course, there are also things waiting for you in the room. Monsters：More than ten kinds of monsters are randomly generated on the map, each monster has special skills, you must know them very well, otherwise you will be wiped out at any time. Guard：Thousands of monsters will launch a general attack at the end, and you need to use the collected materials to fight them. Weather：A changeable and random weather system, each weather that is randomly and dynamically switched will have an important impact on the game process.
row.short_description: It's a murderous adventure filled with whimsy, grotesque ghosts and high-powered weapons. Find your AI teammates and form a powerful fighting squad. Draw your cards to get powerful props and skills. Collect all kinds of materials and fight against the tide of monsters hunting.

row.name: SKIRMISH
row.detailed_description: Destroy your friends in SKIRMISH! This Local-Multiplayer Top-Down Space Shooter is a blast! Be the last ship in one piece to be victorious! This is a 5-player local multiplayer game (4 controllers + 1 keyboard), but you can also play online thanks to the Steam Remote Play Together! First, select your color! Next, choose your ship! FIGHT! VICTORY! Blow up your friends in this free-for-all fun!
row.short_description: Destroy your friends in SKIRMISH! This Local-Multiplayer Top-Down Space Shooter is a blast! Be the last ship in one piece to be victorious!

row.name: Bullet Runner: The First Slaughter
row.detailed_description: Wishlist the main game About the Game This is the first act of Bullet Runner - a chaotic linear single-player shooter, packed with fast-paced and skill-based action. Fight your way through HORDES OF POWERFUL ENEMIES , execute combat strategies with quick reflexes to take on the biggest of the baddies. Use a wide variety of BIG FUCKING GUNS to take on the enemy your way! Customize your loadout with a wide variety of guns to fine tune your playstyle. Combine CRAZY MOVEMENT AND COMBAT MECHANICS to make your way through dynamic environments. Dodge, slide, swing and shoot your way to victory!
row.short_description: A clone army is taking over the world. Kill them all in an epic single-player campaign to save humanity, and yourself!
row.notes: Bullet Runner: The First Slaughter will contain Blood and Gore, Intense Violence and Strong Language.

row.name: Waven
row.detailed_description: In a flooded world where only a few islands have survived the rising waters, you play a seafaring adventurer searching for answers to this great upheaval. Long ago, gods and dragons ruled the world. Today, magic remains but what of the mythical beings of yesteryear? At the dawn of a new era, choose your hero, equip your best spells and set sail for an incredible odyssey. Sail from island to island in a vast world full of colorful creatures, gain power, refine your strategy and uncover the secrets of a world adrift. WAVEN is a new roleplaying game experience that is accessible, fun and immersive. It combines adventure and turn-based strategy, inspired by the best tactical RPGs, with deckbuilding mechanics and valuable items to collect. It can be played for free online on PC, Mac, smartphone and tablet. Alone or with friends, face off against multitudes of burlesque monsters of increasing difficulty. Master the elements, cast powerful spells, summon mythical companions and battle your enemies in close combat or from a distance to defeat them and win tons of loot! Gain experience to upgrade your hero and prove your valor by entering the doors of the 'Kolossium' to challenge other players and become a legend yourself! TACTICAL RPGs REVISITED WAVEN takes inspiration from the combat and progress systems of the best tactical RPGs while building on the strategic depth of turn-based combat and deck building. The result? An explosive and joyful combo! LIVELY TURN-BASED COMBAT Prepare your deck before each battle and use every ruse available to you to take home the victory! Play in your own style! Your options are practically unlimited when combining the many character archetypes, spells, equipment and companions available. ALL MODES ARE YOURS PvE, PvP : take advantage of each game mode to express yourself! Fight monsters to harvest resources and win equipment, and challenge other players to climb to the top of the rankings! PLAY AS A GREAT HERO Win battles, earn experience, spells and companions, customize your equipment and deck, and take your strategy to new heights. A CROSS-PLATFORM ADVENTURE Continue your adventure wherever you are! Enjoy WAVEN on PC, Mac, smartphone or tablet with the same account. AN ORIGINAL UNIVERSE WITH A UNIQUE GRAPHIC STYLE Explore a colorful heroic fantasy world inside a distinctive graphic universe, the 'Krosmoz', a persistent world that has existed for years in video games, animated series and much more.
row.short_description: Forge your own destiny! Choose your character, equip your best spells and sail from island to island in quest of fortune and glory. Level up your hero and your strategy in this free-to-play tactical multiplayer RPG with unique colorful graphics.

row.name: Brageskålen
row.detailed_description: Your choices matter Brageskålen is a Norwegian visual novel where the player's choices drive the story. You play as a young skald on Veøya in the year 986. An important part of the game is performing kvad, a nordic form of poetry which will influence how people view you, from romantic poems to heroic tales. The game's backdrop and story are based on historical sources. A big battle is brewing, and Veøya's warriors are sending ships to fight the Jomsvikings. A mystical curse flips everything on its head as the able-bodied men of Veøya all get sick. You and your friends are the only ones who can figure out who is behind the curse. Can you solve the mystery?
row.short_description: Travel to Veøya in the Viking Age and solve a dangerous mystery with cunning and song!
row.notes: Contains written descriptions of violence in a viking setting. Contains themes of death and slavery.

row.name: e-act Catcher for Akpala
row.detailed_description: [Important] Notice: 'e-act Catcher for Akpala' is a special auxiliary software. It cannot be played standalone. Cooperation with players who own the VR game 'Akpala' is required. This software invites 'Akpala' players and captures their gameplay in VR in real-time. It is the perfect software for video recording and organizing e-sports events. Not only for filming Akpala player's gameplay but also for hosting e-sports events and drama productions. Share the room ID with users who have 'Akpala'. Once VR players enter the room, start filming or hosting e-sports tournaments, etc. A PC version software that captures the VR experience of Akpala from a new angle. With 'e-act Catcher for Akpala', record the world of Akpala from a new viewpoint!

It offers up to 12 cameras, including fixed and overhead tracking ones, for innovative broadcasting with e-act Catcher

row.name: Puzzle Wizards
row.detailed_description: Puzzle Wizards is a cozy co-op cross-platform puzzle MMO from the creators of Puzzle Pirates. Master the harvest, crafting and battle puzzles to go on exciting adventures with friends in the wilds. Earn valuable resources and treasures to build and customize your village and home with furniture and decorations. Win funky familiars and craft fancy robes, hats, wands and more. Team up and work together with your fellow Wizards to build and decorate Guilds and restore the world! Seasonal event! Fairyland has been disrupted by the wicked SoloGro Bros, a cult-like group of technology entrepreneurs led by visionaries who believe that all anyone needs is SoloGro™, their terrible-tasting 'decentralized' energy drink. Help the poor Fairies throw off the yoke of these mono-crop fanatics by untangling their SoloGro vines, curing innocent crops infected by SoloGro™ fever, battling Bros who have had one-too-many Gro's and using their bean bombs to blow up their own infernal SoloGro Generators. Earn fabulous Fairy loot, furniture, clothes and familiars as rewards from grateful Fairies, build a Fairy house in your village and a Shop in your Guild to welcome them to the wizarding world. Puzzle Wizards is powered by three puzzles: Harvest, Mixing and Battle. Each have their purpose in the heartwood realms: Harvest: use your match-3 skills to gather resources from the world. Mixing: craft clothes, hats, wands, potions and other useful items with this line-drawing puzzle, whilst fending off the challenges of naughty ingredients. Battle: defeat the enemy spirits of the Wildwoods with the fast-paced battle puzzle, sliding to make four tile and larger matches and flipping attacks back to your foes. Voyage into the wildwoods on solo and co-operative adventures to gather resources, recipes and rare drops. Wilds are themed as Sun, Moon and Star with inner, middle and outer difficulties. Adventures are in quick, bite-sized chunks of around fifteen to thirty minutes of fun. Wildwood clearings can be chained together, increasing in difficulty as you progress. Difficulty is adapted to the number of players in your party -- it's possible to solo or play in a group of four or more -- and it's easy to drop in and drop out without stranding your team-mates. The arch-wizard has entrusted you with your own village. The place has fallen on hard times! You'll need to clear the tangled woods with magical sparks from adventures, rescue lost villagers, rebuild theirs shops and redecorate with crafted items and loot from the wilds. Build, expand and customize your own house and fill it with a menagerie of magical familiars. The village is your personal space and a solo progression path, developing your access to cosmetics and empowering items like wands, charms and potions. Puzzle Wizards has a full friend system and will add your Steam friends who are playing automatically. There is chat built-in to the game. You can also meet new friends adventuring and in Wizard Guilds. The game is friendly and co-operative: there's no place for negative behavior and bad language is filtered. Wizards band together to form Guilds to bravely explore the dangerous middle and outer wilds, facing down scary monsters and other spirits. You'll need to help out with construction work to build the Guild Towers that will grant your guild access to the most challenging wilds and lairs. Relax in the Wizards Tavern after adventures and challenge each other wand duels. In the future we'll be adding more social 'parlor' games and tournaments, too! Puzzle Wizards' content will expand with seasonal theme releases offering new adventures, loot and advanced gameplay challenges. Themes released so far: Halloween, Winterfest, Lunar Love Dragon and our current seasonal theme, Fairyland vs. the Sologro™ Bros.
row.short_description: Save Fairyland from the SoloGro™ Bros in this cozy co-op MMO from the creators of Puzzle Pirates! Adventure with friends to earn loot, furniture and clothes. Build and decorate your village and join a Wizards' Guild to help restore the world. Play cross-platform on Steam, iOS and Android.

row.name: 100% Challenge
row.detailed_description: Control the Core to capture objects of the same color and avoid touching those of a different color. Doing this will create a progress bar that, when completed, allows you to advance to the next level. If you touch the wrong colors, you will create a color barrier that will make it difficult to capture the right objects. You can eliminate it by touching it with objects of the same color. Complete the progress bar 10 times to beat the 10 levels and earn the maximum reward. Doing it quickly and without taking damage will give you the highest score. In each attempt, you will earn progress points that you can use to acquire new skills and go further and further. Single player modes : Tutorial will teach you the basics of the game. Arcade allows you to earn points by completing matches, with which you can unlock upgrades. Horde is an endless arcade mode where you can challenge yourself to see how far you can go. Ultimate Challenge is the real challenge where you can configure your skill tree and post your score on the World Ranking until you become the best. Two player modes : Coop is the Arcade mode where two players collaborate to progress and earn skill points. Versus is a Horde mode for two players where the last one surviving wins. Try pushing your opponent or swapping the color barrier with them! The Ultimate Challenge is a special game mode where you can configure which skills you want to activate. The more difficult you make it, the higher score you can get. The result you get in Ultimate Challenge can be posted on the World Ranking and show the world who is the best at the 100% Challenge. We love creating games, we are learning, and this is our first game! For this reason, we really appreciate constructive feedback that can help us improve. Please expect to find in this game a small, simple, arcade-style, casual, challenging, and replayable scoring game. The goal is to beat your previous record, unlock skills to go further and further, and compete for the best score worldwide. As it is a simple game, we have prepared a Demo version where you can learn and enjoy most of the available mechanics. If you feel like seeing everything, showing off your skills in the world ranking, or simply supporting us to continue with future projects, you can contribute by purchasing the full version. We have tried to add some extra modes that we hope you will really enjoy. Other features and accessibility Easy or difficult? We have tried to make a game with mechanics that are easy to understand and remember so that everyone can enjoy it. But we have also made sure that difficulty is a determining factor in progressing. We hope that the skills you acquire will allow everyone to achieve their own balance where they feel comfortable and have fun participating in the challenge! Colorblind mode : We know that the game mechanics require distinguishable color palettes, so we have included a modified color mode for colorblind people that can be activated in the settings. Unfortunately, we cannot verify its effectiveness, but we hope that everyone who wants to can enjoy the game. If you want us to improve any aspect of accessibility, you can also leave us a comment. Languages : We want the game to be accessible to everyone, so this page and part of the game content have been translated using an automatic translator. If we have included any errors or used inappropriate language, please let us know so that we can try to correct it. Attribution The SFX are royalty-free, and some of them were downloaded from FreeSFX and Freesound. The game soundtrack, as well as the music that can be heard in the trailer, is the work of Kevin MacLeod. You can find more information about the titles included in the credits within the game. Trailer track title: Rhinoceros Some cuts and small modifications were made to this audio track to adjust it to the needs of the trailer. You can listen to the original work on the author's website. Thank you! Thank you very much for taking the time to read this message. Good luck in your games!
row.short_description: Action arcade! CAPTURE enemies of your color and AVOID the rest to become the best in the world! Fast, addictive and 100% challenging!

row.name: Stellar Stroll
row.detailed_description: Embark on a thrilling interstellar journey with your fuzzy co-pilot in this exhilarating space adventure game. As your furry friend is a rookie in space exploration, your guidance and expertise will be crucial to navigate the perils of the cosmos. Key Features Master your spaceship: Pilot your craft with precision, utilizing your knowledge of physics and expert piloting skills to traverse the vastness of space. Protect your companion: Keep a watchful eye on your furry sidekick as you maneuver through obstacles, shielding them from harm by blocking incoming debris with your ship or guiding them to safety. Laser gun at your disposal: Utilize your spaceship's laser gun to blast away incoming space debris, clearing a path for both you and your fuzzy friend. Docking capabilities: Invite your companion to dock their ship with yours, allowing them to experience the awe-inspiring wonders of the universe up close and personal. Unforgettable cosmic journey: Explore the breathtaking beauty of outer space with your furry companion by your side, creating lasting memories as you uncover the mysteries of the cosmos together. Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure, piloting your ship and safeguarding your endearing partner as you uncover the marvels of the universe!

row.detailed_description: At the dawn of the world, two originary deities were created from humanity's most primal desires: the god Eros and the goddess Aphrodite. With the development of civilization, the flourishing of different desires and drives led to the birth of more and more deities, and eventually erupted in a Great War of the Gods. Eros emerged victorious, yet his betrayal at the hands of Aphrodite left him sealed away inside an ancient Relic, and the world abandoned to an age of godlessness. Several millennia later, various civilizations have flowered on the continent of Dienne, tenaciously clinging on in the absence of protection by the deities. While searching for a way to bring her boyfriend back to life, Inase, a scholar of ancient societies, accidentally breaks the seal and awakens Eros. To reclaim his powers and piece together his fragmented memories, he sets out on a journey with his newfound concubines… [AAA: The Next Generation in Adult Gaming] Rise of Eros is the world's first AAA-tier adult game. row.name: DFHack - Dwarf Fortress Modding Engine
row.detailed_description: DFHack is an add-on for Dwarf Fortress (search for it here on Steam!) that enables mods and tools to significantly extend the game. The default DFHack distribution contains a wide variety of these tools, including bugfixes, interface improvements, automation agents, design blueprints, modding building blocks, and more. Third-party tools (e.g. mods downloaded from Dwarf Fortress Steam Workshop or the forums) can also seamlessly integrate with the DFHack framework and extend the game far beyond what can be done by just modding the raws. DFHack’s mission is to provide tools and interfaces for players and modders to: expand the bounds of what is possible in Dwarf Fortress reduce the impact of game bugs give the player more agency and control over the game provide alternatives to toilsome or frustrating aspects of gameplay make the game more fun Our online Quickstart Guide (see the 'View the website' link in the sidebar) will help you get up to speed with how to use DFHack. It's also available in-game via the quickstart-guide command. The best way to make feature requests or report problems is to open an Issue on our GitHub issue tracker (see the 'Stats' link in the sidebar). When reporting problems, links to your zipped, uploaded savegame and mods are immensely helpful, and issues with attached savegames and mods get fixed faster. We need a zip of your mods because we can't load your savegame without them. DFHack installs directly into your Dwarf Fortress directory, so be sure to install it to the same Steam library and drive as Dwarf Fortress. If you are on Linux, both games must also have the same 'Compatibility' setting (e.g. 'Steam Linux Runtime 1.0 (scout)'). It is not a problem if you already have DFHack manually installed and are switching to Steam. You can subscribe to the Steam version and it will absorb the installed files. Your saved DFHack configuration in the dfhack-config directory is safe. No additional steps are necessary.
row.short_description: Extensions for Dwarf Fortress, including bugfixes, interface improvements, automation agents, design blueprints, modding building blocks, and other tools.

row.name: Scholar's Mate - First Move
row.detailed_description: In Scholar's Mate First Move you will play as Judith, a young college student who was going back home after finishing the semester. After waking up disoriented in an abandoned hospital room, she will try to escape and get back home safe. Exploration and ingenuity will be your only chance to get out of this strange and dark place alive. Will you succeed? A first-person horror experience in the purest 'EscapeRoom' style. Investigate, think and solve. Original voices and music.
row.short_description: Scholar's Mate First Move is a first-person horror experience in a psychiatric hospital. Use your wits to escape from this sinister place.

row.name: CETERIS Paribus
row.detailed_description: Kai is in big trouble! Economics homework is due tomorrow and it’s too late to study. Luckily, Professor Pavlos lives right next door! Pavlos will not only help Kai complete their homework on time, but also explain economics practically, through the different ways it affects our lives. Follow Kai across Pavlos’ house, discovering pieces of the old professor’s life in every room. Each piece teaches Kai something new about economics, in a simple and contextual way. Complete all rooms and finish Kai’s homework and you too will know the basics of economics! In Ceteris Paribus you will: Navigate a charming environment built in Unreal Engine; Experience a combination of classic point-and-click adventure and hidden object games; Discover open and secret rooms in Pavlos’ house, filled with memories and references to real historical events; Learn more about economics in a fun way, maybe understanding terms such as “inflation” and “cryptocurrency” for the first time; Decide for yourself if Pavlos is really a vampire or not. Kai is anxiously awaiting your help!
row.short_description: CETERIS Paribus is an educational point&click game aimed at providing basic economics literacy to players 13 and up. Kai is in need of last-minute help with their Economics homework and Pavlos teaches them concepts, terms and events through hidden-object and drag-and-drop mini-games.

row.name: On The Brink
row.detailed_description: Use Capri's gravity manipulation to slingshot across the universe as she embarks on a mission to liberate a forgotten dimension from the clutches of an all-powerful being. Solve puzzles, uncover mysteries, and shatter space-time itself in this snappy sci-fi action platformer. What lies in the dimensions above our own? An original sci-fi narrative set in the far reaches of the universe following Capri's fight to right cosmic wrongs and save PROJECT: Almagest . High-speed movement is interwoven with unique puzzle mechanics sure to engage hypothalamuses and prefrontal cortexes alike. Galaxy distribution across the universe is dynamic and infinite. Stay conscious, or be lost in the infinite aether. On The Brink has subtitles available alongside controller support for both Windows and Mac OSX. Recommended for third-dimensional beings. Playable in the second dimension, with decreased performance.

Heroes Stand Tall: M.E.T.A

Created as a personal project, it was developed to learn the full process of making and releasing a game on Steam. Set in a fast-paced PvP arena, players could choose from a small set of characters and weapons to compete in short, intense death matches. The focus was on core shooting mechanics, quick movement, and getting hands-on experience with FPS game design. This game is no longer in active development and will be removed from the store. It served as a valuable learning experience and a first step into game development.

row.name: IndependANT
row.detailed_description: THE COLONY HAS FALLEN! I mean, literally , the ant farm you call home has fallen off the table and smashed to pieces on the Living Room floor. What's worse: the Queen has gone missing in the chaos! Now leaderless and homeless, the ants of the farm are on the brink of starvation. As a brave worker ant, it's up to you to scour the unknown world of the Living Room for food. You'll explore the towering furniture, interact with the local ant population, and lay claim to all manner of delicious bug snacks! Do you have what it takes to become truly IndependANT? FEATURES: A small open world rich with detail! 4 delicious foods to find! 18 weird lil' ants to talk to! 20-30 minutes of gameplay, probably! WHY DID WE MAKE THIS? IndependANT is part of Young Horses: Free Range, where we collect our smaller side projects and release them for free! This game is a tech demo we made to help us get used to the Unreal 5 engine. It turned out well enough that we thought fans might enjoy playing it (but not so well that you might enjoy paying for it...) So give it a try! It's free, so there's only so disappointed you can be!

row.name: Kagura Survivors: Endless Night
row.detailed_description: Slay thousands of monsters and survive as the beautiful Shrine Maiden Kagura-chan. Kagura Survivors is a fantasy casual rouge-lite game where you must choose how to level up Kagura into a mighty Shrine Maiden. Battle thousands of monsters and survive if you can! Something is wrong in the Kaguraverse. An anomaly is creating tears in space-time and causing parallel worlds to converge! It falls upon Kagura-chan, the vessel of the Goddess's will, to get to the bottom of this crisis and return order to the various universes. If only it were that simple... As she steps through a rift to the Dimensional Crossroads, she finds that her powers are gone! With every portal she enters, she is reset to Level 1, no stronger than a fledgling adventurer. And to make matters worse, the forces of darkness are always close behind... Take up the sword and play as Kagura-chan, battling hordes of evil creatures across the rift in dimensions to solve the anomaly and set things right again.
row.short_description: Something is wrong in the Kaguraverse. An anomaly is creating tears in space-time and causing parallel worlds to converge! It falls upon Kagura-chan, the vessel of the Goddess's will, to get to the bottom of this crisis and return order to the various universes.

row.name: Wizard's watch
row.detailed_description: You are a wizard and your village is under attack. Push back the enemy forces with powerful spells. Burn, freeze, shatter and crush the enemy soldiers with your spells. Defend successfully the different parts of the village (the lumbermill, the farm, the town and the magic ruins) and defeat the evil boss to claim your victory. Gain XP as you kill your enemies and unlock upgrades for your magic powers. Unlock new wizard skins as you progress in the game and defeat your enemies with more power. Defend your village with the help of one of your friends in the multiplayer co-op mode !
row.short_description: You are a wizard and your village is under attack! Push back the enemy forces with powerful spells. Burn, freeze, shatter and crush the enemy soldiers with your magic powers. Gain XP as you kill your enemies and unlock upgrades for your spells.

row.name: Wild Omission
row.detailed_description: Wild Omission is an open world multiplayer sandbox survival game with severe weather set in an infinite procedurally generated world . Your goal survive, craft tools, and build bases that hold up against the most extreme weather. You can go at it alone, or with friends. Whether it's your friends, a wild animal, or a tornado , pretty much anything and everything can kill you if you aren't careful. You must start off with nothing, and pull together to overcome all odds. Use the resources you have gathered to craft tools, weapons, and shelter. Build the house of your dreams, The only limit is your imagination, and what you can craft. Weather is usually mild, but it can become deadly. Fortify your base and repair it when bad weather strikes. Bring your friends along with you to help (or to grief your base). Create a community!
row.short_description: Wild Omission is an open world sandbox survival game with severe weather set in an infinite procedurally generated world. Play alone or with friends.

row.name: OSLO:2084
row.detailed_description: DYSTOPIAN FUTURE In OSLO:2084, you take on the role of Embla, a brilliant and ambitious hobby hacker with a burning desire to challenge the status quo. The world around you is unrecognizable, a wasteland of desperation and oppression ruled by a merciless regime. The AI that once promised to bring order and prosperity has turned rogue, entrenching the powerful and suppressing the masses. As you explore the floating highs and lowest depths of Oslo's underbelly, you'll encounter a cast of eccentric characters and uncover dark secrets that will challenge your every belief. Can you rise up against the forces of corruption and rewrite the rules of the game? The future fate of humanity rests in your hands! KNOWLEDGE IS POWER Oslo:2084 is an educational and social impact game that promotes key values, including democratic data culture, engagement in democratic governance, and empowering players as agents for change. With immersive gameplay, Oslo:2084 aims to raise awareness about hate crimes and discrimination, while building empathy and understanding of the world around us. While the game itself is effective in engaging students, it's worth noting that the accompanying resource booklet - created in partnership with the European Wergeland Center and Utøya AS - can significantly enhance learning outcomes when used in conjunction with the game during teaching or other learning activities. Download these resources by clicking 'view the manual' on the right panel.
row.short_description: In OSLO:2084, hack your way through a dystopian world where AI rules supreme and democracy is a distant memory. As Embla, fight for freedom and change the course of history in this thrilling cyberpunk adventure.

After moving into the scenic woods of Your Average Campground, this black bear needs to prove himself to his new neighbors, and what better way to do so than to bring them the human foods their hearts desire? With the use of an animal-exclusive food-delivery app, take orders from your fellow animals, use your tools to evade campers and rangers, steal the delectable treats, and bring them back to your creature customers, all without getting caught!
