row.name: 群雄策・牌 Heroes Strategy・KARDS
row.detailed_description: join us We will pay attention to the comments of everyone in the Steam community in real time, and actively deal with the problems in the game for you: Twitter: Twitch: Facebook: YouTube: About the Game 'Heroes Strategy·KARDS' is a TCG card game with a relaxed competitive Hearthstone gameplay set in the Three Kingdoms. Players can summon hundreds of heroes of the Three Kingdoms to form troops to repel the enemy. The heroes mentioned here are cards in general games. During the game, players should adjust their card-playing strategy at all times according to the opponent's actual card-playing situation. Since the operation of playing and placing cards in the game needs to be done manually by the player, coupled with the interface similar to the poker table, it makes people feel like they are really playing cards. Battle interface In the battle of the game, players need to arrange and deploy their own combat strategies according to the situation of the opponent's cards, and the most important thing is to have a general understanding of the skills attached to each card in their hands. Entering skills Some cards have a sweeping effect that can deal physical damage to multiple cards of the enemy at once, while some cards have a meat shield attribute that can resist damage from enemy cards for their own heroes, and some can even deal with these damages rebound etc. And the effect of these cards will affect the balance of your victory in every battle. If you use it properly, you will have the power to defeat the strong with the weak. Card collection Of course, not all cards can allow you to have supernatural abilities. In the game 'Heroes Strategy Cards', you also need to adjust and filter your own card group, and strengthen your own cards. Only in this way can we survive in the next series of battles. It is worth mentioning that if some cards have a transformation effect in battle, they can have stronger attributes and effects after transformation. Such a transformation card will act as a decisive factor in the battlefield, thereby reversing the situation and completing a single kill. Heroes vying for the throne The PVP gameplay of 'Heroes Strategy·KARDS' is fundamentally different from other card games. Different from the value fight in the asynchronous arena, the PVP arena of 'Heroes Strategy Cards' is a synchronous online duel. This requires the two sides of the competition to connect through the mobile phone network and wifi to ensure that they are online at the same time. During the game, after one party plays cards, the other party can play cards to meet. A maximum of two heroes can be played each round. If all the heroes of one party die or the summoner dies, the game ends. Qualifying The game of 'Heroes Strategy·KARDS' provides a video mode, which is convenient for non-competitors to watch and communicate. In addition, there is a surrender mode in the game. If you encounter an opponent who is too powerful, admitting defeat directly is also a kind of respect for the opponent. Card attributes The hero cards in the game can enhance the attribute value of famous generals through functions such as advancement, star promotion, ascension, and transformation. General skills In addition to the special effects of the hero itself, in the game, you can also add more interesting effects to your heroes through enchantment. Matching different enchantments with the effects of famous generals can bring unexpected effects. You can try it, you may be pleasantly surprised! Compared with more card games, 'Heroes Strategy·KARDS' has more card game mechanisms and card content settings worth trying, plus a variety of heroes from the Three Kingdoms. Rich stories and grand battlefields, if you are a player who is interested in the heroes of the Three Kingdoms or card battles, then you might as well give it a try, the game 'Heroes Strategy·Kards' will definitely bring you Get some good gaming experience.

row.name: Project Apidom
row.detailed_description: From a team of passionate developers and gamers comes a multiplayer extraction RPG, combining elements of MOBA-like combat and RPG-like character builds. Leave the comfort of the Breach, the space between worlds, and come back to Pangea to fight back against ancient monsters and recover the remaining resources of the planet for your own survival. Once a thriving world of competing scientific factions, Pangea was invaded by the ancient monsters, forcing those factions to flee into the Breach and create Apidoms - mechanical robots, vessels of their consciousness - to return in their stead. They are fast and agile, yet lack the strength to fight back. They must be upgraded. With limited resources, Tech and Brute factions are forced to come back to the surface of Pangea. There they scavenge for materials and items, crafting and upgrading their Apidoms to fight against the monsters, and each other. On the surface, Apidoms are faced with constant and dreadful battles, fighting against both the monsters and other Apidoms. The survival of the fittest is the only way to live in a destroyed world, with newly discovered or crafted items allowing the Apidom to survive until the next encounter. Discover and craft a variety of weapon and armor sets to unlock endless possibilities for building your Apidom. Combine that with skill points gained from battle experience, and each Apidom becomes a unique tank, support, magician…whatever your heart desires, or the situation requires. Receive Shards and other loot from the battles to craft better items or upgrade the ones you have. Dismantle items you don't want and spend skill points to tailor your Apidom to your needs. There are no predetermined roles but the ones you make yourself!
row.short_description: Free-to-play multiplayer extraction RPG set in the apocalyptic future world of Pangea. Fight against enemies, both other players and monsters, for resources. Craft items and earn skill points to build an unstoppable Apidom that matches your playstyle.

row.name: Mindbug Online
row.detailed_description: New Game Mode: Mindbug Ascension Ascension: Roguelike Progression Mode Introducing Ascension, a new roguelike mode where your decisions and deck choices carry over as you progress. Build a unique path, discover powerful creatures, and challenge increasingly difficult encounters in a thrilling progression experience. With randomized encounters, evolving strategies, and permanent rewards, Ascension adds a fresh layer of depth to Mindbug for both new and veteran players. About the Game Unique Card Battler Mindbug takes the excitement of strategy card games and distills it into the most streamlined, skill-based dueling experience in the multiverse. Quick to pick up, endlessly strategic, and fair to all players. There’s no endless deck-construction, no random booster packs, and no complicated rules to memorize. Every decision matters, and every match feels fresh and unpredictable. Experience Meets Innovation Co-designed by Richard Garfield (Creator of Magic: The Gathering), Mindbug combines decades of TCG expertise with a groundbreaking, original game mechanic. The Mindbugs allow you to steal your opponent’s creature play twice per game — creating tense, mind-bending duels that reward strategy, timing, and skill. Crazy Card Abilities Mindbug is simple to learn but deep to master. Every card is powerful in the right situation, and every play can turn the game on its head. You’ll find yourself making meaningful choices from turn to turn, balancing risk, bluffing, and clever combos. The game is short, but each decision is super impactful. Fast and Intense Matches Play a complete game in under 5 minutes. Mindbug delivers rapid-fire duels that are easy to teach, fast to set up, and endlessly replayable. Perfect for a quick match with friends, a competitive showdown, or just a few minutes of strategic fun. Infinite Strategies Even though Mindbug is extremely easy to learn, the game will keep surprising you with new and exciting challenges and combos. The unique Mindbug mechanic allows you to control your opponents’ creatures and leads to unique decision-making that requires even veteran card game players to adjust their traditional playstyle. What are you waiting for earthling? Show your incredible skill and turn your opponents’ strongest creatures into your own advantage! Play Mindbug Online Now!
row.short_description: Mindbug redefines the card-battler genre, focusing on pure strategy and fast-paced excitement from the very first turn. You'll need to be quick on your feet and have lightning-fast reflexes to dodge obstacles and make sharp turns, all while trying to outrun your opponents. you'll need to go as fast as possible to outpace your opponents and win the race. Erin has a very important party to attend tonight... but a misunderstanding leads to her being fresh out of the shower with nothing at all to wear ! But one fateful day, her world is turned upside down when she steps out of the shower and realizes that all her belongings have vanished into thin air. row.name: HEX PLAT
row.detailed_description: About This Game The Game Is A Simple 2.5d Platform Action Game. The player can move and jump. That and solve puzzles using little gimmicks in the stages. Some of the stages are a bit meaner than others, but you'll get through them. How to Play The only controls in the game are A, D and Space on the keyboard; the UI controls use the mouse, but the basic parts of the game can be played with one hand. The objective of each stage is simple: manipulate the spheres to reach the red glowing tiles, that's it.

row.name: Space Expedition
row.detailed_description: Sequel to the game AVAILABLE NOW About the Game ' Space Expedition is an old-school platformer game that mixes different styles of play. It tells the story of a brave astronaut who wants to find out what happened on a faraway space station. Space Adventure Explore new places, solve puzzles, avoid traps, fight monsters, use machines, and fly spaceships—all in a pixel-art world! You’ll need to be smart to finish tasks, quick to escape danger, sharp to get past obstacles, and brave to fight enemies. This game is for real heroes! Get ready, put on your space suit, and charge your jetpack—the quest begins! Main Features Atmospheric Exploration: Enjoy a world with unique areas, beautiful landscapes, and strange creatures that spark your curiosity. Engaging Puzzles: Use your brain and problem-solving skills as you interact with the world, move objects, and work with the planet’s native creatures to move forward. Intuitive PC Controls: Play smoothly with easy-to-use controls made for PC, making your time in the alien world as fun as possible. Captivating Soundscapes: Lose yourself in the rich sound experience of Space Expedition, featuring an original soundtrack and sound design that matches the game’s look and feel. Mysterious Story: Learn the story of the alien planet as you explore its unknown areas. Find hidden artifacts, old ruins, and secret messages that show the world’s secrets and your purpose there. A Decade of Fun Originally released 10 years ago, Space Expedition has won the hearts of many players worldwide. Now, this classic game is free on Steam, allowing new players to enjoy it. Prepare for an unforgettable trip that goes beyond space and time. Learn the mysteries of the cosmos and explore an alien world full of wonder and excitement. Will you take the challenge and find the secrets of this mysterious place? Experience the Adventure Space Expedition is a game that keeps you on your toes. From dodging traps to fighting monsters, there is never a dull moment. Each level is carefully designed to test your skills and keep you engaged. Whether you are solving puzzles or piloting spaceships, you will always find something new and exciting to do. A World of Wonder The game world is full of unique biomes and mesmerizing landscapes that will captivate you. The pixel-art graphics and original soundtrack create an immersive experience that draws you in. As you progress through the game, you will uncover hidden artifacts, ancient ruins, and cryptic messages that reveal the planet's secrets and your purpose within it. Join the Adventure Space Expedition has been a favorite for many players over the past decade. Now, with its release on Steam for free, a new generation of players can experience its charm. Get ready to explore an alien world filled with wonder and intrigue. Will you rise to the challenge and uncover the secrets of this mysterious place?'
row.short_description: Space Expedition is a 2D sci-fi platformer where you play as an astronaut who is sent to a space station to collect samples of mysterious dark matter. Space Expedition combines puzzle platforming, pixel art, and atmospheric adventures set in the style of 1980s sci-fi horror films.

row.name: Landfall Archives
row.detailed_description: Break into the Landfall Archives and steal previously unreleased games, demos, interactive slide shows, and even an old version of TABS! Landfall Archives is a collection of every project Landfall and friends have worked on since 2016 that didn't make it to the shelves but which all deserve to see the light of day. This collection of 23 projects includes: Anything for my pals (2021) Control a herd of Pals to help you navigate through a short level with obstacles. Robots Forever (2018) Find weapons to fight modular robots! Every robot part has its own health and can be destroyed separately so you better watch out… Robots Forever 2 (2019) This game builds on the concept of modular robots from the first Robots Forever. Included are more robots with varying sizes and parts, as well as randomly spawning weapons with upgrades. Post Game (2019) Small building game where you build conveyor belts and other parts to move packages around a facility. The more packages you get into the containers, the more credits you collect! Physics Survival (2019) A physics animated top-down game where you explore and interact with the environment and animals to gather resources that you can use to get more equipment and units. TABS 2017 (2017) TABS 2017 is an early version of Totally Accurate Battle Simulator using the 2.0 physics system that was scrapped in 2017 in favor of the current 3.0 version. In the game you use a variety of different units to beat a level or you can play around in the sandbox mode. Airships 1 (2018) An exploration of airship building, using a system with different modular parts you can use to build your ship. Fly the ship around the landscape to explore! We imagined this to be a way to travel around in some of the other prototypes. Airships 2 (2018) Another version of airship building with different modular parts and improved stabilization for the airships, aiding in flying and construction. Wrecktangels (2019) Local PVP Simple side-view battle game where you jump and shoot each other while using a time-slow mechanic. The world is built out of objects that collapse and break apart as they are hit, to keep you on your toes! RTS card game (2021) Play cards to spawn units, and cast spells during real-time strategy gameplay. Build your own deck and combine cards to change which units and abilities are part of your deck. We made this to explore real-time card mechanics with some light RTS gameplay. Physics Fighter (2021) Brawl with enemies in small rooms, using your fist, legs, and a knife. The enemies have different attacks and patterns that they follow during fights to keep you on your toes. Medieval America (2020) Online PVP Physics shooter where you battle your enemy on a destructible level that collapses as the battle goes on, be careful not to fall! Plant Plane (2019) Go on a peaceful journey along the level in a plane, creating bushes and leaving nature around you as you fly past. Ocean Plane (2023) Fly around and fire small missiles at airships and towers, in and around an ocean. Playful (2021) Online PVP A 1v1 game where you can battle and play in different scenarios with your own rules and goals. It was made to be a sandbox to create your own small games in. Blob Game (2018) A small experience of being locked in a room with an unknown creature while a voice speaks to you. There are a few different endings to this game, can you find them all? Walking House Game (2021) Prototype for a building game where you control and build a walking castle. Travel to explore and gather resources around you to build and upgrade your base. Beware of the enemies lurking nearby! Missile Game (2021) Control missiles and fly them through different levels with varying obstacles to bring down physics towers, with the goal of destroying the small objects you find in the structures. Creepy Robots (2017) Run and climb around a small town scene while being chased by humanoid robots! ROUNDS 3D (2022) Online PVP Prototype for a 3-dimensional version of the game ROUNDS. It’s mainly explored with the shooting mechanics and a handful of upgrades. Counts and Stakes (2020) Online PVP A vampires vs vampire hunters-themed top-down-shooter focusing on precise aiming. Play against other players in small arenas with physics obstacles that you can interact with. Physics Presentation (2018) Not exactly a game, but more of an interactive slideshow made to be used as a presentation explaining the principles of the physics used in Landfalls games. Auction Brawl (2017) 2-4 Local Splitscreen Split screen fighting game where you bid on items that you then use to brawl against the other bidders. You can also grab and use most other items in the auction room to fight your fellow players!
row.short_description: Break into the Landfall Archives to steal and play previously unreleased games, demos, interactive slide shows, and even an unreleased version of Totally Accurate Battle Simulator from 2017!

row.name: Jump Puzzle
row.detailed_description: A platform jumping puzzle game, Reasonable use of various abilities of different animals, Keep the unicorn from falling into the abyss, Find your way home. Simple game operation, just choose the direction and jump Rich game experience, plots with different functions constitute unique levels Sometimes some plots are needed, move or rotate it. Sometimes some plots are not needed, break or move it Sometimes different heights are required, ascend or descend it It even sometimes requires bumping to solve puzzles And all it takes is choosing a direction, jumping. In short, simple operation and extreme thinking are the core of the game
row.short_description: A platform jumping puzzle game, Reasonable use of various abilities of different animals, Keep the unicorn from falling into the abyss, Find your way home.

row.name: Shapes & Shots - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Shapes & Shots is a Roguelite Shooter Bullet-hell , where you can control time as you make your way through a twisted and delusional universe. Your enemies will merge, creating infinite combinations to try to overwhelm you: only your skills, combined with the variety of upgrades you choose, can lead you to victory. When it gets tough out there and you realize there is no cover, or when you are about to be overwhelmed by a barrage of bullets... Stop everything, take a deep breath, and reposition yourself behind the enemies. Unload all your might against them and turn the tide. In this universe, enemies can merge, combine the power of their weapons, and gain unique characteristics. Take care of them before they realize that unity is strength. Challenges will increase: you must level up to increase your base characteristics. Choose whether to enhance the ability to control time or to increase mobility and damage. But that is not all. In your climb to victory, you will find many chests that will grant you access to unique game-changing powers!

The character played by the player enters a virtual world, but a fault occurs during the entry process, causing the player to lose some memory. The only thing to remember is that the task is to find and establish a close connection with an important girl here. In this process, gradually retrieve memories and use various means to achieve goals. Provide companionship, assistance, or services (massage, etc.) to girls in daily life to enhance their liking for you, break through layers of spiritual and physical barriers, and ultimately form a strong connection with the girl to complete the final task. Free map, you can enter any room to find girls to interact with. In the game, you can also edit and change the appearance of girls' clothing, and after unlocking the action, you can 'recall' it at any time to view it.

row.name: 三千零一页 3001 Pages : a fairy tale for 33
row.detailed_description: 游戏概述 在一个对所有人来说都无比普通的清晨，她翻开书，为你轻声讲述一个童话。它可能是一群动物在钢铁丛林中的冒险，可能是一位动物骑士披荆斩棘的反攻，也可能是深海中等待被人遇见的泡沫美人鱼……三千零一个相互陪伴的夜，三千零一个彼此守护的简单故事，他们都想告诉你这样一件事——要永远相信，童话，骑士，还有魔法。 ——关于这款游戏—— - 游戏内容 GAME CONTENT - 本作品将是一部值得收藏的童话故事集，其中包含持续更新的多个童话故事及相关外传、电子收藏。 随着您对这些故事的体验与发掘，您将获得我们精心准备的电子收藏、精美CG和 可能存在的 全新动态主页面，为您的游戏提供更多装饰可能。 希望您享受这些童话，在纷扰的现实生活中寻找一分纯净。 - 角色 CHARACTER - #三三# 天真烂漫的可爱女孩，喜欢唱歌、跳舞，她很喜欢小动物，所以养着两只小猫，平时也在投喂其他小狗小猫。 不知道为什么她总能逢凶化吉，或许和也在悄悄陪在她身边的两个小精灵有关？ #啵啵骑(男)# 种族是传说中的大耳狗，与啵啵骑（女）是同甘共苦的挚友。 喜欢吃喝玩乐以及任何有趣的东西，大大咧咧的外表下藏着一颗细腻的心，是一个在关键时刻值得信赖的家伙。由于思维太过跳脱经常惹出麻烦，好在他身边一直有挚友的陪伴，为他善后。 #啵啵骑(女)# 种族是传说中的大耳狗，与啵啵骑（男）是同甘共苦的挚友。 喜欢阅读、创作，喜欢三三，平时是非常可靠的存在，经常给自己的挚友善后，也因此她对待自己的挚友没有对待他人来的温柔。据说都市怪谈里“暴力女魔头”的传闻与她有关。 #真相# 一只“可爱”的加菲猫，喜欢睡觉、吃东西、找乐子，是三三养的两只小猫中的一位。 不到一岁的他，有着与其他同龄猫相仿的好奇心，但是天性慵懒的他并没有去满足好奇心的体力，不过，跟她主人一样，在某些方面有着远超常人的执拗。但在大姐富贵面前，他怂的一批。 #乐子# 一只“可爱”的加菲猫，喜欢吃东西、睡觉、害怕真相，是三三养的两只小猫中的一位。 不到一岁的他，有着与其他同龄猫相仿的好奇心，但是一位“友善”哥哥的存在，严重影响了这只小猫探索世界的进程。 不过不用担心，他已经在寻找躲避哥哥的“爱”的方法了。比如，去寻找二姐荣华的帮助。 #荣华# 一只黑乎乎的龙猫，是三三曾经的宠物现今的守护灵之一。是三三宠物中的二姐，有些呆萌，平时喜欢以恶魔的形态出现在三三身边。 比起大姐富贵，她对待两只小猫还算温柔，但还是喜欢和富贵一起调侃两个弟弟。 #富贵# 一只雪白的长毛兔，是三三曾经的宠物现今的守护灵之一。是三三宠物中的大姐。有些坏心眼，平时喜欢以天使形态出现在三三身边。 喜欢戏弄调侃弟弟妹妹，但面对自己的主人三三，她总是很温柔。 - 声明 STATEMENT - 本作品为B站up主@啵啵小狗341及其宠物、粉丝形象的二创改编游戏，游戏内容不涉及现实事件，仅为表达陪伴而作。 制作组在游戏制作及发布的过程中 未获得任何收入 。 祝您游玩愉快~
row.short_description: 她翻开书，为你轻声讲述一个童话。它可能是一群动物在钢铁丛林中的冒险，可能是一位动物骑士披荆斩棘的反攻，也可能是深海中等待被人遇见的泡沫美人鱼……三千零一个相互陪伴的夜，三千零一个彼此守护的简单故事，他们都想告诉你这样一件事——要永远相信，童话，骑士，还有魔法。

row.name: Realm of Simplicity MMORPG
row.detailed_description: DESCRIPTION Realm of Simplicity is an indie-developed open world MMORPG set in a medieval fantasy where you will embark on your own adventure. Complete quests, master your skills, trade loot with others or befriend them in a party to conquer the mightiest of monsters! FEATURES A massively multiplayer online persistent world Challenging PvPvE dungeons Party system to adventure with your friends Player-driven economy Unique monsters with different AI Self-contained quests No classes, instead you are what you wield Never Pay-to-Win
row.short_description: Realm of Simplicity is an indie-developed open world MMORPG set in a medieval fantasy where you will embark on your own adventure. Complete quests, master your skills, trade loot with others or befriend them in a party to conquer the mightiest of monsters!

row.name: Grimm of the Dome
row.detailed_description: In this non-linear adventure game made by only one jobless poet, your choices and dices will lead people in this Utopia or Distopia to different endings. Wander in the last city of human civilization as Agent Grimm Roll the dice to stop at a random point of the daily patrol as an Archival Division agent. Drop pins on the map to stop at a designated point and advance the investigation. Meet with various people and witness/influence their unique lives. Help the 'super magistrate AI' to investigate the mystery cases Investigate the sudden suicide of the most influential religion leader of the city, with neither omen or last words, but wired manner of death destroying the implant chips, and an unknown intruder at the scene. Investigate the returnal of dead people, and their possible connections to the illicit psychotropic substances and uncontrolled AI. Investigate the religious group which has over 1/4 of human population as their adherents and their dangerous scientific research projects. Meet with the Ai-worship religion, the gangs, those who are challenging the distinction between humans and androids, and other residents of the Dome City. Wander in the city constructed by an over 200,000-word parable of science and politics. Play through tens of side stories, and encounter people of unique characteristics and history. Unlock all 4 different endings, leading the city to its utopia or distopia future. **The English translation is currently based on machine translation. A manually-verified translation will soon be updated in the patch v1.01. **
row.short_description: In this last city of mankind, an isolated paradise in the ocean, your choices and dices will lead it to Utopia or Distopia. You will help the magistrate AI to investigate the AI-worship religious group, illicit drugs, those who were resurrected, and those who are neither android nor mankind…

row.name: Darksy's Adventure
row.detailed_description: Darksy's Adventure is a 3D platformer with furry characters and abstract 3D worlds. It was to be another regular day for Darksy but on his way to work he got captured. Luckily, using his cunning observation and thinking he managed to escape. Having been left far from home, Darksy must now make his way home. Join Darksy on his long journey through deadly yet colourful areas filled with deadly foes who want to stop him. Features: 19 standard level in total, each with their own soundtrack 6 unique boss fights 6 massive worlds: The Forest, Pirates Ocean, Wild Furry West, Catastrophic City, Construction Site, Underwater Factory Character customization 4 special abilities: Speed Boost, Magnet, Super Darksy and Invisibility 13 secret retro levels that can be accessed by finding secret game cartridges In game Cutscenes Fun base abilities including: Pounce, Tail whip and shooting atoms 3 difficulty settings
row.short_description: Darksy's Adventure is a 3D platformer with furry characters and abstract 3D worlds. Tail whip and pounce your way to victory!

row.name: Fallen Force
row.detailed_description: Wishlist the game if you find it interesting!❤️ Gameplay In Fallen Force enemy is dead only if you punch him off the edge of arena. You have to use clever positioning, mix of fast light attacks with strong charged attacks and special abilities that grant you temporary edge over your enemies while avoiding getting punched yourself. Survive 20 rounds of endless enemy waves, upgrade yourself and become an unstoppable force. Customization You have the option to create your own player. Choose one of many characters, weapons and abilities with thousands of options from the start and buy as many upgrades to create the most powerful build possible. Punch them, shoot them, burn them, freeze them and push your enemies out of arena whatever way you want, for that is the only way to win...
row.short_description: Rogue-lite arena shooter, where you kill monsters by knocking them out of arena. Shoot them, punch them, freeze them, burn them and much more in this unique take on a genre.

row.name: The Twin Paradox
row.detailed_description: The Twin Paradox is an RPG in which you must prepare yourself for the first time travel. Explore the 'Beyond' laboratory and interact with its scientists. Learn physics concepts that will help you understand how time travel could work in real life, as well as a bunch of interesting things from other sciences. Math-Free If math isn't your thing, don't worry! This isn't the classic game where you have to do mathematical operations to defeat enemies. Characteristics Scientists from various fields who will teach you many things. You will learn Einstein's famous special relativity. Very interactive map for exploration enthusiasts. Immerse yourself in your character because your actions will have consequences. Can you find all the references and easter eggs?
row.short_description: The Twin paradox is an RPG where you must prepare yourself for the first time travel. Make decisions, explore, and learn real science with the scientists of the 'Beyond' laboratory. It's up to you to make the journey a success.

row.name: Aker Fern 2 : Demo
row.detailed_description: Get to know the first episode of the story created by Chaos Group Games. Full version available on Steam on the Aker Fern 2 website _______________________STORY_______________________ Aker Fern 2 : Demo - presents us the story taking place after what happened in the original Aker Fern from 2020. Dan Tern and Tatiana Mika find certain place hiding a certain mystery about Mikołaj Fern , the last incarnation of our protagonist. As a result of their pursuit after it something that will be the turning point for the story in next chapters of the game. _______________________CHARACTERS_______________________ Dan Tern The protagonist. He is a young man who tries to enjoy his normal life. What distinguish him from others is the fact he remembers his memories and experiences of his previous life . „After my death people conspiring against my family decided to use the opportunity and did so in the most dirty way they could, by putting the curse on my soul.” Tatiana Mika Extremely curious and stubborn. Tatiana Mika helps Dan from time to time in matters of his interest, she is doing it ever since he saved her from the Last Devil . She has an unusual glove on her right hand which is a control device for a device called Nano cube allowing her to obtain even the most secured information . „I feel a bit sorry for the taxi driver though. I thought he was about to get a heart attack the moment he saw Dan carrying Ajris' body. The only thing that was missing was a question if he had a shovel to borrow. „ Lena She is a part of organization having as objective researching and solving the dangerous situations caused by paranormal phenomena. Due to her responsibilities she is using help from Dan because of knowledge he obtained as Mikołaj Fern . Lena is also caretaker of Karen . „ You are impossible, Dan Tern. To come to us with this sleeping girl and expect us to wake her up despite the obvious danger it brings.”. Ajrs Ajris was traveling with Mikołaj Fern. When he died and his soul has been cursed by opponents of his family, it was Ajris who became the person who allowed him to rest in peace. Sadly she paid with life for it . As a ghost she has been waiting for his return to this world. When it happened and he recovered his past memories she was finally noticed by him. Since then she is accompanying him in his new life. „ You don’t have to be afraid of me. After what I saw I’m convinced that you are way more terrifying than me.” ______________________EKIPA________________________ _______________________OPENING______________________ ___INFORMATION ABOUT OUR PROJECT CAN BE FOUND ON OUR SOCIAL MEDIA___
row.short_description: As Mikołaj Fern I have been travelling and experiencing many adventures along the way. I was considered an antagonist by most of people from that era. Over five hundred years have passed until I came back to live as Dan Tern. As him I will lead a certain story that never reached its definitive end.

row.name: Scott Whiskers in: the Search for Mr. Fumbleclaw Playtest
Dippy & Chippy
row.detailed_description: Dippy & Chippy is a thrilling two-player co-opetition promoting the game that takes you on an epic adventure through a world filled with danger and excitement. In this action-packed game, you'll take control of a two-headed ogre and work together with your partner to fight your way through hordes of skeletons and other monsters. Using a single controller, you and your partner must coordinate your movements and attacks to overcome the challenges that lie ahead. With intuitive controls and challenging gameplay, Dippy & Chippy is perfect for gamers of all skill levels. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter a variety of environments and enemies, each with its own unique challenges and dangers. You'll need to stay alert and use all your skills to survive. Featuring stunning graphics and an immersive soundtrack, Dippy & Chippy is a game that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. So grab a friend and get ready for an unforgettable adventure in this exciting and engaging game. Key Features Test your bond! - 2 players on a single controller responsible for 1 ogre. Co-ordinate, and communicate to move and kill enemies. Immersive feedback - Each element has curated VFX and SFX feedback to keep 2 players engaged and comfortable Variety of challenges - Each level brings new enemies/traps and compelling coordination from the players! Players from all skill levels! - Dippy & Chippy can be played with players with vastly different skill gaps without being unfair.
row.short_description: Join forces with your best friend and embark on a thrilling adventure as the two-headed ogre duo, Dippy & Chippy, in the ultimate two-player couch coop game of exploring dungeons and discovering treasures!

row.name: Continent of the Ninth Golden
row.detailed_description: Continent of the Ninth Golden is an action MORPG. Players take part in the game as heroes of Blenheim to stand against Nefer, an evil villain trying to open a gate to the Netherworld and swarm the land with his infernal legion. C9 showcases quality visuals, strategic combat, and a gripping story. Choose a character that best represents how you want to experience the game. The five base classes -- Fighter, Hunter, Shaman, Witchblade, and Mystic -- can each upgrade into multiple advanced classes, all of which are unique in their skills, visuals, and play styles. The console-like controls, various skill combos, and RPG-based elements make C9 a satisfying choice for all fans of action games. Key Features: Unrivaled Action RPG Continent of the Ninth Golden is a wholly unique action MMORPG experience. With its non-targeting combat, you no longer have to suffer with “locking on” to a single enemy! C9 gives you the freedom to lay waste to any enemy foolish enough to get in range of your sweeping weapons. This unique system has earned C9 five awards, including Grand Game Award Korea in 2009. Various Skill Combos Enjoy the complete freedom of combining skills and commands with cancellations and evasions to create an almost unlimited number of combos. Chain your attacks together and see just how much damage you can do in a single frenzy of attacks! Hack through every enemy that gets in your way! Precise Controls C9 features precise, customizable controls using either a mouse and keyboard or a gamepad. Unlike other RPGs, the way you control your character determines whether or not you survive! No more pushing the same four buttons over and over in a tedious rotation. Your hands will never be at rest during combat. With enough skill and practice, you can learn how to juggle and control your enemies with such precision they never have the chance to fight back! PvP Player versus player is a core element of C9. Players can use the combos they have perfected in various PvP modes. Use your skills with just the right timing, and chain your combos together perfectly to secure your victory! Ultimate Fury Skills Ultimate Fury Skills are the most powerful skills a player can learn. These skills boast supreme damage with very impressive visual effects. Each advanced class has its own, unique ultimate fury skill. Diverse Content C9 allows you to enhance items, build guild housing, craft items, and remodel equipment; very popular features for players of online RPGs. The game also features a unique Legend system to display your in-game achievements to other players and express the personality of your character.
row.short_description: Continent of the Ninth Golden is an action MMORPG. Players take part in the game as heroes of Blenheim to stand against Nefer, an evil villain trying to open a gate to the Netherworld and swarm the land with his infernal legion.

row.name: The Lancaster Leak - O'Brien State Park
row.detailed_description: Episode 1 - O'Brien State Park Missing persons happen at state parks all the time, with most never receiving closure. However, after an FBI investigation tape was leaked, new light is shined on a missing person case all the way back from 1985. You Control the Found Footage Experience the investigation tape firsthand as the FBI annotates events. Immersive Graphics and Sounds Jam-packed visuals, effects, and sound design that create a stunning VHS style. Only the Beginning This is only the first of many tapes leaked by FBI intern Valerie Bardot. There seems to be a bigger picture, slowly being revealed by whoever tampered with the tapes post-leak. EPISODE 2 COMING SOON! Key Features 15-20 Minute walking simulator Jumpscares Story Heavy
row.short_description: YOU CONTROL THE FOUND FOOTAGE. An FBI intern leaked special investigation tapes before suddenly disappearing. The first tape of the series contains found footage from O'Brien State Park revealing the true events that were covered up in the 1980s.
row.notes: Jumpscares, blood, and depiction of dead animals

row.name: Untitled Ghost Game
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Untitled Ghost Game, a spine-tingling 2D ghost hunting adventure brought to you by a small but dedicated team of developers. Interactive items and several unique maps Step into the shoes of a paranormal investigator armed with an arsenal of ghost hunting equipment, including an EMF reader, a Luigi board, a thermometer, a clock, a spirit box, a sketchbook, and a geiger counter. Explore a variety of creepy locations, including Mario's Cottage, Leonardo's Villa, Haunted Boardwalk, and the Spooky Mall. Gameplay mechanics and loop Your objective is to use your equipment to locate the ghost and ghost room to see how it interacts with the environment, items, and hiding places. Once you have gathered enough information, it's up to you to make an educated guess about the type of ghost you're dealing with. Once you've made your guess, the exorcist can come in and take care of the ghost. Ghost interactions and music But beware - ghosts can be unpredictable and dangerous, so be sure to keep your wits about you. With atmospheric visuals, spooky sound effects, and a haunting (badass) soundtrack from the musical artist Sodaguyz, Untitled Ghost Game will keep you on the edge of your seat. So join us on this bone-chilling journey into the unknown, brought to you by a small passionate team of indie developers who are dedicated to bringing you the best in 2D ghost hunting gameplay.
row.short_description: Free multiplayer 2D ghost hunting game that you can play with friends created by a small game dev team.

row.name: 스쿨라이프
row.detailed_description: Synopsis 'Where is your memory?' What does love mean to high school students? Even if you can't give a philosophical and outrageous answer, it's undeniable that it's a top priority concern for hot-blooded youth in the thick of it. Who went out with whom, and who broke up again yesterday. Any classmate will listen when a story like this comes up in class. Love... Love... Was it just spending time fooling around with friends? I had never been in a relationship, and had little interest in it. but... Game features Three heroines 3-4 hour play time High quality CG
row.short_description: School Life is a visual novel game with a school background and a light atmosphere.
row.notes: There is an indirect description of suicide and cuss word There are no other sexual, drug and alcohol abuse, or self-harming factors that could offend the player.

row.name: Roguebot
row.detailed_description: Roguebot is a fast-paced third person action-roguelite in which the player must fight their way to the top of a futuristic facility. Armed with a plethora of firearms and melee abilities you get to control a small robot on its journey through three distinct biomes. The deeply interwoven story unfolds as you find mysterious satellites that lie scattered in this ominous environment. No run is the same as the floors are procedurally created. COMBAT SYSTEM Fast paced action, by combining different types of ranged and melee attacks. Responsive movement to dodge enemy attacks. By collecting config shards after defeating bosses, you can unlock different abilites that influence many gameplay mechanics. MODULAR EQUIPMENT Strategically decide what modifications to buy with machine parts dropped from enemies. Freely combine over a dozen of equipment modifications with different rarities, allowing for high build variety. Discover many synergies between different equipment mods and abilites. PROCEDURAL LEVELS No run will be the same, each floor has a generated layout, with thoroughly thought out rules and conditions taken into account. 3 distinct sections that differ in enemy types, level geometry, environmental hazards and visual theme. Each section is guarded by a unique boss fight. THEME AND LORE What starts out as an unassuming sci-fi game quickly turns into a discussion about morality and the human condition. Read through three meticulously crafted stories of humans in the past. Unveil their fate as you go. The cyclical nature of the Roguelite genre becomes a story-telling tool. Learn more about the world and lore by talking to NPCs.
row.short_description: Fast-paced Roguelike shooter in a dystopian steampunk future.

row.name: 黑貓：逆光｜Black Cat：Back Light
row.detailed_description: 「至高無上是飛行，慇勤寄盼，莫負好青春。」——〈 西子姑娘〉 【遊戲方式】 為第一人稱 3D 角色扮演解謎遊戲，玩家將以「古董底片相機」探索「前空軍桃園基地設施群」，在黑貓的帶領下，拍下並收集指定影像，追尋冷戰歷史的軌跡。 遊戲時長約 15 至 30 分鐘，玩家須依指示完成五項主要任務，於過程中認識黑貓中隊，以及走訪「前桃園空軍基地設施群」部分場域。 【故事背景】 冷戰期間，暗夜中，臺美密切合作《快刀計畫》，在中國大陸高空執行偵察任務。臺灣派出黑貓中隊飛行員，飛向七萬英呎的高空，每位飛官在執行任務期間，都有屬於自己的故事。但落到地面，回到眷村，他們也只是尋常的人父、人子。 時間快轉至 2025 年。曾是黑貓中隊總部，如今已成為市定古蹟的「前空軍桃園基地設施群」，經整修後，來到預備對外開放的階段。 而在開放前，桃園市文化局邀請職業攝影師，進駐攝影為設施群留下紀錄，同時也接受大專院校師生以研究為目的，申請參訪園區。 主角攝影師阿誠，從小在養父「老張」耳濡目染之下，培養出攝影興趣並以此為業。但成長過程中，因認為養父固執難以溝通，逐漸與養父產生隔閡。在一次劇烈爭吵後離家，直到養父逝世，都沒有解開心結。 這次為了工作，阿誠拿起養父生前送的萊卡 M3 相機，來到前桃園空軍基地設施群，遇見了正在參訪的臺美混血研究生 Penny，並在神秘黑貓的引領下，鮮為人知的過去在鏡頭裡逐漸聚焦成形，阿誠開始發現一些養父的過去⋯⋯ 【商品特色】 根據史料，高度還原真實場景。 精緻 3D 建模，復刻 U-2 偵察機原貌。 採第一人稱視角設定，參與趣味解謎任務。 以地方文史為基礎，富含教育意義。 完全免費！ 【特別說明】 本遊戲以 3D 場景為主，過程較容易因視覺效果，引發頭暈、噁心等症狀。請玩家特別留意，如有任何不適，應適時進行休息。
row.short_description: 〈黑貓：逆光〉藉由冷戰期間，臺美密切合作《快刀計畫》的過往，帶領玩家以「古董底片相機」探索「前空軍桃園基地設施群」，在黑貓的指引下，拍攝並收集指定影像，追尋冷戰歷史的軌跡。

row.name: Fingernail Floss
row.detailed_description: DEAR [email recipient], YOU ARE FORMALLY INVITED TO BE NEXT * the next PLAY OF OUR LATEST PINECONE PRODUCT! ITS A BENEFIT FOR MY ENTERTAINMENT AND YOUR WALLET AND MY WALLET! PLAY NOW! THE GAME IS FREE! ITS SHORT! IT'S A STEAM GAME! ------------------------------------------------- Fingernail Floss is a short visual novel where you and your friends must overcome deadly trials in a twisted death game. Experience the strange world and characters of Fingernail Floss! This game features lore! Save states! Loading save states! Obstacles the cast of characters must overcome! Fingernail Floss is a story-focused game that lets you truly experience what it's like to be low-budget test subjects! ------------------------------------------------- THE GAME FEATURES: - ABOUT AN HOUR OF FUN! - AN ENDING! - MSPAINT GALORE! - (THIS TEST DOES NOT PROVIDE FREE DENTAL!) (CONTENT WARNING: This game features themes of Death, Gore, Depression, Suicide & Violence!)
row.short_description: A short spooky-fun visual novel where you are a special guest for a special test! Is death a game to you? Do you like color schemes that involve the color black? EXPERIENCE FINGERNAIL FLOSS! !
row.notes: This game contains themes of Death, gore, suicide, depression, and violence!

row.name: Overwatch® 2
row.short_description: Overwatch 2 is a critically acclaimed, team-based shooter game set in an optimistic future with an evolving roster of heroes. Team up with friends and jump in today.
row.reviews: “Overwatch 2 Stadium is a mode so unique to what the hero shooter has to offer that it almost feels like an entirely new spinoff.” Destructoid “...an action-packed and enjoyable progression of the beloved hero-shooter franchise. Overwatch 2 is a big step towards restoring the faith in the franchise and has me thinking it’s time to pour a few more hundred hours into my favorite team-based shooter” 9/10 – Game Informer “...an evolution of the intense, nuanced, and brilliantly colourful team-based battle that made its predecessor so enjoyable.” 8/10 – IGN

row.name: Starwulf - Seeker of Secret Space Playtest
Agents of SomeCompany
row.detailed_description: See the world through the eyes of SomeCompany 's agents. Gain and use parkour abilities to become the fastest in the world. Follow company's plan and don't forget to take your pills... Double jump, wallrunning, stomp and dash - utilize them all to complete the levels quickly. Fight with your foes using bow and sword, gain time by defeating them and don't let them kill you. Run as fast as you can through six chapters of levels with different low-poly environments and distinctive music. Reach bronze, silver, gold and ultimately diamond medal. Prove you're a valuable asset for the company. Compete with other players and become the most renowned agent in the world.
row.short_description: Unleash your speedrunning skills and complete your missions as fast as you can in this first-person parkour platformer. Speed through the low-poly world and compete with other players to prove you're SomeCompany's best agent.

row.name: StackHoops
row.detailed_description: How To Play Make the shot and add to the Cash Pot. Copy your opponent's shot and add to the Cash Pot. Miss the shot that your opponent made and your opponent takes the Cash Pot. The first player to reach $1000 wins the game! Features FREE TO PLAY. Purchases for cosmetics only. Online Multiplayer. Single Player 1v1 and Challenges. Rewards for winning Online and completing Challenges.
row.short_description: A casual multiplayer basketball-like game. Play against your friends, random matchmaking, or against the computer. Customize your ball, court, and more to showoff to the world and win in style. Complete challenges and prove your skills!

row.name: The Jeffy Game
row.detailed_description: Experience the adventure of a lifetime through the eyes of Jeffy. DEFEAT THE GREEN BEANS, COLLECT THE CEREAL BOXES, AND CLAIM VICTORY! Each carefully crafted level will leave you wanting more with its innovative puzzle elements and thought-provoking worlds. DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES? Throughout your journey you will encounter different types of enemies and obstacles that you must overcome. SECRET LEVEL! If you collect all of the hidden cereal boxes you will unlock a secret level in which you will discover lore relating to the Kable10 universe. After you have finished the game you can also unlock Golden Jeffy which allows for even more replayability and fun!
row.short_description: The Jeffy Game is an outrageously fun 2D platformer where you play as Jeffy and embark on the adventure of a lifetime! Defeat the evil green beans, collect the cereal boxes, and discover hidden surprises! Now available on Steam!

row.name: GraalOnline Era
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the world of GraalOnline Era, a modern 2D action MMO RPG. Purchase weapons and work with a gang to compete in activities such as special events, base capturing and PvP battles in the Spar Complex, or start your own gang and chart your own path! There are a ton of unique weapons available. Melee weapons for close quarters or take out your enemies from long range with guns! Complete quests to access other items to boost your arsenal. Character customization is a staple of GraalOnline! There are thousands of hats and outfits with the option to upload your own graphics to the game, which makes the customization options endless! Player houses and gang houses offer further customization options, with stores across the map providing a wide variety of ideas and unique furniture items. Seasonal changes bring various updates, including unique themed shops, season-appropriate methods for making money, and unique changes to the map. Game Features: Create your Gangster There are infinite Free ways to customize your character when you start playing, options to upload your pixel art to create endless customization possibilities and to show off your style. House customization, with countless shops in-game that sell thousands of unique pieces of furniture to customize your house the way you want. Massive Open World PVP Battle against thousands of players in real-time on GraalOnline Era, Whether it be 1 v 1 sparring matches or 5 v 5 gang spar matches, or maybe you join your friends and play Laser Tag, defend against waves of enemies in Plasma Corp, or join in a Battle Royale! Or even take part in a Gang War with gangs of up to 25 players to claim Gang Bases or battle players across the giant map! Collect GraalOnline Era is updated regularly with various hats, weapons, items and furniture to collect! Jobs There is something for everyone to do to gain currency in GraalOnline Era. Make pizzas at Speedy Pizza, dig up shells at one of the beautiful beaches around the game, collect mushrooms and garbage across the massive map, and many more!
row.short_description: Era is a modern 2D action MMO RPG. Purchase weapons and work with a gang to compete in activities such as special events, base capturing and PvP battles in the Spar Complex, or start your own gang and chart your own path!

row.name: Little Crab Fisher
row.detailed_description: Buzz ***LITTLE CRAB FISHER WILL SOON BE FREE ON STEAM ON AUGUST 18th!*** About the Game ***LITTLE CRAB FISHER WILL SOON BE FREE ON STEAM ON AUGUST 18th!*** Welcome to Little Crab Fisher, the playful clicker adventure game that takes you on a journey through the Crustacean Sea! Step aboard and get ready to explore the vast, cartoonish world of Little Crab Fisher. Set sail on your own customizable vessel and navigate the sea, all while putting your fishing skills to the test. With unlockable islands, Little Crab Fisher offers a simple yet intriguing story that will lead you to uncover the secrets of the Crustacean Sea. Collect achievements along the way as you complete challenges and unlock new items and themes to customize your boat. But the real thrill of the game is discovering and collecting the mythical crabs that are scattered throughout the sea. With a unique mythical crab at each location, the journey to collect them all is sure to keep you hooked. Sell your catch to upgrade your boat and unlock even more features to enhance your gameplay. In addition to fishing for crabs and collecting mythical creatures, Little Crab Fisher offers even more excitement with the chance to discover pirate treasure hidden throughout the Crustacean Sea. And if that's not enough, keep an eye out for feeder storms that lure more crabs to the area. Chase them down and increase your catch! While frantically harvesting crabs can be enjoyable, keep in mind there might be something mysterious lurking in these depths. Put on your finest sailor's hat and come join the fun. Experience the exciting world of Little Crab Fisher!
row.short_description: A clicker-style crab fishing game based in a fantasy world. Collect mythical crabs, travel the high seas, and upgrade your ship. A fun-filled adventure awaits!

row.name: 全城警戒-世界大战一触即发，跪求指挥官！
row.detailed_description: 《全城警戒》是一款以策略战争、现代军事为题材的战争策略游戏。 美术方面采用独特的3D建模2D渲染技术，使画面更加精细、逼真，立体感更强，技术支持更全面，功能更完善，制作更精美！ 玩法上采用策略战斗，6位4种兵种巧妙搭配，多种战斗场景，体验不同地形和战役的趣味！ 【军事战争，真实体验】 简约设计清晰大气的UI布局，兼顾美观和实用性，但氛围上完美突出现代战争、中东战争的氛围感，在关卡中体验经典战役，在战斗中感受炮火氛围！ 【百余兵种，策略搭配】 兵种是游戏中最核心的玩法内容，游戏都是围绕着拥有更多更高级的兵种而发展基地。其他的系统也都是为了让自己的兵种更强。更高级的战争工厂可以造更高级的部队！ 【多线养成，合理分配】 丰富的培养体系，多线的养成方向，满足指挥官的养成收集欲望，拥有配件、装甲、技能等系统，合理分配资源，收集从不间断。 【资源抢夺，胜者为王】 资源的获取途径可以是矿场生产、矿点占领、玩家掠夺，你会不会也来参与这一场资源的危机引发的战争？
row.short_description: 《全城警戒》是一款以策略战争、现代军事为题材的战争策略游戏。在这里，能源耗尽、危机丛生，只有王者才能恢复世界的秩序！全面发展基地、抢占资源工厂、突破敌方防线，攻占中心城市，惩恶除奸，扬我国威！

row.name: Blade Mistress
row.detailed_description: Blade Mistress is an old school retro styled 1990s like game where you become a lovely lady and fight your way in a magical world against creatures who threaten to destroy it. Travel to unique realms and discover the secrets of what caused this chaos. Take part of a class selection to help and aid others or to become the fighter and need support from others. Blade mistress is a online multiplayer which is designed to incourage team work and player aid to each other with little to no hand holding it is your job to find out things and what is truely happening in this world. Create your own personal dungeons with Geomancy, or join other players in their own dungeons, Become 1 of 6 classes Physical, Magaical, Creative, Beast Master, Generalist, and War Mage. Each class having a unique set of skills design to aid each other.
row.short_description: Blade Mistress is a old school skilling and crafting styled game. Designed to require team work and a community of players who help each other to discover what has caused monsters to invade this world and fight as lovely ladies. Loot, kill and fight your way to the top.

row.name: SatelliteInfection
row.detailed_description: In a world where mankind has perished, he alone cleans the universe by removing garbage (broken satellites). It is a growth type shooting game set in space. Combine many enhancements to create your own spaceship. It is also possible to challenge the highest record in infinite mode or survive for a limited time in story mode. In the future, new enhancement parts will be released through continuous updates.
row.short_description: In a world where mankind has perished, he alone cleans the universe by removing garbage (broken satellites). It is a growth type shooting game set in space. Combine many enhancements to create your own spaceship.

row.name: Monster Museum
row.detailed_description: Have you ever dreamed of having your own museum where you can collect monsters? Dream no further, because now you can do it in Monster Museum! In this world, you can summon and collect monsters inspired by mythologies around the world and display them at your very own museum. Features: - Manage your own museum - More than 50 monsters to collect and discover - Buy decorations and make your museum the best to fit your style - Tons of minigames! Such as fishing, planting, treasure hunting and many more - Combine monsters to increase its tier and power - Explore the city and find all the secrets! - Follow the exciting story about the city And most importantly, make your monster museum the best in the world!
row.short_description: Have you ever dreamed of having your own museum where you can collect monsters? Dream no further, because now you can do it in Monster Museum!

row.name: Abathor - Atlantis Landing
row.detailed_description: Atlantis is being razed! Demon hordes have burst through dimensional gates to destroy the entire continent. The last Atlantean refugees have been devoured by a sea abomination as they boarded their ships to flee the massacre. In this game excerpt, the monsters appear to be led by a mysterious enemy: cunning General Kipak. What is happening in the once mighty Atlantis? The heroes land on a dangerous beach, each with a powerful reason for being there... Relive the glory of arcades in this action platformer for up to 4 players. This game excerpt contains: 5 distinct levels of increasing difficulty (from the more than 50 stages that the complete game will have), riddled with enemies, traps and challenges. The beginning of Abathor's story. You will start to sense what is happening on the Atlantis continent and how to deal with the threat. A combat against the sea abomination that has devoured the fleeing Atlanteans. A pixel-perfect art design, beautiful and detailed, and epic musical compositions.
row.short_description: Play Abathor Atlantis Landing and relive the glory of arcades in this action platformer for up to 4 players.

row.name: Planting Trees
row.detailed_description: Planting Trees is a unique and entertaining simulation game that allows players to explore the wonders of nature and the importance of environmental conservation. In this game, players take on the role of a reforestation expert and must plant seeds, care for animals, and maintain a good balance of the environment. With the use of buildings, including research labs to discover new plants, players can progress and build a thriving ecosystem. Enjoy the satisfaction of watching their seeds grow into mature trees and the thrill of discovering new species of plants and animals. The game offers a playful and engaging way to understand the complexities of the natural world and the challenges of environmental sustainability. Whether you're an eco-enthusiast or simply looking for a fun and educational game, Planting Trees is a must-play.
row.short_description: Take on the role of a reforestation expert.

row.name: Combo Bombo
row.detailed_description: Welcome to join our official discord server to find friends to play together: Get ready for the exciting world of Combo Bombo! Engage in thrilling multiplayer battles with friends, using creative and powerful weapon combinations to dominate the competition. Combine Items into Powerful Weapons With our innovative weapon combining system, you can mix and match items to create powerful tools of destruction. Online multiplayer battle Join the fun and battle it with your friends in our online multiplayer mode. Different mini-games And don't forget about our exciting mini-games! Complete them to earn points and gain an edge over your opponents. With two levels, five mini-games, and ten unique weapons waiting for you, Combo Bombo offers endless hours of thrilling gameplay. Don't miss out on the fun!
row.short_description: Combo Bombo is an online multiplayer game where friends can engage in joyful combat using various creative and powerful weapon combinations. Players are challenged to think strategically as they combine different weapons to form even more devastating tools of destruction.

row.name: 被坏女人骗成冒险者!
row.detailed_description: 2D side-scrolling rpg, clap mobs! get stronger! build your own broken set! Let's progress as a adventurer with our main character and complete the ultimate quest! (the game currently does not support English sorry about that! however, it is still totally playable because we all gamers!) Beat mobs, level up, gain attack or health stats. And mostly importantly: Unlock new unique weapons each with thier unique ability. Combine them into your dream set, either you feel like taking any boss's attack while laughing, or one shotting anything that is on your way. The choice is up to you. And perhaps you want to be a hardcore gamer, only using the starter set without leveling up your stats. The point is, you can play the game in multiple ways, and it might be tons of fun? Try it out! (The game is still not nearly finished, currently there are 2 zones. The final plan is to have 8 and much more unique items. And you might find a few bugs here and there)
row.short_description: 2D side-scrolling rpg, clap mobs! get stronger! build your own broken set! Let's progress as a adventurer with our main character and complete the ultimate quest! (the game currently does not support English sorry about that! however, it is still totally playable because we all gamers!)

row.name: 美妙的薅网管大冒险
row.detailed_description: 美妙的薅网管大冒险： 是一款令人兴奋的冒险游戏！ 真人互动！难以置信的定价！ 解开神秘谜题，发现财富和宝藏。 其实是中了某博主的抽奖。 @呼叫网管 既然是任意一款Steam游戏！ 那就自己做一个放上来也没问题吧😄😄 你将扮演一名年轻的冒险者，他被派往远离城市的一个偏远地区，以寻找一个失踪已久的网吧。在这个神秘的地方，你将面临各种各样的挑战，包括越过悬崖峭壁，破解险恶的机关和谜题，以及与危险的野兽战斗。你必须用你的智慧和勇气，才能在这个古老而神秘的地方生存下来。 在探险过程中，你将发现一些令人惊叹的奇观，如古老的键盘和遗失已久的显卡。你将收集和使用各种各样的工具和设备，以协助你完成任务。你将和不同的NPC互动，并获得他们的帮助，了解更多关于这个神秘地方的信息。 华丽的图形和生动的音效，使你感觉像是亲身经历这个冒险。这是一个充满挑战的游戏，只有最勇敢的玩家才能够克服所有的难关，揭示出真相并发现宝藏。你准备好开始你的探险了吗？

row.name: Dragabox
row.detailed_description: GET THESE BOXES OUT OF THE WAY! Use your intellect to navigate your way through over 200 puzzling levels. You might think you have played some games that require pushing things around, but this game requires a lot of pulling! Do you have what it takes to reach the door? You must first clear a path by moving boxes that stand in your way. There are combinations of pull boxes, push boxes, and electric barriers that need to be deactivated to create a path to success. Dragabox is an addictive game as you are drawn into apparently simple mazes only to occasionally find yourself cornered. The levels are increasingly tricky, adding different types of obstacles and problems, leading to a natural learning curve of problem-solving. This game will sharpen your intellect! This game is friendly for all ages and is great for logic training and problem-solving. Features: - 12 fun animated avatars you won't find anywhere else - 225 levels - undo last play button - reset level button - 15 original musical arrangements - step counter - stars for personal best scores Give it a try. See if you can complete all 225 challenges.
row.short_description: Use your intellect to clear a pathway to the door. Push and pull boxes out of your way, and deactivate electrical barriers. Over 200 levels of brain-busting challenges. Give it a try. See if you can complete them all!

row.name: CAWEZ's Puzzlebox: HIRAETH
row.detailed_description: CAWEZ's Puzzlebox: HIRAETH is a direct look inside of the perplexing mind of its creator: it is a compilation which explores the past mistakes and the dubious decisions of a failed artist who let himself be consumed by his passion. In this game, you will solve a series of carefully crafted physics puzzles, exploring unique experimental mechanics, and test your skills at equally mind-bending 3D platforming challenges. Puzzle types: Top-down tile pushing: some tiles may enter areas the player cannot, and vice-versa. Some tiles can only be pushed indirectly by another, and some must be pushed directly. This gives rise to complex emergent mechanics you will be tasked with exploring and exploiting. Gravity puzzles: the player has to power to change the direction of gravity. Some objects will keep their original gravity, whereas some will mimic the player. You will need to figure out how to alter the gravity of specific tiles in order to hold others in place, all while guiding the player to the objective. Fractal puzzles: tiles cast ghost-like images around them that do not interact with physics in the way you would expect. As the puzzles near a solution, you will find the grid more and more cluttered by these images, blocking your path. You will need to guide the player to the Objective while keeping all 'buttons' pressed. Zero-G puzzles: The shortest puzzle type, where the player can freely float around in space, and solve 3D tile pushing.
row.short_description: CAWEZ's Puzzlebox: HIRAETH is a game about mind-bending puzzles and unique platforming challenges, all with a dreamy atmosphere and physics-defying mechanics.

row.name: 天神印（THE BLOCKADE）
row.detailed_description: This is a letter of apology to everyone. Hello, everyone, we are the 'God Seal' project team. First of all, we would like to extend our sincerest apologies to all the players who have supported us. We recognize that Tenji does not meet the expectations of the market and does not meet the requirements of a qualified game. Here we sincerely apologize to all of you. In order not to cause trouble and debuff to the domestic independent game industry, we should jointly maintain the harmonious atmosphere of the independent game circle and consolidate the trust between each other. Also to make up for the loss of the players, and to express our sincerity and apology. We decided that before the game was good enough to pay for it: to make 'Tenji' a free game, and to provide a refund service for players who previously purchased the game. We have submitted a request to Steam for review to change the pricing model and expect the store page to become free in a week's time. We have been closely watching the market's reaction since the launch of Tenshen Seal. The evaluations that followed were both unexpected and expected, and all seemed so reasonable. It is not expected, because the project team has invested a lot of energy and funds during this period. In the three years before the launch, the operating cost has exceeded 445w yuan. The game was overturned five times during this period, and the sixth and final version was released at the end of August. As expected, because the project team was too inexperienced in the early stage of game development, most of the people in the project team were game lovers without any industry experience. As a result, the game failed to meet expectations in terms of gameplay and art performance. We are deeply aware of the shortcomings of the current game, which keeps us awake at night. After deep reflection, we have learned from our previous failures and are determined not to repeat them. At present, we have started a brand new project: 'Apart from the Year'. 'In addition to the year' is a national wind horizontal version of the shooting game, it will be more focused, and executable, the project has completed the project, is working hard to produce demo. It is expected to be online in a year. Here, we ask the players to give more understanding and support, together witness our growth and progress. In order to do better in the 'Age Apart' project, we have established a 'age Apart' project QQ group to invite interested players to join. We sincerely welcome players to provide us with valuable suggestions and discuss with us. 'Beyond the year' project exchange QQ group: 677522088 At the same time, we guarantee that we will not give up the first game we made, 'God Seal' will always be updated. Because of the 'God Seal' frame construction miscellaneous. In the update, we need to fill in a lot of content, including and not only with maps, copywriting, story, props, wild monsters, bosses, skills, skills, mind, and a series of content. Therefore, the update interval will be longer. We also hope that you can provide us with more suggestions to make it better. At the same time, it also makes the project team better. Finally, apologies and thanks again to all players. We hope to regain the trust and love of our players through hard work and improvement. We always believe that only love can withstand the long time. With respect to the project team Celestia Seal. 1. About games After the war of gods and demons, the law of heaven suddenly changed, the thunder fell early so that the monks on earth could not guard against it, and a generation of proud children all fell. In the following decades, no one broke through the field of gas refining. The path of fairy cultivation was temporarily depressed. Ten thousand years later, peach Blossom village, young Qin Xiao full of pride, regardless of parents dissuade, determined to embark on the path of cultivation. With outstanding talent, Qin Xiao smoothly worship into the Xiuxian mountain gate. However, the road to cultivating the immortal is very difficult, as time goes by, not only Qin Xiao's cultivation is becoming more and more refined, but also a group of powerful opponents have appeared in front of him, hindering his way forward. With the fall of the peach flower fairy, the disappearance of the sentence awn, the destruction of the large array, the front is more and more confusing. In the city of the female emperor, Qin Xiao encountered the nine tails of the monster who was imprisoned in the lock demon tower for ten thousand years, although she was beautiful and gorgeous, but the means were ruthless and spicy, and countless monks died in their hands. After hard work, Qin Xiao finally defeated nine tail, but this is only the tip of the iceberg of truth. The truth of the war between gods and demons, the reason for the sudden change of the Heavenly Way, the upper God Qin Tian who fell without reason, and the Heavenly Seal that cut off the path of God... There will be more unknown waiting for Qin Xiao. In this merciless way of heaven, no one can escape from the endless vortex. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 2. About us Official Q Group: 839142973 Welcome you to join. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 3. Game introduction module ① Map system In this game, players will be placed in a vast expanse of large maps, free to explore, freely move forward, constantly reveal new regions and magnificent landscapes. The world is beautiful and presents multiple environments, like a peach garden in a dream. Peach blossom forest looming, as if the world fairyland; The lava beneath the volcanic crust is raging, wild and hot; Luwu towering cliffs, showing the grandeur of nature; Jia Chao's dense forest is deep and dark, hiding endless mysteries. Each environment has unique weather patterns that add a wealth of variety to the journey of discovery. In the game, players can interact with various objects and terrain in the environment. Whether gathering rare herbs or digging up precious ores, every interaction can lead to unexpected gains. At the same time, be wary of unexpected traps and hidden map entrances that may bring new challenges and surprises to your adventure. In this vast and colorful world, exploration, adventure and discovery will be the themes of Tenji. Map function display: Character Movement Display: ② The tomb system The map is littered with the entrance to the legendary Tomb of the Gods and Demons. The player can uncover these secrets by searching for them. However, it's not enough to just find the entrance, you also need to defeat the owner of the tomb in order to gain rare rewards and a deeper understanding of the story of the game world. In this process, you will face unprecedented challenges, but also will gain endless fun and sense of accomplishment. ③ Skill schools According to different Reiki attributes, the skill system is divided into gold, wood, water, fire, and earth five sets of system skills, and each has a different exclusive weapon. In addition, there are additional auxiliary skills of thunder, wind, and ice. At the same time, it provides the player with a rich choice of skills and collocation possibilities. Players are free to combine various skills to create unique combat styles based on their play style and needs. ④ Craft system The skill system, as a major feature of the game, brings a richer level and depth to the game. It is independent of the skill system, allowing players to explore and learn unique skills such as drawing, alchemy, casting, and more. By learning and mastering these skills, the player will have an advantage in battle and be able to deal with the enemy more effectively. Enriched the gameplay of the game, but also for the player to provide more freedom and choice space. Players can choose to learn and master different skills according to their own preferences and game needs to create unique characters.
row.short_description: Tenshen Print is a fantasy single-player role-playing game by Emeng Shanhai Studio, which uses a 2D perspective rarely seen in fantasy RPGS. In the course of the game, the player will set foot on the journey of cultivating the immortal as the spirited young 'Qin Xiao'.

row.name: 全球戒备
row.detailed_description: 关注我们 《全球戒备》游戏1群：200171742 《全球戒备》游戏2群：1184079878 百度贴吧：全球戒备游戏吧 新浪微博：@苦柚Games 诚邀参加测试 友情提示： 游戏是一款 慢节奏、慢热 的军事策略竞技游戏。 享受快节奏、即时痛快的玩家朋友，不一定能接受这类回合制战棋。 希望喜欢军事战棋策略的玩家朋友，能成为我们的早期核心群体，给我们更多支持与帮助！非常感谢！ About the Game 在一次不寻常的陨石风暴中，外星太空舰队坠落地球，外星舰队的残骸和碎片散落各地，残骸甚至带有远古太空战斗的痕迹。世界各国政府担心会引起大众的普遍恐慌，决定向民众隐瞒真相，派遣精英雇佣军前往坠机地点，抢在竞争对手之前获得外星技术。 作为这些准军事组织之一的指挥官，你必须成功地侦察、保护在每个外星人坠毁地点发现的武器和情报，并将其交付给城府颇深的政府合作方。但是随着任务的逐步深入，外星物品对你们的攻击越来越致命时，你们发现了另一个真相：某些政府动用了国家的资助，试图利用外星技术控制世界人口。人类面临着更严重的威胁，可能导致人类被彻底消灭，自此进入了全球戒备状态…… 游戏特点 1. 真实军事作战，场景皆可互动 游戏整体采用真实世界地图作为大背景，所有战斗都将在世界地图上的某一国家或地区进行。局内环境及障碍物则运用3D图形技术进行高精度建模，成荫的树林、山坡与岩石、废旧的汽车，搭配等比例缩放的人物建模，真实还原现代军事潜行作战的场景。且周遭物体均可作为掩体，不同掩体对应不同枪械的弹道，有：防御力，闪避率，命中率相关的差异。充分利用视角错位掩护己方位置，等待下一回合的进攻！ 2. 硬核战棋策略，多情景回合对抗 配以3D立体建模，每一个单元棋格都将拥有多层地形。攀爬到高处或者选择恰当的视野遮挡，都会获得部分属性加成，当然也会对自身不同朝向的受击、被击、暴击、闪避、命中等造成差异。在切换不同场景后，也需要根据周围地形和障碍物，预判敌人的藏匿点以做好防守或攻击的准备。战棋策略之余，还需要配合不同兵种特性灵活行动。这一切有关于地形地貌、战斗属性的变化都使军事策略更丰富多维。 3. 兵种组合策略，享受指挥的艺术 一支队伍由4名战士组成。目前游戏内有3大阵营、3种品质、9大兵种、共计100+技能的战士，可供玩家用于协同作战。玩家可以根据场景需要，挑选不同的战士组成不同队伍，如安排狙击兵在定点棋格狙杀，让突击兵进行近距离冲锋等，制定不同作战计划，完美展现指挥的艺术。 4. 真实还原枪械，填充你的军火库 游戏内的枪械、防弹衣、手雷等都参照军事装备进行建模；各类装备也在现代真实武器设计的基础上，增加局内的作战实力。目前装备分为武器、护甲、弹药与耗材。每名战士可以根据其定位和属性自由组合装备，更大限度表现个人优势。装备还支持：可拆解/可组装升级/可修理，军械迷大可享受其中！ 5. 真人实时竞技，战局变幻莫测 游戏做了大量的PVE内容，但是，游戏的核心乐趣来自于硬核PVP。游戏整体建立在多人策略竞技互动的玩法骨架之上，这也正对应了军事作战的最美妙时刻，莫过于：人与人斗，其乐无穷。作为重点玩法，游戏提供了不同的PVP模式，玩家1v1真人实时对战，或2名玩家与机器人三方实时共战，不同的胜利条件，让玩家可以尽情享受运筹帷幄的成就感，和千变万化的策略烧脑。 6. 丰富社交系统，军团军备竞赛 相较于单人体验的PVE和PVP模式，游戏还提供了好友、军团的社交功能玩法。玩家在单人行动外，可以结识到新的游戏伙伴。 由于军事+战棋的双重硬核程度，我们希望依托这些系统和Steam社区，让喜欢这个玩法方向的玩家朋友们，能够有一个可以交流的环境，和好友互动，在军团里参加军团活动，也可以和我们开发组互动，留下来，循环促进更好的游戏氛围。
row.short_description: 《全球戒备》是一款硬核的军事战棋策略游戏。外星太空舰队坠落地球，世界各国政府都想抢先得到残骸，研究外星技术。你将代表某个国家，带领4人小分队前往坠落点侦查情报。真实还原的世界地图、潜行战斗场景与各类枪支弹药；多兵种组合策略，与玩家实时对抗，尽显军事才能。指挥官，请指示！
row.notes: The game contains some violent scenes and words. Have poison, burning, and shooting scenes, roles could get killed and hurt. Please be cautious.

row.name: Andarin Weppes: Pre-Dementia
row.detailed_description: Step into the tangled mind of a dementia patient as he visits the house of his late grandpa, who also suffered from the ethereal embrace of dementia. Witness your perception warp, gravity surrender its grasp and the very essence of space and time tumble into a puzzling dance as your advancing dementia twists your reality into the unfamiliar. Pre-Dementia Play through 6 levels and acquaint yourself with the early stages of dementia where your illness only mildly affects your mind. You'll notice and have to overcome subtle anomalies in your environment. Explore as much of the house as you can and get familiar with the environment before your illness starts affecting you more severely. Key Features A Surreal Dwelling: Explore a once-familiar house now shrouded in the mystique of dementia. Traverse its non-Euclidean environments, where up and down lose meaning, and rooms meld in perplexing arrangements. Unravel Puzzles: Engage your mind in solving intricate puzzles scattered throughout the enigmatic abode. Each riddle holds a piece of the profound story that connects memories, dreams, and reality. Journey Through Memory: Witness the convergence of memories and delusions as you venture deeper into the shifting chambers of the mind. Experience the blurred boundaries between lucidity and illusion. Ambiguous Reality: Embrace the uncertainty. Prepare to question what is real and what is not, as the lines between reality blur. Rewind: Fear no more from mistakes of the past. Prepare your mind for a symphony of illusions and truths, and immerse yourself in a journey where the journey and the destination are an enigma. Dare to tread the paths that defy reason and embrace the boundless realm of a dementia inflicted mind. Step forth into the mysteries of Andarin Weppes:Pre-Dementia and uncover the surreal truth that awaits within.
row.short_description: Andarin Weppes is a first person puzzle experience of a man with ever advancing dementia...

row.name: Cronous
row.detailed_description: Full 3D client online game Cronous Online is a fully 3D MMORPG. Supports image zooming in/out, lens rotation, and height adjustment. Players can enjoy the game in a familiar environment. Diversified career settings The game has four initial professions to choose from, namely Warrior, Assassin, Barbarian, and Magician. Any profession can be promoted by advancing to the corresponding level. There are usually two different directions for advancement, and players can choose the gameplay that suits them based on their preferences and character positioning. Mature social functions Cronous has a complete community interaction system, such as chatting, dialogue, teaming, and guilds, which gives players a stronger sense of belonging. Good social relationships will make the character's growth and exploration process more exciting. Classic battle scenes In terms of visual expression of combat and magical effects, Cronous maximizes the continuation of classic style. In addition, the game sound will also change accordingly with the character's behavior and distance. Guild Castle Battle When the guild has sufficient strength, it can choose to capture the castle. After successfully occupying, the guild will receive more taxes and produce higher-level equipment. The president can set different ranks for members, and each rank will also have different guild rights.
row.short_description: Cronous Online is a large MMORPG that features character growth and confrontation as its main features. Players can enhance their own strength in various ways to confront the demons of Cronous continent.

row.name: MEs
row.detailed_description: MEs is a new personal knowledge collection and network of multiplayer worlds — a multiplayer file system that visualizes your images, music, text, and 3D models as virtual worlds. Use them as materials to build your own worlds to play and share the visualization of your thinking. STORY Explore the endless world of MEs and encounter art, data, memories, and unexpected 'artifacts.' Exchange hearts and minds with others on your journey of encountering and re-exploring your own mental map. Play with the natural flow of your deep thoughts in ever-expanding constellations, while enhancing communications, growing relationships and building community. DEVELOPER NOTES MEs is still in very early stages of development, so we appreciate any and all forms of feedback! If you are interested in helping us test MEs, please follow the Discord link or sign up on our website from the information panel to right.
row.short_description: Take part in exploring the ever-expanding innerworlds of MEs — a personal knowledge collection for gathering the smallest sparks of ideas.

Twelve sheets with images to explore freely or be challenged by finding the proposed elements. No ads, no purchases and no hooking dynamics.
row.short_description: The ideal initiation video game for preschool children to learn words in English and Spanish.

row.name: Gekko Episode of Amelia
row.detailed_description: ■ What is Gekko? Gekko is the stage where swords, machines and ponytails appear in modern society. A school romantic comedy visual novel that depicts an exciting love pattern with five heroines. This work is the second in the Gekko series and offers the story of the tsundere policewoman 'Amelia'. ■ Story Time is modern. The largest machine product company 'Imperial Heavy Industries' Monopolize the share of 'Automata' Demand was spreading not only to industry but also to ordinary households. High school student 'Yuto' who attends 'Seioh High School' Unfortunately, he gets caught up in an automata runaway incident, but after a short break, the third-generation automata 'Nova' saves his life. The hideout was taken to 'Nova' as it was, and 'Yuto' was assigned a serious task. ―――― Become a lover with 5 school idols to defeat 'Mugen Tukuyomi'. 'Yuto' is his buddy 'Nova', He started the operation to become a heroine and a lover with the operation staff 'Kageyama'. This time the target is Amelia, the head of the Discipline Committee of Seioh High School, who uses force to suppress the delinquents spreading in the school and maintain public order. row.short_description: In a stage where swords, machines, and ponytails appear in modern society A school love-comedy visual novel in which you can enjoy an exciting and thrilling love story This is the second installment of the Gekko series. In this work, you can enjoy the love story of Amelia, a tsundere police girl.
