row.name: 13iew
row.detailed_description: A girl abandoned in the basement of a hospital for some reason. She gets out of the basement and goes above ground, where she sees the doctor in the distance. It seems that the doctor abandoned the girl. Help the girl escape the hospital by dodging the doctor! 13iew is a spooky horror puzzle game. Play by switching between first person and side view, and solve puzzles by interacting with various objects according to the viewpoint. Our game is not a horror game. It's a spooky game. You'll have to use your brain a bit because you have to play with differentiating between objects you can interact with in first person and objects you can interact with in third person. Controls are similar to other side-view games, but with the addition of first person, it can be a little complicated, but you will soon get used to it. Explore in 1st person a space that can't be seen in 3rd person, search for clues and solve puzzles. You can feel the atmosphere of a third-person game and the atmosphere of a first-person game at the same time. There are 3 chapters, and feel the atmosphere of each chapter and find the foreshadowing all over the map. You can enjoy it by understanding why the doctor abandoned the girl in the basement as you complete the story through hidden foreshadowings and various devices throughout the map. ps. Made by a team of college students, there may be many missing parts. Thank you for your understanding.
row.short_description: A girl abandoned in the basement of a hospital for some reason. Escape the hospital avoiding the doctor who abandoned the girl in the basement! Complete the story through hidden foreshadowings and various devices throughout the map and find out why the doctor abandoned the girl in the basement.
row.notes: Corpses wrapped in bandages emerge and the doctor attacks the player character.

row.name: PANDORA
row.detailed_description: You've grown tired of their experiments and constantly being used as their tool of oppression. Sai-Corp developed new weapons that'll soon phase you out. And then what? Do they throw you away? Do they keep you as an experiment? No, don't let them choose for you like they always have. It's time to stand against Sai-Corp and earn the freedom they stole from you. Pandora is a third-person action-adventure hack n slash game that combines teleportation and combat abilities. Take on the role of Phase, a cyber-enhanced super-soldier detained by their creator, Sai-Corp. Escape the orbital testing facility and earn the freedom they stole from you long ago. Fluid Movement: Use Phase’s training and cyber-teleportation abilities to experience an engaging move set. A merge of basic and complex movement abilities that give you options when avoiding attacks from enemies or when traversing the broken facility. Advanced Combat: Building on the fluid movement, the game gives Phase his favorite weapons, a katana, and his teleportation dagger. Combine Phase’s move set with his sword-slashing abilities to defeat anyone trying to stop you. Enticing Environment: Utilize the different abilities while traversing the destroyed Sai-Corp Orbital Testing Facility and discover the environment that imprisoned Phase for so long. development Team: Ben Dookram - Sound Designer Hamzah Kashmiri - Programmer Kevin Kulendran - UX/UI Designer Hayder Mahamood - 3D Artist/Co-Manager John Muia - Project Manager Thomas Soares - Level Designer Music Team: Anthony Kubelka - Composer Jake Robertson - SFX Artist Harris the First - Voice Coordinator Yiyang Zhou - Music Coordinator VA Team: Atlin Hofer - Voice of Phase / Co-Scriptwriter
row.short_description: Pandora is a third-person action-adventure hack n slash game that combines teleportation and combat abilities. Take on the role of Phase, a cyber-enhanced super-soldier detained by their creator, Sai-Corp. Escape the orbital testing facility and earn the freedom they stole from you long ago.
row.notes: We have the main character escape a prison facility, and he engages with hostiles on his path. He uses a cybernetic sword and dagger to slash guards who are cyberenhanced beings. The ultimate objective is to destroy the boss who is a mech.

row.name: POOSTALL Royale
row.detailed_description: APRIL FOOLS 2023 That's right, this was all part of an elaborate April Fools joke. But what exactly is real and what isn't? Quite simply, the game is real, the people who worked in it are real and all the plans to continue improving the game are real too! While this game was never meant to be taken too seriously, the people behind the 'C Team of RWS' are passionate and are willing to continuing polishing this game. All the new updates will be FREE! _____________ So you got to this Steam page and you're wondering what in the blue hell you're seeing right in front of you. It's hard to explain really, one month in the making and the C team of RWS crapped out this absolute masterpiece that is available for you to download right now! We can't believe we're not charging you for this masterpiece! It's almost like that game... Hatred! Shoot your way through multiple waves of braindead NPCs who are literally only programmed to run towards you while yelling random things recorded from a bathroom stall with a cheap USB microphone. Compare your highscore with your friends, if you have any. Enjoy the beautiful assets that we've bought and didn't even bother to make ourselves! We've gone WOKE! For the first time ever, you get to play as a female POSTAL Dude, complete with voice lines and everything. The Pigeon Mission Many years in the making, and it's finally here... the super ultra cool PIGEON MISSION is finally a reality! Feed pigeons as fast as you can and... well... that's it really. Wait, you expected to be able to kill them? we've gone woke, remember? In case you haven't realised by now This is an April Fools joke...
row.short_description: APRIL FOOLS 2023ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ Don't let the title fool you, this isn't a battle royale game. Maybe this isn't even a game at all... well, just download now and figure it out!
row.notes: Contains: • Frequent killing; • Non Playable Characters verbally expressing fear; • Usage of legal and illegal drugs; • Suicide feature/animation accompanied by dialogue.

row.name: Kingsblade: King's Keep Prologue
row.detailed_description: Kingsblade: Next-Gen Escape's mobile hack 'n slash platformer! Leap across peril! Deal with dastardly rats! Break the bones of skeletons! Save the Princess! (This indirect prologue to Next-Gen Escape's King's Keep Escape Room is spoilers-free and adds to the story behind the escape room. It is not necessary to play King's Keep to enjoy this game.) In Kingsblade, players take on the titular role and try to save Princess Ariana from the foul dungeon beneath the capital city. You'll encounter vicious rats, and toiling skeleton guards as you venture further in the dungeon... And find a most dangerous foe in the bottom chamber... Jump over danger and slash at your foes! You are the Kingsblade!
row.short_description: The Kingsblade has been called, and you've answered! Leap across peril! Deal with dastardly rats! Break the bones of cowardly skeletons! Save the Princess in this Hack 'n Slash platformer!

row.name: 异界旅客：序章

The game's subsequent content will also continue to be updated here for free! The game contains a dazzling variety of combat methods and content, such as melee taps and combos. The character's hard hits, skills, flight, locking enemies, quick tumbling, etc. Also, the game contains a wealth of enemy Ai, with large and small monsters and robots of all shapes and sizes waiting for you. The total game process is about half an hour, a total of three levels. The main gameplay is cool to fight strange, brain grass, experience the pleasure of easy combat.
row.short_description: Traveller: Prologue is an adventure and exploration game with combat at its core. The player takes on the role of an adventurer who is about to embark on a journey through a trial level to qualify as an alien traveler.

row.name: AvaKit
row.detailed_description: No more expensive mo-cap gears! AvaKit IS HERE! AvaKit , which finishes its CBT(closed beta test) starts an Early Access in Steam! VTubers can start their real-time motion capture of their VRM files through AvaKit . Just a single camera is okay to start. The only thing to start AvaKit is just a single, common webcam. No iPhone or Leapmotion needed. SINGLE CAMERA and AvaKit are only things that you need to become a VTuber. Then hand, arm, iris, facial expression, and body tracking is available in AvaKit. Any type of camera - laptop webcam, smartphone, external webcam - is okay for us. Easy to start your own live-streaming What you need to do before start is so simple: (1) Connect your camera (2) Start the AvaKit (3) and implement two types of calibration. After these three procedures, you can enjoy our complete tracking solution. If you have your own VRM files, you can change the avatar model and start live-streaming. ( AvaKit officially supports the plugins of OBS Studio - Spout2 Capture & Syphon) We provide you default VRM character, Rua-chan! You can try features of AvaKit with our cute mascot characeter, 'Rua-chan'. Also, AvaKit only supports the VRM file for 3DVTubers currently, but we plan to expand our spectrum to Live2D model. Whenever there are any issues or difficulties related to playing AvaKit , please let us know through our official . Newcomers are always welcome! 😜 Why you have to choose AvaKit AvaKit provides the optimized features to livestream in YouTube and Twitch for VTubers. Currently, the major features that AvaKit supports are as follows. Easiest and fastest real-time facial expression, hands, body tracking to start Microphone-based lip sync (both audio-based and video-based are available) High-quality rendering through AvaKit pipeline(shader applying other than MToon) Shape key implementation through hot key registration - blendshape, costume, hair, etc. Precise setting related to tracking parameters and avatar movement available Position, rotation and size modification of avatar available Prop import (Available to import PNG file as a prop) Chroma key - green background, Spout2 Capture and Syphon Client available Various backgrounds, lightings, particle effects, and beauty filters NDI support available Available both on Windows and MacOS! There are much more features that AvaKit wants to show you. We really tried hard to develop. We are always open to your suggestions, so please feel free to say to us at our ! Features that will be updated Also, features that are planned to be developed through previous tests are as follows. Interaction plugin between VTuber and viewers by linking with Twitch and YouTube Sticker and illustration auto-generation Closet mode(This will help you change your costumes easily without shape key registration) More various rendering filter(shader) types Inner camera for avatar selfie like VRChat ...and many more through our exclusive plugins! How to make a contact with dev There is our . Also, we are consistently our development procedures through our official Twitter account, so you can also communicate with us through this channel. We look forward to communicating with you! Credit There are several 3D asset presets in AvaKit for throwing-object-feature. Thanks for your contribution. @FelineEntity @zuzu @RenAtlach
row.short_description: AvaKit: all-in-one streaming app for VTubers. You can start real-time mo-cap with just a single camera. High-quality rendering with 100% lilToon support, perfect sync, and various contents AvaKit prepared for you will take you to the awesome virtual world.

row.name: Fantasy Quest Prologue
row.detailed_description: An absolutely cute funny game about you saving cute anime girls from monsters. Fight your way through cute monsters. Collect fantasy-based powerups and blast through your enemies. Collect keys to unlock new areas on the map. Have a blast traversing through the stylized bright beautiful arena The world of Aria is being attacked by monsters, The elves constructed a summoning circle to summon an other world wanderer to save them from the monster horde. You are entrusted with the magic staff of the elves that is created from the branch of the ancient tree in their homeland. Gameplay: classic fps mechanism number 1 : magic bullet number 2 : burst razor leaf number 3 : lightning bolt number 4 : fireball This is an Anime themed Arena Shooter game with the classic arena-style weapon system with a fantasy twist. Features fantasy-based weapon system.
row.short_description: Protect cute anime girls. Shoot monsters. Simple.

row.name: Kemono Friends Opening Day
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Japari Park! After passing a month-long training program, you’ve finally become a Caretaker at the world-renowned Japari Park ! You’ve learned all about taking care of Friends , animals who have turned into animal girls, and their mysterious home, Japari Park, a massive archipelago where every type of natural environment in the world can be found. But you didn’t come halfway around the world without a reason. You’ve been invited to work at the park by Nana , a Caretaker responsible for two particularly troublesome Friends. Nana needs your help to manage a Serval cat with loads of energy and an Ezo Red Fox with no respect for the rules. If she can’t find someone who can handle them, Nana won’t be able to start teaching part-time at the Learning Center. Meet the Friends of Japari Park! As a Japari Park Caretaker, your responsibilities don’t end with Serval and Ezo Red Fox! You’ll meet many more cute and misbehaved girls who will need your guidance in order to live happy, healthful lives in the park. How you choose to handle their troubles and trauma will lead to either good or bad outcomes for these girls, and the fate of everyone may even depend on it! Kemono Friends Opening Day is a Kemono Friends fan project visual novel where you make friends with Friends and do your best to guide them to a good ending, no matter how difficult things become. Chapter 3 Available Now! Play the all new 3rd chapter ! Enjoy the biggest mall in Japari Park with Serval and Ezo Red Fox, meet new Friends like Humboldt Penguin and Royal Penguin, learn more about Anubis and Cerberus, see the girls dress up in cute outfits, and help Hululu overcome her past trauma. Thanks once again to all our hard working team members for their work bringing chapter 3 to life! We look forward to delivering the next chapter of the game when it is ready.
row.short_description: A fan visual novel where you join Nana at Japari Park as new caretaker. Fun and food await in adventures with an energetic serval cat and an always hungry fox!

row.name: H.I.A: Horror Investigation Agency
row.detailed_description: Join the fun in this brand new Early Access Multiplayer Horror Game! WELCOME TO THE H.I.A: HORROR INVESTIGATION AGENCY The H.I.A. is a fun multiplayer horror game in which you and co-players have to investigate horror cases . Among finding victims and evidence of the horror event that has taken place, you will be faced with jumpscares and scary monsters along your investigation. Get the evidence you need and return to the H.I.A. headquarters safe and sound. FEATURES 1-6 player online co-op Play through fun horror missions together with your friends or with random teammates. Explore unique missions with each their own story and challenges. Have you and your friends got what it takes to complete them? Welcome new employee! As an H.I.A. employee it is your task to help horrified customers in need. Manager Dominic is always on the phone with new customers which you can help. Head over to Ricky, select a case, and finish the job. Casual Apart from solving horror cases, the H.I.A. is also a great place to have casual fun with friends. Hangout, spend time, make yourself look cool, and don't poop your pants when the monster gets you! SOCIALIZE Besides the H.I.A. being a horror game, the H.I.A. is also a place to socialize and have fun with others. Make use of chat, chat emotes, gestures and physical emotes to express yourself and communicate with friends and fellow players. APPEARANCE Customize your character appearance and express yourself with a variety of clothing & cosmetic options. Hats, outfits, backpacks and more customization options on its way. GADGETS The H.I.A. has a fun and intuitive tool system . Interact with tools around the world, each having their own unique functionality. Pick them up and store them in you tool slots. SOLVE CASES Decide which mission you and your friends will be playing by selecting cases in the lobby. Once you and your friend have decided on which case to solve, jump in the car and head to the mission. NPC INTERACTIONS Interact with lively NPCs . Some tell you some stories, other ask you for help, and who knows, some might even jumpscare you! THINGS YOU CAN DO IN H.I.A. Play missions Fun multiplayer with up to 6 players Replayability Socialize with friends or strangers Customize your character Talk with NPCs Equippable tools Horror chasing AI Jumscares Chat & Voicechat Emotes & Gestures Puzzles Find/Collect objects Objectives Arcade Gamemodes (Coming Soon) And plenty more features added every week! What you can also expect in H.I.A: Jumping across obstacles, Fun(ny) horror stories, Different types of Equipment, Socializing, Multiple unique Monsters and Cases to solve, A mighty fun time.
row.short_description: H.I.A: Horror Investigation Agency is a fun multiplayer horror game in which you and co-players have to investigate exciting horror cases. Among finding victims and evidence of the horror event that has taken place, you will be faced with jumpscares and scary monsters along your investigation.

row.name: Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories
row.detailed_description: Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories is a humorous co-operative escape room game where you are looking to get hired by an international criminal organisation. Unfortunately for you, the job interview is being held in a very inconvenient location, and you must make your way through an old sewer system to get there. To make it in time, you must make good use of your wits to overcome the challenges that await you in the sewers. Solve Puzzles Wide variety of simple and fun puzzles, that are sure to make you laugh, or at least to make your friends laugh at you. Explore and Discover You will get to enjoy exploring a dirty sewer system, as you try to make it to the job interview. There are plenty of hidden collectibles and safety violations for you to find as you make your way through the sewer. Work Together Play solo, or distract your friends in up to 5-player multiplayer.
row.short_description: 'Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories' is a humorous co-operative escape room game where you are a henchman who has to make his way through variety of puzzles to make it to a job interview on time. Can you solve all of the puzzles that stand in the way of your employment?

row.name: Bomhops
row.detailed_description: Update Notes *UPDATES SEPTEMBER 2023 *New music tracks. *Updated aesthetics within the menus. *Updated maps. *A scoring system has been added. *The game is now in full-screen mode. *A limited shooting system has been implemented. *The option to reset, exit, and disable music with buttons has been added. *New effects have been added when shooting, accompanied by a different sound. *Issues with shooting and restarting the game have been resolved. About the Game Simple and entertaining 2d game, for two players locally, in different scenarios, very easy to play with just a keyboard, a few keys, and see who is the most skilled on each map, in a house, factory or laboratory, your you decide!
row.short_description: Simple and fun! Challenge a friend to one-on-one duels across six unique stages, or play solo and conquer 15 levels with increasing difficulty!

row.name: PUNCHERMAN!: First Day
row.detailed_description: PUNCHING IS ALL YOU KNOW. YOU'VE PUNCHED ALIENS, DEMONS, ZOMBIES—BUT WITH THESE THREATS GONE, YOU FACE YOUR GREATEST CHALLENGE YET: FAMILY LIFE. PUNCHERMAN! : First Day is a comedy physics dad simulator where you live a day in the life of a former violent FPS protagonist/superhero/generally manly man as he tries to prove himself as a good father and husband. But there’s one problem with that: the only real ability he has is an insanely powerful PUNCH! Engage in the most masculine of stay-at-home-daddery by completing household chores and running errands using only your fists of fury… and accidentally destroy everything you see in the process. FEATURES AND CONTENT! A short vertical slice of the concept: about 20 minutes of chaotic punching fun! A to-do list of 10+ basic chores and errands to punch your way through Four distinct maps filled with physics objects that break or get launched on being punched 3D first-person punching with both hands Optional timer display for speedrunning
row.short_description: PUNCHERMAN!: First Day is a first-person comedy physics dad simulator where you play as a retired FPS hero/generally manly man trying to become the best dad ever. One problem: the only way he can interact with the world is with an incredible punch. Use your fists of fury to prove your heart of gold!

row.name: Aphotic Descent
row.detailed_description: A mobile research facility exists deep down in the ocean where scientists from all over the world study the ecology of creatures ranging from the euphotic zone down to the aphotic zone to carve the path open to deep sea exploration and understanding. After not hearing from the facility for months, a rescue team is sent by submarine to investigate. When the team finds a lead, the submarine is hit by a sudden force. A lone diver manages to escape through a bathysphere and crashes down onto the sea floor... Explore the Depths Descend into the ocean, where you’ll journey through various zones, from the sunlit surface zone to the twilight zone and finally the aphotic zone where monstrosities of the deep exist. Prey vs Predator Encounter a diverse range of creatures, where every encounter presents a unique challenge that requires you to adapt your skills and equipment in order to survive in tense environments. Revelations from Within Your only company are the scattered documents found throughout revealing the true nature of the world engulfing you. Gather information about the horrific experiments conducted and creatures lurking in the dark watching your every move. Suit Up Equipped with a powerful flashlight and your trusty diving knife, you’ll illuminate the dark waters around you, while using the blacklight feature to reveal hidden clues and solve puzzles, and defend yourself against aggressive predators and destroy key objects to complete encounters. NOTE: Aphotic Descent was developed by a team of students, and we greatly appreciate any feedback you may have!
row.short_description: In Aphotic Descent, you play as a diver whose submarine crashed at the bottom of the ocean. With no other option for survival, you must make your way to a nearby underwater research facility facing terrifying creatures, all while descending deeper and deeper...

row.name: Embervale
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Embervale, the ultimate idle fantasy RPG on Twitch and Steam! Dive into a magical world, strive to be the strongest player, and uncover unique treasures. Thrive in Adventures, where your strategic decisions with streamers and viewers determine your success and lead to victory! Embark on thrilling adventures alongside your favorite streamers and experience the thrill of victory and the agony of defeat! Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the world of role play games, Embervale is the perfect way to dive into the action and join a community of passionate players who share your love for gaming. So why wait? Join the adventure and start your journey to become the ultimate player in Embervale today! Why Choose the Steam Version of Embervale? The Steam version of Embervale offers the most reliable and optimized gaming experience. With all graphical assets included directly in the game, you can enjoy significantly reduced loading times. This ensures that even players with slower internet connections can dive into the adventure seamlessly. Streamers will particularly benefit from using the Steam version when playing Adventure mode with their viewers, as it provides the best and smoothest experience possible. Rest assured, the Steam version contains the same rich content and exciting features as the Twitch extension and web versions. Plus, you can showcase your Embervale achievements on your Steam profile, adding an extra layer of bragging rights to your gaming accomplishments. Can I Play Without a Twitch Account? When you start Embervale, you'll have the option to create an account through Steam or link your existing Twitch account to your Steam profile. This flexibility ensures you can jump into the game whether you’re using Twitch or not. However, for Twitch streamers, there's an exclusive Adventure Mode. To access this feature, you'll need to either log in with your Twitch account or link your Steam account to Twitch. This mode is designed to enhance the interactive experience for streamers and their communities! Achievements Once you link your account to Steam, all your achievements will be synchronized across platforms. No matter where you play, any unlocked achievements will automatically appear on your Steam profile. This seamless integration ensures your accomplishments are always up-to-date and ready to show off!
row.short_description: Welcome to Embervale, the ultimate idle fantasy RPG on Twitch and Steam! Dive into a magical world, strive to be the strongest player, and uncover unique treasures. Thrive in Adventures, where your strategic decisions with streamers and viewers determine your success and lead to victory!

row.name: Color Summoners
row.detailed_description: Outwit your opponent and reduce their life points to zero! Simultaneous Turn-Based Gameplay Instead of taking turns, both players declare and resolve actions simultaneously. This means you must constantly anticipate your opponent's moves and make strategic decisions on the fly. Simple Cards, Powerful Combos Each card has a simple yet powerful effect, leading to a wide variety of combo possibilities. Discover and master devastating combos to outplay your opponent. No Rare Cards, No P2W Forget about common cards being inferior to rare ones! This game has no rarity system. Every card is carefully balanced, and victory depends on your ability to read your opponent and build powerful combos. Free to Play We want everyone to enjoy this game, so it's completely free to play. Play with Friends or Strangers Use the matchmaking system to find online opponents or create custom matches to play with friends. Join the Community Join our Discord server to find opponents, make friends, and discuss the game. Respect This game is a modified reproduction of a Flash card game called 'Card Commander' which is no longer available. I am not affiliated with the original creator of Card Commander, 'hozo', but I would like to express my gratitude for his work.
row.short_description: Color Summoner' is a card game in which players play cards simultaneously on the same turn. Defeat your opponents by reading their actions!

row.name: The ABC
row.detailed_description: Special Thanks This game is made from 'SMILE GAME BUILDER'. Story The story is Hee-chan's first encounter with Brahmanism while she was dreaming. Actually Hee-chan didn't know about Brahmanism. It is Brahmana who had an eye on her because he was searching for a gate to another future. Brahmana smells cinders from Hee-chan's soul. In his opinion, anyone's soul must have one or more entrances that is connected with alternative future. Hee-chan Brahmana Game Feature This game is not JRPG but Adventure Game . Playgrounds are mainly separated in three parts. Hidden Object Game Tag Game Block Play Game
row.short_description: This is the ABC story of Hee-chan's encounter with Brahmanism. Because Hee-chan is a girl who has a strong sense of justice, she is easy to lose her temper. Brahmana knows such a person's feature very well and he smells cinders from Hee-chan. Where does the smell of future comes from?

row.name: Revenge of the shadow ninja
row.detailed_description: Revenge of the shadow ninja is a platform game with a gloomy artistic style, you will play the role of a samurai named Shimazu. Shimazu's son is kidnapped and his wife is killed by Takeda with the help of a demon named Fudo. For the past 10 years, Takeda has been sealed away by Shimazu, it is Shimazu's duty to take revenge and try to save his son. Use all your skills to avoid dangerous traps. Destroy all opponents on your way to revenge. Progress through levels by destroying your enemies with dashes and shurikens. Avoid deadly traps, collect gold and upgrade your skills.
row.short_description: Platform game with a gloomy artistic style. Challenging levels with many traps and enemies. Use all your skills to avoid dangerous traps. Destroy all opponents on your way to revenge.

row.name: The Artist
row.detailed_description: Step into the shoes of a successful lawyer in ‘The Artist’ , a gripping and dramatic visual novel that puts story and character above all. Experience a mix of humour, romance, and drama as you navigate your relationship with Ava. With multiple possible endings depending on the choices you make, ‘The Artist’ takes you on an emotional and thrilling journey through the depths of love and trust. After a run of bad luck on the dating scene, and having seemingly explored every avenue available to you, you unexpectedly meet a woman named Ava who captures your heart and attention. You find yourself falling into a deepening relationship that is hard to get a grasp of. Ava is an utterly mysterious muse that brings curiosity and so many feelings out of you that make you second guess yourself endlessly. She is the kind of woman that will make you question everything you know about relationships. Will you stay by Ava's side, even as the evidence against her mounts? Or will you cut ties and move on with your life? The Artist is currently in Early Access, and the first act of the story is available to play for free. The current version features: - Over 1,200 static renders - Over 26,000 words of dialogue - 12 Animated Scenes - Jam-packed with Meaningful Interactions - 10 Achievements to Unlock - In-game Gallery There are three major updates planned for The Artist , and these will be delivered in the form of 'Acts'. - Act One is available for free to give you a chance to play the game, get a feel for the story and characters, and ultimately not waste your time and money. - Act Two will continue where we left off, and will be around the same length as Act One - Act Three will be the final release of The Artist , and will see the end of the story. - We will be releasing bonus content in the form of DLC that go directly towards the production of The Artist and all future stories we choose to tell.
row.short_description: Do you feel good where you are? Some people do, some don't even if they have everything in the world. Does love fix that sort of feeling, even if such feelings feel so hard to grasp and such love could be toxic to yourself? What is a loving muse to the artist who paints them?
row.notes: The game graphically depicts sex and focuses on a hard-hitting story above all else. Some situations may cause stress and upset to many players. The story is not intended for players who suffer from mental health issues or are going through a particularly dark period in their lives. All sexual acts in the game are consensual.

Find the ending and collect the pictures. Find Your Escape your choices will always have consequences . . . . . .

row.name: The Last Veggies
row.detailed_description: The Story A giant meteor full of weird looking creatures has crashed on our planet. Those monsters overran our cities and ate all our food before we were even ready to defend ourselves. The survivors have set up giant safezones that are monster free but they are running out of food. Carl and his friends, a special team of veggie loving monster killers have been sent to the farmlands, the last green spot on earth to look for a new food source. Grow veggies, deliver them to the safezones and fight of those evil creatures as long as you can! The Game In the Last Veggies it is all about Veggies and Monsters. Plant veggies, deliver them to make some money or defend them at all costs. Use your income to buy random items and upgrades for yourself, your weapons or your farm! Fight waves of monsters and defeat even more powerful bosses! Collect golden carrots by defeating enemies to unlock new playable characters, maps or even gamemodes! Veggie Delivery An Endless gamemode with Veggies, Monsters, Raiders, evil Bosses and even Lootatos for the right amount of fun! Here you have to plant, defend and deliver your veggies to make a living and to secure the survival of humanity. Delivering veggies will provide you with some cash to buy upgrades for yourself or your farm! watch out for Raiders that attack your farm and prepare yourself for insanely powerful bosses! Survive as long as you can! The Last Veggies You are slowly running out of seeds to plant veggies and there are not that many left... Defend the Last Veggies until help arrives! In this gamemode you will have to defend veggies to the last Wave. You will gain some money for each surviving veggies that you can use for upgrades and items to make surviving a little easier. There are no Bosses or Raiders here but that doesn't mean that this gamemode is easier! Seed Savers Oh no! Now we are running out of Seeds! Travel to secret location where humanity has stored the last of the seeds to make sure that there are always enough veggies. get those seeds to your vehicle and leave before you are overrun! This mode includes evil bosses, new creatures and tons of seeds! A wide Selection of Characters Carl has a lot of friends out in the Farmlands and you can play each one of them. Every Character comes with a unique set of skills and each character carries a different weapon that will change your playstyle completely! Choose your difficulty Each Map and GameMode can be played in 3 different difficulty levels. If those 3 difficulties are still not enough for you there are events that can be switched on or off to make the game even harder! But the higher the difficulty the higher the chance to fond rare golden carrots!
row.short_description: The Last Veggies is a 2d top-down shooter roguelite where you play as a farmer or his friends fighting hordes of monsters while trying to save humanity by delivering fresh veggies. Play different maps with different characters and an always changing set of Items and Upgrades.

row.name: 不被忘记的你
row.detailed_description: 角色 女主角，中文Galgame资料站CnGal的看板娘，有着人工智能的机器人，在CnGal关闭后，为CnGal的重建而努力着。 我：男主角，和往常一样在下班后返回住处，却在故事开头遇到了看板娘。 类型和玩法 玩家将以男主角“我”为主要视角，体验与女主角看板娘共同努力，重建CnGal经历的免费美少女小说游戏。 制作人员 剧本：箱崎奈绪 示图：疯猫MC 配音：闲踏梧桐 测试：Kirmy 监督：箱崎奈绪 特别感谢 CnGal资料站 酱油（Dreamory）
row.short_description: 免费美少女小说游戏，玩家将以男主角的视角，体验与女主角CnGal看板娘相遇后，共同重建CnGal资料站的故事。

row.name: Curse of the Corsair
row.detailed_description: Echoes of a swashbuckling and treacherous past reverberate through a vast and untamed sea, brimming with riches and danger. In this action-packed adventure RPG, you'll set sail on a journey inspired by the modern classic Hyper Light Drifter, but with a salty, scurvy twist. As a pirate in search of lost treasures and hidden knowledge, you'll explore a world full of danger and wonder. But beware: your character is plagued by a debilitating curse, driving you ever deeper into the mysterious depths of the ocean in search of a cure for the curse of the Corsair. • With everything from characters to environments rendered in lovingly hand-drawn animations, you'll be fully immersed in a vibrant and dangerous pirate world. • Slice and dice by getting up close and personal with melee combat or engage from afar with ranged weapons, it's up to you! • The challenges you'll face are daunting and plentiful; enemies are ruthless, the environment can be unforgiving, and true allies are few and far between. • Discover new weapons, learn unique skills, and uncover valuable equipment as you navigate through a detailed and branching world full of secrets and hidden paths. Set sail for adventure and discover the untold riches and ancient secrets that await you in this epic pirate RPG!
